changes: **Layer Manager and Filters:** Rebuilt the Layer Manager (filter tree beside the table, mockup rows and eyes, narrow pallet, columns, import from another drawing) with nested filters stored in the drawing, wildcard/property filters applied from the search, layer groups, `-LAYTRANS`, `-LAYERSTATE`/LAS and `XBIND`. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Quick Select and FILTER:** Advanced selection filter with window, pattern help, states and live match count, saved filters in the drawing or a file, and `'FILTER`/`'QSELECT` inside a running command. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Tables Overhaul:** Table style cell styles with starting tables and insert-from-style; cell picking, grips, fill grips, a Table Cell ribbon tab, in-place editing, insert N rows/columns, break and fill; typed values checked against the cell's data type, with dates, currency/percent, thousands separators and two-digit year handling; wrapped text grows rows; `TABLECONTENT` kept in step. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Quad Cursor Menu (API v15):** Entity-aware cursor menu with per-type panels and a plugin quad surface; plugin host hardened (NullHost document access, boot-ack observability, channel-ready dispatch). *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller) and [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*

**Dynamic Block Authoring:** Flip parameters end-to-end and their coupled caches migrated across edits; ordered action follow-ups with retained-branch evaluation; value sets for linear, XY, polar and rotation parameters; naming and label prompts at placement; lookup tables keep a blank next-value row; nested reference properties and visibility states edited in batches; the Parameters Manager edits rows and filters in place. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), with Save Block crash recovery from [@Ch4rlos](https://github.com/Ch4rlos))*

**HATCH and GRADIENT:** Command-line keywords, draw and path modes, shared arc options, a full Hatch panel, boundary path flags and forms, picked regions keep nested islands, island selection follows the circle start rule, Normal skips unflagged islands, ANGLE first in bundled patterns. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao))*

**Annotation Scale and Complex Linetypes:** Model-space linetypes honour `MSLTSCALE`; viewports honour `PSLTSCALE`; annotative attributes, dimensions and objects follow the current scale and the layout's own setting; a drawing opens at its saved scale; dashes keep their length in a scaled INSERT; multileader/dimension blocks, wide polylines and complex linetypes draw on block children; aligned linetypes fit every whole period per run. *(Contributed by [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao))*

**New Commands and Parity:** `COMPARE` (modified objects, settings and a CSV report), `BURST`, `XBIND`, `PREVIEW` (SVG), `PUBLISH`/`-PAGESETUP`/`EXPORTPDF`, `-LAYTRANS`/`-LAYERSTATE`, `-FIELD`, `SCALELISTEDIT`, `ANNOUPDATE`, `SELECT`/`SELECTPREVIOUS`, `LOGFILEON`/`LOGFILEOFF`, `JOIN` (collinear runs become a polyline; a line source reports the lines joined), `GROUP` rename/members at the command line, `OBJECTSCALE`, `SCALE`/`ROTATE` with a `Copy` option, `SPLFRAME` for spline-fit 3D polylines, `TEXTEDITMODE`/`DIMOVERRIDE` through the shared variable prompt, `DIMSCALE`/`DIMDEC`/`DIMLFAC` at the command line. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Packaging and Releases:** Windows and Linux ARM64 and Intel macOS builds; managed mode for hosted installs with a start folder and SIGTERM recovery; the website's download page links the latest release's files; `.desktop` entry written when registering as a handler. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@Nozzit](https://github.com/Nozzit))*

**Command-Line Drafting Parity:** `MEASUREGEOM` quick start, Area/Volume chains and `CLose`; `OFFSET` current-settings line, `Through`/`Erase`/`Layer`, `OFFSETGAPTYPE`, Exit/Multiple/Undo; `MATCHPROP` Settings window, named plot styles, centre-line preview and `MATCHMODE` above 32 bits; `REVCLOUD` chords and grips; `WIPEOUT` reference prompts and editable properties; a word after a variable's value prompt answers it; commands accepted from suggestions or typed with arguments are echoed; refused input prints as a plain line; solid geometry bounds are reported from `MEASURE`. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@mvanhorn](https://github.com/mvanhorn))*

**Workspace, CUI and Tool Windows:** Customize User Interface with your own ribbon panels, a Classic workspace and Classic toolbars, Quick Access Toolbar customization and floating ribbon panels, dockable tool palettes, windows of their own for dialogs, keyboard-driven menus, and type-to-search in dropdown lists. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Interaction and Editing:** Double-click edits in paper space and viewports; `Ctrl+Tab`/`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` switch drawings; image drop; softer shaded-view lighting; dialogs open beside another dialog. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Performance:** Spatial indexes in TRIM (cutter index, block boundaries, hover cuts), faster large-drawing interaction, viewport pointer latency and block-stub expansion, first click after a paste, OSNAP/OTRACK candidate hysteresis, faster `LAYOFF`, fewer re-tessellation passes. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@martijn3BM](https://github.com/martijn3BM), [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos), [@Nozzit](https://github.com/Nozzit), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Table Cell Styles:** dialog, starting tables, insert-from-style; `TABLE <option>` as one line; cell data types with dates, currency/percent, separators and two-digit years; wrapped text grows rows. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Cell Grips and Editing:** row/column labels, ranges, Tab, in-place editing, N rows/columns placed without the editor, break and fill, top/left grips move the shared neighbour edge, Table Cell ribbon tab with nine alignments, grip resizes redraw. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
**`TABLECONTENT` Sync:** a table's copy follows its edits. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Layer Filters:** filters match on the shared engine; used/unused/selected-object scopes; `FILTER <name>` and saved filters in the drawing; nested tree; import layers from another drawing. *([@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Layer Tools:** named layer sets and groups; `-LAYTRANS` standards mapping; `-LAYERSTATE` and LAS files; `LAYMRG` for several sources with a confirm; per-object `LAYOFF`; `LAYERFILTER`; `COPYTOLAYER` picks the destination after the objects; layer dropdowns reveal and highlight the selected object's layer; new layers take the picked layer's look; merge into a layer. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Selection:** `SELECT`/`SELECTPREVIOUS` with a remembered set; group picks report the group; `STRETCH` Shift+click removes an object; `Ctrl` cycles a hot polyline grip; MTP/M2P hot grips; dragged grips stay put with a rubber band; spline-fit 2D and 3D dotted frames; `SPLFRAME` for spline-fit 3D polylines; `GROUPDISPLAYMODE` centre grip and extents box. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Associative Arrays:** arrow grips for counts and spacings; COPY Array with a Fit option; a copied associative array is an array of its own — including copies of arrays of attributed blocks; zoom extents count items drawn as stubs. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Parameter Authoring:** value sets (None/List/Increment) for linear, XY, polar and rotation; name/label/description prompts at placement; a blank lookup row for the next value; chained actions named at authoring; ordered follow-up lists with retained branches; a written parameter value moves the reference it was set on. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Flip Parameters:** validated Flip targets, transported axes, reflection frames, coupled Flip evaluation and cache migration. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Parameters Manager:** docks above the authoring palettes, opens from the command and ribbon, edits rows in place, filter/search narrows the list, header column menu, glyph per measured kind, expression filter; lookup and visibility rows stay listed while the graph will not take an edit. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Attributes:** one form when `ATTDIA` is on; `-ATTEDIT` handle and tag rename; swap a string in values from the command line; INSERT attribute visibility under `ATTMODE`; values read as children with their own geometry. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@dhy365-creator](https://github.com/dhy365-creator))*

**Copies and Explode:** copies of an array of attributed blocks are arrays of their own; `BURST` keeps attribute values as text; `EXPLODE` breaks multilines into their lines; `ATTREDEF` redefines a block's attributes from a reference. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@travisjhughes](https://github.com/travisjhughes))*

**Viewports:** VPORTS configuration list, three-viewport layouts, hover outline, `VPMAX`/`VPMIN`, named VPORTS configurations, `VPSCALE`/`VPLOCK`, metre drawings restore physical viewport scales. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Sheets and Plot:** `PREVIEW` renders the page as SVG; `-PAGESETUP` named setups; `PUBLISH` named sheets into one PDF; `EXPORTPDF` named file per layout or all; plot to PDF folder, naming and DPI; annotation scale applied to model-space dash patterns; literal `1:1` paper label preferred. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**MLEADER and Dims:** MLEADER labels stay precise far from the origin; a leader of type None draws only its content; text background fill switches with code 292; multileader balloons and annotative dimension text follow the annotation scale (`SETVAR` exposes annotation scale, visibility and hatch variables); `REVCLOUD` path-length chords, settings, grips and a Revision Cloud split button on Annotate > Markup; `DIMSCALE`, `DIMDEC` and `DIMLFAC` at the command line. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Interchange and Save:** SVG/SVGZ import (`SVGIN`, drag and drop); Copy as SVG; `.ifccad` preferred over `.ifcx` (still supported); autosave copies live in a folder of their own; lossy DXF export prunes dangling references; `BEDIT` Save Block writes its recovery copy at once; DGN V8 reads every model element stream. Block previews restored for transform, placement and clipboard commands. *([@felixriestra](https://github.com/felixriestra), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@BjornFidder](https://github.com/BjornFidder), [@Ch4rlos](https://github.com/Ch4rlos), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Fields and Text:** `Ctrl+F` inserts a field at the caret; Insert Field into a formula; fields of fields reopen; `-FIELD` script form; MTEXT editor follows the text style and names where each value comes from; two-column text style manager with a live preview and usage; the font list sits under its field and is coloured; the Apply summary lists every changed style with counts; full symbol list in two columns; typed `\U+XXXX`; paragraph spacing; `\C256` runs in the layer colour; an SHX font's missing character draws its stand-in; a written line stays in its drawing; SHX big fonts pick the code page; arc-aligned text drawn as text. *([@ftaski](https://github.com/ftaski), [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao), [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Node Graph:** nodes for every object the drawing commands make — Hatch, Multiline, Multileader, Helix, Radius/Diameter dimensions, Rectangle, Polygon, Donut, Revision Cloud, Modify and Model — plus Objects By Type. *([@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MCP:** `entities_create` gives Inserts attribute values by tag; `set_properties` takes colour as a number or RGB; matchprop_settings schema digest; scripted attribute placements answered in form; attribute values read as children with their own geometry. *([@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Registry and Docs:** Commands Reference; Terén plugin in the registry; 3D solid icons, VAR badge, command synonym and alias icon resolution. *([@felixriestra](https://github.com/felixriestra), [@pabloxbezx](https://github.com/pabloxbezx) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Save and Interchange:** dangling handles pruned from acknowledged lossy DXF exports; DWG-only `DIMCONTAINER2` kept across DXF round trips; image reactors and association dependencies retained; a minimized window skips the thumbnail screenshot; block cache previews restored for transform, placement and clipboard; evaluated dynamic block origins preserved on open. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston))*

**Blocks and Attributes:** inserted references get their declared attributes; bare references fill from the definition; a copied reference keeps its identity; a copy into another drawing still carries its definition, styles and object graph; the attributed marker follows the definition body; visibility states keep the first state fully visible and leave other objects alone; the explodable flag decides; value lists anchor to their grip; a picked lookup is nearest the click. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Constraints:** erasing geometry takes its dimension and parameter; fixed objects hold grip drags; an angular or corner edit turns its side without stretching; labels stay complete from creation. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Hatch:** the cull box of small fills far from the origin holds; a picked region keeps every island nested inside; loops picked by island style follow their path flags. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**MTEXT:** size grips point the way they drag and width stays positive; the corner preview clears when the editor opens; paragraph spacing in text heights. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Wipeouts:** a wipeout hides the model-space grid and axes; one grip per corner; `Frames` regenerates correctly; image adjustment is read-only. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Viewports:** `DRAWORDER` reorders model space inside a viewport; a far view centre goes through f64 view axes; non-annotative dynamic blocks stay visible in layout viewports; layout sheet origin follows the page-setup margins. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Properties:** decimal readouts round a tie away from zero; the Parameters visibility toggle refreshes after it changes; the Values label pads like the other rows; a typed value applies on Tab and click-away, not only Enter. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Tables and Ribbon:** clamp panic fixed on minimum-size rows; `TABLE <option>` runs as one line; tables redraw after grip resizes; Quick Properties and lists release command focus; ribbon layer colours editable. *([@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@emrahoksak](https://github.com/emrahoksak))*

**Dimensions and Linetypes:** dimension pictures re-solve in `DIMREGEN` with `DIMUPDATE`; arrow-tip grips on linear/aligned dimensions; `DIMEXE`/`DIMEXO` drawn in the preview; linetype dashes laid out per run and fitted around closed paths; wide polylines keep their bands; annotative dashes keep their length on scaled inserts. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston))*

**MLINE, FILLET and CHAMFER:** multilines explode to their elements with colour, linetype and miter factor; a polyline arc fillets as its arc; two polylines join at end segments; zero-distance chamfers leave no zero-length line; FILLET refuses a radius longer than the line; FILLET defaults the radius to 0. *([@travisjhughes](https://github.com/travisjhughes), [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Localization:** Czech and `.ftl` translations updated; variable value prompts share one translated catalog entry; arc-option prompts carry catalog keys in every locale; Turkish and table-cell strings fixed. *([@dwbmb](https://github.com/dwbmb), [@city-1921](https://github.com/city-1921), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Performance:** Spatial indexes in TRIM (cutter index, block boundaries, hover cuts), faster large-drawing interaction, viewport pointer latency and block-stub expansion, first click after a paste, OSNAP/OTRACK candidate hysteresis, faster `LAYOFF`, fewer re-tessellation passes. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@martijn3BM](https://github.com/martijn3BM), [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos), [@Nozzit](https://github.com/Nozzit), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Table Cell Styles:** dialog, starting tables, insert-from-style; `TABLE <option>` as one line; cell data types with dates, currency/percent, separators and two-digit years; wrapped text grows rows. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Cell Grips and Editing:** row/column labels, ranges, Tab, in-place editing, N rows/columns placed without the editor, break and fill, top/left grips move the shared neighbour edge, Table Cell ribbon tab with nine alignments, grip resizes redraw. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
**`TABLECONTENT` Sync:** a table's copy follows its edits. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Layer Filters:** filters match on the shared engine; used/unused/selected-object scopes; `FILTER <name>` and saved filters in the drawing; nested tree; import layers from another drawing. *([@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Layer Tools:** named layer sets and groups; `-LAYTRANS` standards mapping; `-LAYERSTATE` and LAS files; `LAYMRG` for several sources with a confirm; per-object `LAYOFF`; `LAYERFILTER`; `COPYTOLAYER` picks the destination after the objects; layer dropdowns reveal and highlight the selected object's layer; new layers take the picked layer's look; merge into a layer. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Selection:** `SELECT`/`SELECTPREVIOUS` with a remembered set; group picks report the group; `STRETCH` Shift+click removes an object; `Ctrl` cycles a hot polyline grip; MTP/M2P hot grips; dragged grips stay put with a rubber band; spline-fit 2D and 3D dotted frames; `SPLFRAME` for spline-fit 3D polylines; `GROUPDISPLAYMODE` centre grip and extents box. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Associative Arrays:** arrow grips for counts and spacings; COPY Array with a Fit option; a copied associative array is an array of its own — including copies of arrays of attributed blocks; zoom extents count items drawn as stubs. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Parameter Authoring:** value sets (None/List/Increment) for linear, XY, polar and rotation; name/label/description prompts at placement; a blank lookup row for the next value; chained actions named at authoring; ordered follow-up lists with retained branches; a written parameter value moves the reference it was set on. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Flip Parameters:** validated Flip targets, transported axes, reflection frames, coupled Flip evaluation and cache migration. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Parameters Manager:** docks above the authoring palettes, opens from the command and ribbon, edits rows in place, filter/search narrows the list, header column menu, glyph per measured kind, expression filter; lookup and visibility rows stay listed while the graph will not take an edit. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Attributes:** one form when `ATTDIA` is on; `-ATTEDIT` handle and tag rename; swap a string in values from the command line; INSERT attribute visibility under `ATTMODE`; values read as children with their own geometry. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@dhy365-creator](https://github.com/dhy365-creator))*

**Copies and Explode:** copies of an array of attributed blocks are arrays of their own; `BURST` keeps attribute values as text; `EXPLODE` breaks multilines into their lines; `ATTREDEF` redefines a block's attributes from a reference. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@travisjhughes](https://github.com/travisjhughes))*

**Viewports:** VPORTS configuration list, three-viewport layouts, hover outline, `VPMAX`/`VPMIN`, named VPORTS configurations, `VPSCALE`/`VPLOCK`, metre drawings restore physical viewport scales. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Sheets and Plot:** `PREVIEW` renders the page as SVG; `-PAGESETUP` named setups; `PUBLISH` named sheets into one PDF; `EXPORTPDF` named file per layout or all; plot to PDF folder, naming and DPI; annotation scale applied to model-space dash patterns; literal `1:1` paper label preferred. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**MLEADER and Dims:** MLEADER labels stay precise far from the origin; a leader of type None draws only its content; text background fill switches with code 292; multileader balloons and annotative dimension text follow the annotation scale (`SETVAR` exposes annotation scale, visibility and hatch variables); `REVCLOUD` path-length chords, settings, grips and a Revision Cloud split button on Annotate > Markup; `DIMSCALE`, `DIMDEC` and `DIMLFAC` at the command line. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Interchange and Save:** SVG/SVGZ import (`SVGIN`, drag and drop); Copy as SVG; `.ifccad` preferred over `.ifcx` (still supported); autosave copies live in a folder of their own; lossy DXF export prunes dangling references; `BEDIT` Save Block writes its recovery copy at once; DGN V8 reads every model element stream. **Node Graph:** nodes for every object the drawing commands make — Hatch, Multiline, Multileader, Helix, Radius/Diameter dimensions, Rectangle, Polygon, Donut, Revision Cloud, Modify and Model — plus Objects By Type. *([@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MCP:** `entities_create` gives Inserts attribute values by tag; `set_properties` takes colour as a number or RGB; matchprop_settings schema digest; scripted attribute placements answered in form; attribute values read as children with their own geometry. *([@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Registry and Docs:** Commands Reference; Terén plugin in the registry; 3D solid icons, VAR badge, command synonym and alias icon resolution. *([@felixriestra](https://github.com/felixriestra), [@pabloxbezx](https://github.com/pabloxbezx) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Save and Interchange:** dangling handles pruned from acknowledged lossy DXF exports; DWG-only `DIMCONTAINER2` kept across DXF round trips; image reactors and association dependencies retained; a minimized window skips the thumbnail screenshot; block cache previews restored for transform, placement and clipboard; evaluated dynamic block origins preserved on open. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston))*

**Blocks and Attributes:** inserted references get their declared attributes; bare references fill from the definition; a copied reference keeps its identity; a copy into another drawing still carries its definition, styles and object graph; the attributed marker follows the definition body; visibility states keep the first state fully visible and leave other objects alone; the explodable flag decides; value lists anchor to their grip; a picked lookup is nearest the click. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Constraints:** erasing geometry takes its dimension and parameter; fixed objects hold grip drags; an angular or corner edit turns its side without stretching; labels stay complete from creation. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Hatch:** the cull box of small fills far from the origin holds; a picked region keeps every island nested inside; loops picked by island style follow their path flags. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**MTEXT:** size grips point the way they drag and width stays positive; the corner preview clears when the editor opens; paragraph spacing in text heights. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao) and [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Wipeouts:** a wipeout hides the model-space grid and axes; one grip per corner; `Frames` regenerates correctly; image adjustment is read-only. *([@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Viewports:** `DRAWORDER` reorders model space inside a viewport; a far view centre goes through f64 view axes; non-annotative dynamic blocks stay visible in layout viewports; layout sheet origin follows the page-setup margins. *([@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao), [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Properties:** decimal readouts round a tie away from zero; the Parameters visibility toggle refreshes after it changes; the Values label pads like the other rows; a typed value applies on Tab and click-away, not only Enter. *([@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Tables and Ribbon:** clamp panic fixed on minimum-size rows; `TABLE <option>` runs as one line; tables redraw after grip resizes; Quick Properties and lists release command focus; ribbon layer colours editable. *([@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@emrahoksak](https://github.com/emrahoksak))*

**Dimensions and Linetypes:** dimension pictures re-solve in `DIMREGEN` with `DIMUPDATE`; arrow-tip grips on linear/aligned dimensions; `DIMEXE`/`DIMEXO` drawn in the preview; linetype dashes laid out per run and fitted around closed paths; wide polylines keep their bands; annotative dashes keep their length on scaled inserts. *([@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston))*

**MLINE, FILLET and CHAMFER:** multilines explode to their elements with colour, linetype and miter factor; a polyline arc fillets as its arc; two polylines join at end segments; zero-distance chamfers leave no zero-length line; FILLET refuses a radius longer than the line; FILLET defaults the radius to 0. *([@travisjhughes](https://github.com/travisjhughes), [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Localization:** Czech and `.ftl` translations updated; variable value prompts share one translated catalog entry; arc-option prompts carry catalog keys in every locale; Turkish and table-cell strings fixed. *([@dwbmb](https://github.com/dwbmb), [@city-1921](https://github.com/city-1921), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

changes: **Shared Document Model & Interchange:** Moved the drawing database onto the shared `OpenCADDocument` model, added `IFCX` open/save, and routed additional formats through registered converters. Before a save that would drop converter-reported content, the app lists the losses and lets you return or continue. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimension and Annotation Overhaul:** Completed the `DIM` command family with `DIMOVERRIDE`, `DIMDISASSOCIATE`, `DIMREASSOCIATE`, `DCDISPLAY`, `DIMREGEN`, `DIMCENTER`, `DIMINSPECT`, `DIMTMOVE`, `DIMBREAK` and style application; saved dimension pictures, annotative sizing, flip-arrow flags and user-arrow blocks now round-trip. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Multileader Overhaul:** Added full `MLEADER` command prompts, layer and property editing, grips, edit and align/collect workflows, block-content placement, add/remove leader actions and safe explosion. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MTEXT Editor Rewrite:** The editor now patches the raw MTEXT source, with superscript/subscript buttons, one-sided `^` stacks, glyph-box and fraction fixes, typing in the height/oblique/width/tracking fields, undo/redo, and arc-aligned text spacing, alignment and reading direction. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Ribbon and Command Search Redesign:** Rebuilt the ribbon, menus and command search, including key tips, language-following labels, saved layer states in the layer dropdown, and search that offers only commands that exist. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@saadmooh](https://github.com/saadmooh))*

**Tables and Data Extraction:** Added table property grips, command-line table workflows, an Annotate tables panel, cell text fonts, table-copy pictures and extraction table sizing and format parity. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Layer Workflows:** Added `LAYWALK` and the non-modal LayerWalk pallet, `LAYISO`/`LAYUNISO`, nested-attribute `LAYMGR`, `COPYTOLAYER`, `HATCHLAYER`/`XREFLAYER`, per-viewport layer colour and active-viewport columns. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@lpotharn](https://github.com/lpotharn), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Plugin Host and API 14:** Plugins no longer need the host's compiler or codec commit, and the host gained filtered/paged entity queries, one undo step across messages, shared-memory sizing, headless worker-thread requests, REST `document_id` targeting, system-variable reads and bundled plugin installation. Plugin class objects with host-evaluated display descriptors and class parameter schemas extend the parametric surface through API v16. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Automation and MCP:** Added intent tools for common agent workflows, an `MCP` `node_graph` op backed by a standalone graph engine, schema-digest pinning and conformance checks, and `print_all` automation. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Plotting and File Fidelity:** Plots print at true size, plot-to-file opens the viewer, layout page setups report 1:1, PDF import joins segments by endpoint lookup, DGN reads every element of large meshes, and STEP export merges coplanar triangles into one planar face. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Performance and Localization:** Indexed hatch boundary edges, cached grid overlays per pane, memoized rendered labels, indexed paper views once per epoch, and streamed STL and de-quadratic STEP grouping, alongside refreshed Hungarian, Turkish, Arabic and French strings. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn) and [@saadmooh](https://github.com/saadmooh))*

**Shared Model Migration:** Moved the drawing onto the shared `OpenCADDocument` model and adopted its drawing variables, image/wipeout geometry, codec explode paths and hatch areas. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**IFCX Open and Save:** Added `IFCX` open/save carrying blocks, texts, ellipses, solids and stored dimension pictures. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Converter Interchange:** Open and save supported external formats through registered converters, with an explicit review of content a conversion cannot preserve. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Drawing Properties (`DWGPROPS`):** Added a Drawing Properties dialog with a read-only General tab, an editable Summary tab and a custom-property table; OK stores one undo step and save formats that cannot carry properties warn first. *(Contributed by [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX))*
**Recovery Diagnostics:** Recovery reports name the acadrust commit the reader was built from. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Save Format:** Saving keeps the format of the drawing's own file. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimension Commands:** Added `DIMOVERRIDE`, `DIMDISASSOCIATE`, `DIMREASSOCIATE`, `DCDISPLAY`, `QPMODE`, `DIMREGEN`, `DIMCENTER`, `DIMINSPECT`, `DIMBREAK` prompts and `DIMSTYLE` application, with dedicated ribbon rows and inspection values. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimension Pictures and Sizing:** Saved pictures match line breaks and two-line angles, annotative sizes follow the scale's own ratio, flip-arrow flags draw and save, and user-arrow blocks are honored. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**DIMTMOVE and Overrides:** `DIMTMOVE` measures text only when the user placed it, angular text width and baseline `DIMDLI` behave, and overrides rewrite in place and accept BYBLOCK/BYLAYER colours. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Multileader:** Added command prompts, layer, properties, grips, edit, align/collect, block content from the content base point, lowest-free leader index, context-menu add/remove leader, and explosion. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Text Editor:** Edit the raw MTEXT source, superscript/subscript buttons, one-sided stacks, height/oblique/width/tracking typing, input method in the preview, Ctrl+Z/Y, and command-line font/size in Options. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Arc-Aligned Text:** Added spacing, alignment and reading-direction controls. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Fields:** Object, block and text properties resolve in the codec, additional formats and point coordinates are kept, custom drawing properties resolve, and a field text opens its field for editing. *(Contributed by [@ftaski](https://github.com/ftaski) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Style Import:** Import text and dimension styles from another drawing, repointing dimension styles as a paste does and translating the imported strings. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Table Workflows:** Added table property grips, command-line table commands, an Annotate tables panel, cell text fonts, table-copy pictures and extraction table sizing and format parity. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Block Editor:** Parameter previews now draw polar as a dashed circle with an arrowed arc, XY drives from its endpoint, rotation takes a base angle, alignment defaults to perpendicular, grip counts and labels are asked, Lookup appears in the action list, and visibility/lookup pickers float in Test Block. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Constraints:** Added dedicated geometric constraint command names, tangency and parallel picks that hold the first line, repeat-last, dimensional-form conversion, invalid-pick refusal and flagged-constraint names on entity reads. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Associative Path Arrays:** Added associative path arrays with `ARRAYPATH` DIVIDE/MEASURE methods and member extension dictionaries and reactors. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**ATTSYNC and Attributes:** `ATTSYNC` reaches dynamic references through their definition, and attribute definitions and values stay consistent through insert, copy and edit. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Layer Walk:** `LAYWALK` opens the non-modal pallet with wildcard filters, hold, purge, layer-state capture, zoom to extents and selection. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Layer Isolation:** Added `LAYISO`/`LAYUNISO` with lock-only and fade behavior, plus localized icons. *(Contributed by [@lpotharn](https://github.com/lpotharn))*

**Layer Tools:** Added `COPYTOLAYER`, `HATCHLAYER`, `XREFLAYER`, nested-attribute `LAYMGR`, per-viewport layer colour and active-viewport columns. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Performance:** Indexed hatch boundary edges, per-pane grid caches, memoized i18n labels, one-pass paper view indexes, pre-solve propagation, streamed STL and de-quadratic STEP grouping. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Localization:** DIM/TEXT/LAYISO prompts and unit names across locales, a Hungarian refresh, and Turkish, Arabic and French strings. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@saadmooh](https://github.com/saadmooh))*

**Block Dialogs and Export:** Print the block dialog base point at the drawing precision, open `WBLOCK` with no source set, export a complete drawing header, scope the default `INSERT` block to its drawing, and show the live conversion mode as the prompt default. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Editor Records:** End every block definition and rebuilt representation after its body, answer an empty block name instead of ignoring OK, and count the references in the close prompt. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Parameter Authoring:** Drive XY from its endpoint, draw the rotation preview from the base angle, let rotation take a base angle, and ask for grip counts and labels. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Lookup and Visibility:** Name an empty cell as the fault it is, leave a cell that matches no row empty, keep unmatched table/lookup rows marked, offer a way out when OK refuses a table, and float the Test Block pickers. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Dynamic Properties:** Keep the dynamic value list opaque and its keys out of the viewport, give every row its own id, print values at the drawing precision and in the drawing's units, hide the definition's internal records, and let Escape revert a pending cell edit. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Selection and Session State:** Rebuild selected grips and the panel after every edit, keep block reads and writes consistent during an editor session, and report evaluated dynamic references on their definition. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimension Rendering:** Redraw every saved picture with `DIMREGEN`, keep pictures correct after grip edits and undo, and match line breaks and two-line angles. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Dimension Placement:** Measure text only when the user placed it, honor angular text width, and apply baseline spacing and typed origins. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Multileader Content:** Place block content from the content base point, take the lowest free leader index, and describe explosion behavior without naming other programs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**MTEXT Editing:** Fix glyph boxes with tabs, centre fractions, mask stroke text, and avoid a panic on a cut-short width code. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*

**Text and Attribute Display:** Wrap long attribute widths, keep stroke text crisp when zoomed, and preserve inline index colours when exploding MTEXT. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
**MTEXT Save Loss:** Refuse saves and exports that drop MTEXT data unless allowed, and ask before an older DWG/DXF target drops it. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*
**Fields:** Preserve a reopened field's additional format. *(Contributed by [@ftaski](https://github.com/ftaski))*

**TRIM and FILLET:** Crossing `TRIM` on a polyline cuts only where an edge crosses, multilines trim again, block contents work as cutting edges, a polyline arc segment fillets as its arc, and two polylines at their end segments join into one. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@lpotharn](https://github.com/lpotharn))*
**Wide Polylines:** Close joints where a line meets an arc, skip tangent joints in bevels, and avoid panics on short dashed wires. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Selection:** Keep `SELECTIONPREVIEW` visible while a selection box is drawn, make a trembling click still pick a grip, and keep a block editor selection window's objects. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Clip and View:** Place an `XCLIP` boundary through its transform, keep viewport resizing anchored on the sheet, and reject off-target alignment flips. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX))*

**Curves and Solids:** Tessellate huge circles finely when they bypass the analytical path, and snap solid corners inside blocks and in freshly opened drawings. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Layers:** Refresh locked-layer rendering, keep nested attributes through `LAYMGR`, leave saved transparency alone for `LAYISO` lock-only, and take typing as soon as the layer list opens. *(Contributed by [@lpotharn](https://github.com/lpotharn), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Menus and Ribbon:** Open the last menu under its title, keep only existing commands in search, and follow a language change. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@saadmooh](https://github.com/saadmooh))*

**Dialogs and Options:** Return to Options when a dialog opened from it closes, keep the save-warning list scrollable, and keep the context-menu Repeat label showing the command rather than its internal hand-off. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@BjornFidder](https://github.com/BjornFidder))*

**Docking and Colours:** Keep layer names on one line, show tucked-away panels with `Ctrl+1`, and keep colour 7 swatches in step with the canvas. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Fonts:** Fall back from missing Swiss 721 to a same-width Helvetica clone, resolve typographic Windows font families, and treat built-in SHX fonts as never missing. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Plot Output:** Print plots at true size, open plot-to-file output in the viewer, show a Layout page setup at 1:1, and keep PDF short dashes and the plot-setup list width correct. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Import and Export:** Join PDF segments by endpoint lookup, read every data element of a large DGN mesh, merge coplanar STEP triangles, and write periodic DXF splines in clamped form. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Recovery and Audit:** Recover DWG ACIS data through the API, stop treating a `SORTENTSTABLE`'s sort handles as declared handles, and keep the format of the drawing's own file on save. *(Contributed by [@mvanhorn](https://github.com/mvanhorn) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Rendering:** Keep viewport frame colours correct, batch wipeout updates, and keep copied `SELECTSIMILAR` results intact. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
**Packaging:** Embed AppImage update information and upload its `.zsync` file. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Automation:** Act on the `document_id` each REST request names, fail opens instead of waiting on the recovery prompt, and report each op's outcome. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@mvanhorn](https://github.com/mvanhorn))*

**Plugins:** Join plugin-opened record writes to undo scopes, refresh selected grips after plugin edits, and report `DocumentTabClosed` when a tab closes without saving. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Web:** Avoid a service worker in a sandboxed iframe and disable MSAA for canvas geometry. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**MCP:** Repin the tool-schema digest after schema-changing actions and check every core tool and title in conformance. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Localization:** Translate DIM, TEXT and LAYISO prompts in every locale, fix unit names that read as other words, and keep Arabic and French center-object strings correct. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@saadmooh](https://github.com/saadmooh))*

changes: **Dynamic Block Authoring and Evaluation:** Added native value sets, paired and XY move sets, complete parameter frames, grip roles and positioning, action base points and offsets, polygon Stretch frames, Polar Stretch endpoint bindings, multi-output Lookup tables, evaluated geometry previews, dependency status and construction geometry. Authoring graphs and constraints can be edited on references and retained through copy, insert and Save Block As. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Everyday Drafting and Geometry:** Added live crossing-box `EXTEND`, Shift-based `STRETCH` subtraction, one-click HATCH trimming that preserves curved edges and holes, MLINE trimming, geometric `OVERKILL` settings, all-match `FIND`, REGION edge snaps/dimensions, `PELLIPSE`, selection-scoped `FLATTEN`, richer `LIST` and layer isolation prompts. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX) and [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector))*

**Drawing Exchange and Interoperability:** Expanded DGN V7/V8 support for dimensions, notes, meshes, levels, curves and cells; improved PDF text and curved fills with encrypted-file password entry; and improved STEP, IGES, WMF and 3D Studio geometry/material handling. Added valid AP214 STEP mesh export and periodic DWG spline DXF support. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Annotation and Drawing Data:** Improved dimension and MLeader rendering/editing, clipboard dependency remapping, field and attribute copying, and purge safety so common edits and cross-drawing transfers preserve their content and references. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**QuickCalc:** Added a dockable Standard/Scientific calculator with a shared expression engine for `CAL`, point and distance functions, units, `$` variables, system-variable `getvar()`, history, memory and keypad tools. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Large Drawing Performance:** Reduced work in snapping, constraint solving, hatch processing, STEP reads, block previews, property aggregation, scene queries and repeated solid rendering. Benchmarked gains include a 3.1× Properties rebuild for 2,000 entities, 5.3× STEP assembly lookup, 4.3× constraint drag preview, and 27× bulk constraint refresh. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Automation and Data Workflows:** Added headless `--batch`/`--each` drawing scripts, more dash-form commands, open-document automation without tab activation, OLE insertion/properties, hyperlink editing, data-link actions, richer extraction fields and semantic block/attribute data in MCP `ocs_read`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Workspace and Navigation:** Added display-locked viewport pan/zoom, pointer-centered orbit, revised Zoom Extents framing, responsive floating palettes and a faster block gallery with cached, visible-row previews. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Plugin Grips and Host API:** Added API v11–v13 built-in/custom grip reads and drags, live geometry, deterministic notifications, constraint and record APIs, and quiet commands. Non-blocking delivery, settle recovery and improved reentrant host access keep plugin grips responsive. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Parameter Value Sets and Frames:** Added min/max bounds, increments and allowed values for Linear, Polar, XY and Rotation parameters; paired Move and XY Move sets; complete native parameter frames; and parameter-specific Base, End and XY grips with relocatable display positions. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Stretch and Polar Stretch Authoring:** Added Linear Stretch Pair, XY Stretch Box Set and Polar Stretch Pair authoring, polygon Stretch frames, native Stretch targets for arcs, circles, ellipses, points and text, and Base/End bindings. Polar Stretch can separately select rotation geometry and retain rotate-only target size. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Actions and Grip Controls:** Added independent Rotate/Scale base points and native base offsets, Move/Stretch distance and angle overrides, action bars, `BGRIPSET`, grip repositioning, `BCYCLEORDER`, and authoring graphics/settings controls. Added `BASSOCIATE` to repair orphaned action bindings and feedback for dependency markers and grip roles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Lookup, Properties and Evaluation:** Lookup tables now evaluate formulas and ranges, support multiple outputs, retain shared parameter links and allow row selection on references. Added native Flip labels, parameter names/descriptions, Visibility descriptions and reference properties. Drawing and Test Block previews show evaluated parameter geometry without mutating the resident drawing. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Construction Geometry and Status:** Added `BCONSTRUCTION` Convert/Revert and Show/Hide, persisted construction membership, and per-entity constraint status with editor shading. Added `RESETBLOCK`, `BTABLE`, and `PARAMETERSCLOSE`; added `BLOCKEDITLOCK` and read-only editor session variables. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Properties Tables and Save As:** Added native table grips with must-match behavior and reference-side row choice. Save Block As copies structured parameters, grips, actions, Lookup tables, visibility records and retained associative constraint graphs onto independent handles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Gallery:** Added a gallery for drawing blocks with cached thumbnails, indexed names and previews generated for visible rows; library thumbnails load in the background. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Live `EXTEND` and `STRETCH`:** Added spatially filtered live box/lasso previews, crossing-box extension of multiple lines to a shared boundary, and Shift-window or Shift-click subtraction of selected grips/vertices during `STRETCH`. Previews retain fixed original geometry for snapping and handle blocks, full precision and commit/cancel behavior. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**HATCH Editing:** Added `HATCHEDIT` picking on fills, double-click and context-menu editing, fill-only entity selection, and trimming of polygonal and circular regions by finite line/circle boundaries. Repeated cuts preserve analytic curved edges, circular holes and islands; clipped associative hatches detach safely with a notice. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Geometry Commands:** Added geometry-based `OVERKILL` with a settings dialog and `-OVERKILL`, all-match `FIND` with zoom-to-result, MLINE trimming between cutting edges, pattern-HATCH `EXPLODE`, and collinear line/same-circle arc `JOIN` across gaps. `FILLET` now ends after one corner unless Multiple is selected. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Regions, Snapping and Dimensions:** Added REGION boundary object snaps and mouse-pick acquisition, circular REGION edge measurements and associative dimensions, radius/diameter picks through blocks and viewports, and persisted snap aperture through Options and `APERTURE`. The Shift+right-click snap menu accepts letter keys and Perpendicular snaps rank with other nearest point snaps. *(Contributed by [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimensions and Text:** Added per-object annotative state, multi-dimension property rows, angular measurements stored/read as radians, `DIMJUST` text beside extension lines, and `DATAEXTRACTION` position and rotation columns. Dimension context fit overrides are applied per scale. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Drafting Input and Layers:** Added `PELLIPSE` to create bulged-polyline ellipses, stored with the drawing; Shift temporarily suspends Ortho and typed `<angle` applies only to the next point. `LAYISO` prompts for objects and `LAYUNISO` restores only layers it isolated; layer states can freeze layers in one viewport. `FLATTEN` and `LIST` prompt for objects, and `LIST` includes polyline vertices. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**QuickCalc and `CAL`:** Added a shared lexer/parser/evaluator supporting point literals and functions, assignments, `ans`, unit suffixes, angle modes, trigonometry, scientific functions and system-variable `getvar()`. Added dockable Standard and Scientific keypads, memory/history, unit conversion and persistent global `$` constants/functions. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102); review fixes by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Hyperlinks, OLE and Data:** Added Insert/Edit Hyperlink, `-HYPERLINK`, `HYPERLINKOPTIONS`, `HYPERLINKBASE` and Ctrl+K; added `INSERTOBJ`, OLE variables and an OLE Properties panel; added Insert-tab Data and Linking & Extraction panels with Data Link download/upload actions. `DATAEXTRACTION` includes insert/text rotation and Position X/Y/Z. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**DGN Import:** Expanded V7/V8 support for named levels, cells, shared/unshared cell placement, 3D meshes, curves, filled shapes, dimensions and notes. Imported dimensions use file dimension styles/settings; V7 UOR fractions, sub-units, clockwise arcs, text code pages/fonts and dimension layout are handled. Empty imports now report that nothing was imported. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF Import and Passwords:** Added a Password Protected PDF dialog for open/permission passwords and encrypted PDF underlays. Import reads optional-content layers, text runs, fill/stroke paths, linework and curved regions; supports clipping and text-height/font mapping; and reports when a page requires a password. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**STEP and IGES Exchange:** STEP import handles mapped items, missing units/products, operator scale and unnamed representations; STEP export writes faceted B-rep meshes in valid AP214 product structure. IGES import supports surface types 114/118/120/122/128/140/141, offsets, revolutions, whole spheres/tori, levels and free curves. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**3D Studio and WMF Import:** 3D Studio import supports legacy render records, object colors, material finish/transparency/shading/diffuse maps, multiple-material choice and missing-map reports. WMF import improves text alignment/ascent, spaces, and arc sampling/rounding. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Spline and Linetype Exchange:** DWG periodic splines now render; DXF writes full NURBS control points and knots for periodic and fit-method splines. Complex `.lin` files can load shape files beside the linetype or from the fonts folder, with absolute, rotated and upright (`A=`, `R=`, `U=`) element modes. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Raster and Archive Workflows:** `IMAGE` can place georeferenced GeoTIFF/world-file images at their stored world position, size and rotation, while retaining manual placement. `ARCHIVE`/`ETRANSMIT` resolve and include referenced drawings, images and underlays and list references that could not be found. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Headless Drawing Scripts:** Added `--batch` and `--each`, sequential script rows, command-line `OPEN`/`SAVEAS`/`CLOSE`, save prompts for `EXIT`/`QUIT`, and dash-form `-LAYER`, `-PURGE`, `-STYLE`, `-RENAME`, `-DIMSTYLE`, `-LAYOUT` and `-PLOT`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Automation Server:** Open drawings with missing xrefs and report each reference in `state.xrefs`; adopt drawing header system variables on open; enforce `--read-only` for headless save requests; and cancel commands even when dialogs or nested prompts are active. Automation can read/edit an open inactive document without switching the visible tab. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MCP Block Extraction:** Added semantic block extraction to `ocs_read`, returning placed blocks with resolved dynamic names, attributes from ATTRIB/ATTDEF and visible schedule text, evaluated parameters, visibility and Lookup values, and spatial/glob/JSON-Pointer filtering. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Plugin Grip API v11:** Added per-entity built-in grip reads/drags, custom grip declaration and custom-grip begin/move/settle/cancel callbacks, with viewport and MCP paths sharing one pipeline. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Plugin Grip API v12:** Added live-geometry previews, per-entity batch reads, non-blocking delivery and a settle watchdog. Nested commands are rejected during delivery to prevent UI-loop deadlocks; canceled previews restore source entities byte-for-byte. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Plugin API v13:** Added deterministic notifications, changed-region payloads, constraint creation, batched records and `RunQuiet`. Plugin grip settle writes and constraints join one plugin undo step; the manager supports first-write re-entry and recovers from repeated delivery timeouts. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Viewport, Palettes and Platform:** Added display-locked viewport sheet pan/zoom and a status-bar lock switch, pointer-centered orbit, perspective field of view, and revised Zoom Extents framing. Floating palettes can move/resize from edges while preserving the drawing view; Mac trackpad pan/zoom and Linux/Windows DWG/DXF icons are improved. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Graphics and Defaults:** Added camera glyph control with `CAMERADISPLAY`, saved `EXTMIN`/`EXTMAX`, eight solid isolines in new drawings, and solid isoline spacing from the drawing setting. Added Vietnamese (`vi-VN`) localization. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@vandang890615](https://github.com/vandang890615))*

**Cross-Drawing Clipboard References:** Copy/paste now remaps TABLE contents and cell blocks, raster image definitions, complex linetype shapes/text, MLeader styles and their text/linetype/block dependencies, and dimension-style text styles/linetypes/arrow blocks. Missing dependencies are cleared instead of retaining handles into the source drawing. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Copy Handles and Anonymous Records:** Renewed handles for INSERT sequence ends, polyface vertices/faces and polygon-mesh vertices. Pasted `*` blocks and copied/mirrored/pasted `*D` dimension blocks are marked anonymous, avoiding invalid DWG records and AUDIT errors. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Copied Fields, Attributes, Layouts and Viewports:** Cloned FIELD trees and attribute extension dictionaries so copied fields no longer share source data; copied viewport clipping boundaries follow the new viewport; copied layouts receive cloned extension dictionaries. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Purge References:** PURGE retains text styles referenced by MLeader/table styles, symbols used only by inserted attributes, dimension-style dependencies, current header layer/style/linetype and xref-dependent layers/linetypes/styles. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Draw Order and XDATA:** New-drawing draw-depth labels now have resolvable spacing and rebuild the persistent wire arena after depth-generation changes, fixing masks that failed to cover earlier entities. MOVE/ROTATE/SCALE/MIRROR now transform XDATA point/vector/distance groups with the entity and remove stale raw records. *(Contributed by [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Dynamic Block Persistence:** Preserved dynamic graphs through INSERT/copy, native parameter frames and grip dependencies through edits, and constraint graphs through Save As. Fixed table-grip graph dependencies/column metadata, basepoint and parameter preview edits, orphaned grips, action bindings, angle wrap, rotation after base moves and stale input references. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dynamic Block Safety:** Bounded Array evaluation to 100,000 generated entities before copying; updates remain atomic on refusal. Zero-grip parameters continue evaluating, invalid/unassociated grips are rejected, and grip counts, roles, positions and bindings remain consistent across references and DWG/DXF round trips. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Rendering and Preview:** Preserved tapered polyline widths inside INSERTs, retained legacy base-point previews and cleared editor selection on blank picks. Fixed incorrect previews after block saves and reduced unnecessary palette rebuilds. *(Contributed by [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**HATCH Boundary and Trim Accuracy:** Moving an associative hatch with its boundary now preserves each region. Internal picks use the raw cursor point, HPGAPTOL bridges small gaps without welding away tessellation chords, and boundary picks build only nearby face arrangements. Imported polyline cutters work; circular/curved holes and boundaries survive repeated cuts, while unsupported outer curves are refused rather than flattened. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore) and [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector))*

**HATCH Display and Persistence:** Erasing a boundary keeps the hatch’s shape and makes it independent; hatch fills use even-odd behavior for crossing rings. Selected hatch previews now share the resident fill/style/context path, including solid elevation and gradient/pattern transforms. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**STRETCH and Selection:** Crossing-box selection now hides/previews only objects that actually move, preserving other snap references. Shift-excluded grips/vertices stay excluded through preview and commit; fixed original geometry remains available for snapping. Fixed block/instance previews, fast-pointer overlays, rubber-band precision and release-build action creation. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Geometry Commands:** `OVERKILL` now compares normalized geometry within tolerance rather than DWG storage identity, handles reversed/overlapping lines and arcs, and reports checked/removed/modified counts. Fixed preselected JOIN across gaps, bulge EXTEND intersections, locked-layer replacement handles, TRIM/EXTEND option parsing and ellipse MIRROR/MINSERT explode regressions. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Camera and Viewport:** Pan/zoom/orbit reject non-finite camera updates and Zoom Extents skips NaN bounds. Zoom Extents/All/Object retain the intended pixel margin; orbit pivots on the surface beneath the pointer even for wire/fill geometry. A copied viewport gets its own clip boundary. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Dimension Editing and Annotation:** Editing existing dimension text now updates the active override and drops the stale picture block; fixed extension lines stop at the measured object. Rotated/mirrored dimensions relayout readable text, single-scale annotative dimensions use their picture, and per-scale DIMTOFL/DIMSOXD/DIMTIX/DIMTMOVE fit overrides are honored without changing stored dimensions. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**Dimension Rendering:** Fixed annotative text being scaled twice, annotative MLeaders incorrectly multiplying overall scale, angular measurements displayed from their radians value, dimension text width factors, DIMJUST placement, engineering inch trailing zeros, architectural tick width, origin arrowheads, `_None` user arrow blocks and radius/diameter picks inside blocks/viewports. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**MLeader Compatibility:** Corrected text attachment values 5–8 and right-side attachment, landing underline origin/height/line, text and block-content mirroring, background-color masks, copied style remapping and style purge dependencies. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MTEXT and Text Styles:** Corrected bare `\p` drawing-unit indents and tab-stop origins, SHX line spacing, bottom/middle ink attachment, editor preview orientation/contrast and `%%c`/`%%d`/`%%p` entry. Selecting a stroke font now clears the prior system-font override; TrueType bold/italic faces resolve from their family. *(Contributed by [@vandang890615](https://github.com/vandang890615), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**DGN Import:** Corrected V7/V8 curve, cell, unit and text placement; V7 level names, code page, clockwise arcs, UOR fractions and sub-units; V8 mesh face loops; DGN dimension type/point counts, dimension styles, text fonts, arc points and annotation placement. Imported DGN dimensions no longer gain a centre mark. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF Import:** Corrected text runs across graphics/gaps, optional-content layer order, fill/stroke operator handling, line/fill paths, zero-area loops, curved boundaries, clipping and font-derived text heights. Password prompts keep their focus and apply only where import requires a permission password; ordinary PDF attachments remain available. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**STEP/IGES/WMF/3DS Import:** Fixed STEP mapped-item units/operator scaling and representation lookup; IGES cone direction, surface closure, whole torus/sphere and offset surfaces; WMF arc precision, endpoint/ascent and text alignment; 3DS material records, legacy object transforms, malformed chunks and cancel feedback. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Proxy, Mesh and Solid Rendering:** Decoded proxy text/unicode labels, layer/linetype traits, transforms, circles/arcs, fills, shells with holes and bulged polylines. Mesh edges keep object/material colors; layer-0 block members follow their reference; isolines follow the drawing setting; tapered block polylines and short dashed runs render correctly. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**PDF and Print Output:** Fixed plot transparency to use PDF alpha, respected automation transparency/lineweight/merge/stamp flags over saved page setups, restored cap/join state, and corrected paper-space projection of model fills. Fixed model-space color 7/ByBlock hatches and preserved yellow/cyan; added solid/surface/region edges and `.pc5` PDF plotter compatibility. *(Contributed by [@megabrain-agent](https://github.com/megabrain-agent) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Lineweights and Plot Styles:** `LWDISPLAY` alone now controls screen lineweight display; visible plot styles recolor each repeated block copy. Corrected plot fill background handling and PDF searchable-text graphics state/scale. *(Contributed by [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Palettes and Properties:** Block gallery/palette caches no longer collide, build only needed previews and keep Recent/Favorites fallback previews. Floating palettes move and resize consistently while the viewport overlays keep pace; clipped property names show a tooltip. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Command Input and Selection:** Command option buttons wrap instead of squeezing; selection cycling lists each object once and Escape closes the list; spreadsheet-pasted rows become separate points and tabs delimit X/Y. The crosshair remains visible for XLINE/RAY and hides when the pointer leaves the viewport. *(Contributed by [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Layers, Properties and Links:** `LAYUNISO` restores only layers changed by `LAYISO`; hidden/xref-dependent symbols are retained; color dropdowns remain visible within scrollable palettes; transparency inputs keep focus and offer presets. Block-definition hyperlinks no longer expose unsupported view/relative-path controls or lose `#location` data. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@GWydouw](https://github.com/GWydouw))*

**Automation and Script Dispatch:** Headless open uses the recovery reader when strict read fails; header system variables are adopted on open; scripted command dispatch preserves one-command behavior and handles tab closure safely. Python-driven commands now create distinct undo steps, and the fillet wrapper accepts picks through completion. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**GPU and Platform Startup:** GPU probing rejects unsupported F16-in-F32 shader adapters, retries a previously blamed backend before final fallback and distinguishes crash-skipped backends from unsupported hardware. Wayland snaps bundle Xcursor themes; Mac trackpad wheel/two-finger behavior is corrected; Linux and Windows DWG/DXF file icons render at full resolution. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Plugin Grip Reliability:** First-write boundary broadcasts no longer deadlock through manager re-entry; one late grip delivery records a strike and cancels the drag while keeping the plugin connected, with repeated timeouts triggering teardown/re-arm. Stale notifications and incompatible plugin versions are reported or ignored safely. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Web and Other Stability:** Web drawing open evaluates fields as desktop does; web touch gestures use the platform clock. New drawings no longer lose entities to indistinguishable draw-depth labels; drawing reads can recover through the headless path; and DXF shape rotation is not applied twice. *(Contributed by [@megabrain-agent](https://github.com/megabrain-agent), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Performance:** Avoided full-document scans and rebuilds in INSERT block lookup, TRIM/EXTEND picks, HATCH startup/moves, snap candidates, constraint graph refresh, visual-style changes, repeated viewport solid meshes, palette previews and localization lookup. Reused nested xref documents and STEP assembly indexes; reduced automation JSON reply latency. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@Lukreynol01](https://github.com/Lukreynol01), [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*
