allChanges: **Dynamic Block Authoring and Evaluation:** Added native value sets, paired and XY move sets, complete parameter frames, grip roles and positioning, action base points and offsets, polygon Stretch frames, Polar Stretch endpoint bindings, multi-output Lookup tables, evaluated geometry previews, dependency status and construction geometry. Authoring graphs and constraints can be edited on references and retained through copy, insert and Save Block As. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Everyday Drafting and Geometry:** Added live crossing-box `EXTEND`, Shift-based `STRETCH` subtraction, one-click HATCH trimming that preserves curved edges and holes, MLINE trimming, geometric `OVERKILL` settings, all-match `FIND`, REGION edge snaps/dimensions, `PELLIPSE`, selection-scoped `FLATTEN`, richer `LIST` and layer isolation prompts. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX) and [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector))*

**Drawing Exchange and Interoperability:** Expanded DGN V7/V8 support for dimensions, notes, meshes, levels, curves and cells; improved PDF text and curved fills with encrypted-file password entry; and improved STEP, IGES, WMF and 3D Studio geometry/material handling. Added valid AP214 STEP mesh export and periodic DWG spline DXF support. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Annotation and Drawing Data:** Improved dimension and MLeader rendering/editing, clipboard dependency remapping, field and attribute copying, and purge safety so common edits and cross-drawing transfers preserve their content and references. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**QuickCalc:** Added a dockable Standard/Scientific calculator with a shared expression engine for `CAL`, point and distance functions, units, `$` variables, system-variable `getvar()`, history, memory and keypad tools. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Large Drawing Performance:** Reduced work in snapping, constraint solving, hatch processing, STEP reads, block previews, property aggregation, scene queries and repeated solid rendering. Benchmarked gains include a 3.1× Properties rebuild for 2,000 entities, 5.3× STEP assembly lookup, 4.3× constraint drag preview, and 27× bulk constraint refresh. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Automation and Data Workflows:** Added headless `--batch`/`--each` drawing scripts, more dash-form commands, open-document automation without tab activation, OLE insertion/properties, hyperlink editing, data-link actions, richer extraction fields and semantic block/attribute data in MCP `ocs_read`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Workspace and Navigation:** Added display-locked viewport pan/zoom, pointer-centered orbit, revised Zoom Extents framing, responsive floating palettes and a faster block gallery with cached, visible-row previews. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Plugin Grips and Host API:** Added API v11–v13 built-in/custom grip reads and drags, live geometry, deterministic notifications, constraint and record APIs, and quiet commands. Non-blocking delivery, settle recovery and improved reentrant host access keep plugin grips responsive. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Parameter Value Sets and Frames:** Added min/max bounds, increments and allowed values for Linear, Polar, XY and Rotation parameters; paired Move and XY Move sets; complete native parameter frames; and parameter-specific Base, End and XY grips with relocatable display positions. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Stretch and Polar Stretch Authoring:** Added Linear Stretch Pair, XY Stretch Box Set and Polar Stretch Pair authoring, polygon Stretch frames, native Stretch targets for arcs, circles, ellipses, points and text, and Base/End bindings. Polar Stretch can separately select rotation geometry and retain rotate-only target size. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Actions and Grip Controls:** Added independent Rotate/Scale base points and native base offsets, Move/Stretch distance and angle overrides, action bars, `BGRIPSET`, grip repositioning, `BCYCLEORDER`, and authoring graphics/settings controls. Added `BASSOCIATE` to repair orphaned action bindings and feedback for dependency markers and grip roles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Lookup, Properties and Evaluation:** Lookup tables now evaluate formulas and ranges, support multiple outputs, retain shared parameter links and allow row selection on references. Added native Flip labels, parameter names/descriptions, Visibility descriptions and reference properties. Drawing and Test Block previews show evaluated parameter geometry without mutating the resident drawing. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Construction Geometry and Status:** Added `BCONSTRUCTION` Convert/Revert and Show/Hide, persisted construction membership, and per-entity constraint status with editor shading. Added `RESETBLOCK`, `BTABLE`, and `PARAMETERSCLOSE`; added `BLOCKEDITLOCK` and read-only editor session variables. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Properties Tables and Save As:** Added native table grips with must-match behavior and reference-side row choice. Save Block As copies structured parameters, grips, actions, Lookup tables, visibility records and retained associative constraint graphs onto independent handles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Gallery:** Added a gallery for drawing blocks with cached thumbnails, indexed names and previews generated for visible rows; library thumbnails load in the background. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Live `EXTEND` and `STRETCH`:** Added spatially filtered live box/lasso previews, crossing-box extension of multiple lines to a shared boundary, and Shift-window or Shift-click subtraction of selected grips/vertices during `STRETCH`. Previews retain fixed original geometry for snapping and handle blocks, full precision and commit/cancel behavior. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**HATCH Editing:** Added `HATCHEDIT` picking on fills, double-click and context-menu editing, fill-only entity selection, and trimming of polygonal and circular regions by finite line/circle boundaries. Repeated cuts preserve analytic curved edges, circular holes and islands; clipped associative hatches detach safely with a notice. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore), [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Geometry Commands:** Added geometry-based `OVERKILL` with a settings dialog and `-OVERKILL`, all-match `FIND` with zoom-to-result, MLINE trimming between cutting edges, pattern-HATCH `EXPLODE`, and collinear line/same-circle arc `JOIN` across gaps. `FILLET` now ends after one corner unless Multiple is selected. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Regions, Snapping and Dimensions:** Added REGION boundary object snaps and mouse-pick acquisition, circular REGION edge measurements and associative dimensions, radius/diameter picks through blocks and viewports, and persisted snap aperture through Options and `APERTURE`. The Shift+right-click snap menu accepts letter keys and Perpendicular snaps rank with other nearest point snaps. *(Contributed by [@sclMAX](https://github.com/sclMAX) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimensions and Text:** Added per-object annotative state, multi-dimension property rows, angular measurements stored/read as radians, `DIMJUST` text beside extension lines, and `DATAEXTRACTION` position and rotation columns. Dimension context fit overrides are applied per scale. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Drafting Input and Layers:** Added `PELLIPSE` to create bulged-polyline ellipses, stored with the drawing; Shift temporarily suspends Ortho and typed `<angle` applies only to the next point. `LAYISO` prompts for objects and `LAYUNISO` restores only layers it isolated; layer states can freeze layers in one viewport. `FLATTEN` and `LIST` prompt for objects, and `LIST` includes polyline vertices. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**QuickCalc and `CAL`:** Added a shared lexer/parser/evaluator supporting point literals and functions, assignments, `ans`, unit suffixes, angle modes, trigonometry, scientific functions and system-variable `getvar()`. Added dockable Standard and Scientific keypads, memory/history, unit conversion and persistent global `$` constants/functions. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102); review fixes by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Hyperlinks, OLE and Data:** Added Insert/Edit Hyperlink, `-HYPERLINK`, `HYPERLINKOPTIONS`, `HYPERLINKBASE` and Ctrl+K; added `INSERTOBJ`, OLE variables and an OLE Properties panel; added Insert-tab Data and Linking & Extraction panels with Data Link download/upload actions. `DATAEXTRACTION` includes insert/text rotation and Position X/Y/Z. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**DGN Import:** Expanded V7/V8 support for named levels, cells, shared/unshared cell placement, 3D meshes, curves, filled shapes, dimensions and notes. Imported dimensions use file dimension styles/settings; V7 UOR fractions, sub-units, clockwise arcs, text code pages/fonts and dimension layout are handled. Empty imports now report that nothing was imported. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF Import and Passwords:** Added a Password Protected PDF dialog for open/permission passwords and encrypted PDF underlays. Import reads optional-content layers, text runs, fill/stroke paths, linework and curved regions; supports clipping and text-height/font mapping; and reports when a page requires a password. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**STEP and IGES Exchange:** STEP import handles mapped items, missing units/products, operator scale and unnamed representations; STEP export writes faceted B-rep meshes in valid AP214 product structure. IGES import supports surface types 114/118/120/122/128/140/141, offsets, revolutions, whole spheres/tori, levels and free curves. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**3D Studio and WMF Import:** 3D Studio import supports legacy render records, object colors, material finish/transparency/shading/diffuse maps, multiple-material choice and missing-map reports. WMF import improves text alignment/ascent, spaces, and arc sampling/rounding. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Spline and Linetype Exchange:** DWG periodic splines now render; DXF writes full NURBS control points and knots for periodic and fit-method splines. Complex `.lin` files can load shape files beside the linetype or from the fonts folder, with absolute, rotated and upright (`A=`, `R=`, `U=`) element modes. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Raster and Archive Workflows:** `IMAGE` can place georeferenced GeoTIFF/world-file images at their stored world position, size and rotation, while retaining manual placement. `ARCHIVE`/`ETRANSMIT` resolve and include referenced drawings, images and underlays and list references that could not be found. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Headless Drawing Scripts:** Added `--batch` and `--each`, sequential script rows, command-line `OPEN`/`SAVEAS`/`CLOSE`, save prompts for `EXIT`/`QUIT`, and dash-form `-LAYER`, `-PURGE`, `-STYLE`, `-RENAME`, `-DIMSTYLE`, `-LAYOUT` and `-PLOT`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Automation Server:** Open drawings with missing xrefs and report each reference in `state.xrefs`; adopt drawing header system variables on open; enforce `--read-only` for headless save requests; and cancel commands even when dialogs or nested prompts are active. Automation can read/edit an open inactive document without switching the visible tab. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MCP Block Extraction:** Added semantic block extraction to `ocs_read`, returning placed blocks with resolved dynamic names, attributes from ATTRIB/ATTDEF and visible schedule text, evaluated parameters, visibility and Lookup values, and spatial/glob/JSON-Pointer filtering. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Plugin Grip API v11:** Added per-entity built-in grip reads/drags, custom grip declaration and custom-grip begin/move/settle/cancel callbacks, with viewport and MCP paths sharing one pipeline. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Plugin Grip API v12:** Added live-geometry previews, per-entity batch reads, non-blocking delivery and a settle watchdog. Nested commands are rejected during delivery to prevent UI-loop deadlocks; canceled previews restore source entities byte-for-byte. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Plugin API v13:** Added deterministic notifications, changed-region payloads, constraint creation, batched records and `RunQuiet`. Plugin grip settle writes and constraints join one plugin undo step; the manager supports first-write re-entry and recovers from repeated delivery timeouts. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Viewport, Palettes and Platform:** Added display-locked viewport sheet pan/zoom and a status-bar lock switch, pointer-centered orbit, perspective field of view, and revised Zoom Extents framing. Floating palettes can move/resize from edges while preserving the drawing view; Mac trackpad pan/zoom and Linux/Windows DWG/DXF icons are improved. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Graphics and Defaults:** Added camera glyph control with `CAMERADISPLAY`, saved `EXTMIN`/`EXTMAX`, eight solid isolines in new drawings, and solid isoline spacing from the drawing setting. Added Vietnamese (`vi-VN`) localization. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@vandang890615](https://github.com/vandang890615))*

**Cross-Drawing Clipboard References:** Copy/paste now remaps TABLE contents and cell blocks, raster image definitions, complex linetype shapes/text, MLeader styles and their text/linetype/block dependencies, and dimension-style text styles/linetypes/arrow blocks. Missing dependencies are cleared instead of retaining handles into the source drawing. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Copy Handles and Anonymous Records:** Renewed handles for INSERT sequence ends, polyface vertices/faces and polygon-mesh vertices. Pasted `*` blocks and copied/mirrored/pasted `*D` dimension blocks are marked anonymous, avoiding invalid DWG records and AUDIT errors. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Copied Fields, Attributes, Layouts and Viewports:** Cloned FIELD trees and attribute extension dictionaries so copied fields no longer share source data; copied viewport clipping boundaries follow the new viewport; copied layouts receive cloned extension dictionaries. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Purge References:** PURGE retains text styles referenced by MLeader/table styles, symbols used only by inserted attributes, dimension-style dependencies, current header layer/style/linetype and xref-dependent layers/linetypes/styles. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Draw Order and XDATA:** New-drawing draw-depth labels now have resolvable spacing and rebuild the persistent wire arena after depth-generation changes, fixing masks that failed to cover earlier entities. MOVE/ROTATE/SCALE/MIRROR now transform XDATA point/vector/distance groups with the entity and remove stale raw records. *(Contributed by [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Dynamic Block Persistence:** Preserved dynamic graphs through INSERT/copy, native parameter frames and grip dependencies through edits, and constraint graphs through Save As. Fixed table-grip graph dependencies/column metadata, basepoint and parameter preview edits, orphaned grips, action bindings, angle wrap, rotation after base moves and stale input references. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dynamic Block Safety:** Bounded Array evaluation to 100,000 generated entities before copying; updates remain atomic on refusal. Zero-grip parameters continue evaluating, invalid/unassociated grips are rejected, and grip counts, roles, positions and bindings remain consistent across references and DWG/DXF round trips. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Block Rendering and Preview:** Preserved tapered polyline widths inside INSERTs, retained legacy base-point previews and cleared editor selection on blank picks. Fixed incorrect previews after block saves and reduced unnecessary palette rebuilds. *(Contributed by [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**HATCH Boundary and Trim Accuracy:** Moving an associative hatch with its boundary now preserves each region. Internal picks use the raw cursor point, HPGAPTOL bridges small gaps without welding away tessellation chords, and boundary picks build only nearby face arrangements. Imported polyline cutters work; circular/curved holes and boundaries survive repeated cuts, while unsupported outer curves are refused rather than flattened. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore) and [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector))*

**HATCH Display and Persistence:** Erasing a boundary keeps the hatch’s shape and makes it independent; hatch fills use even-odd behavior for crossing rings. Selected hatch previews now share the resident fill/style/context path, including solid elevation and gradient/pattern transforms. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**STRETCH and Selection:** Crossing-box selection now hides/previews only objects that actually move, preserving other snap references. Shift-excluded grips/vertices stay excluded through preview and commit; fixed original geometry remains available for snapping. Fixed block/instance previews, fast-pointer overlays, rubber-band precision and release-build action creation. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Geometry Commands:** `OVERKILL` now compares normalized geometry within tolerance rather than DWG storage identity, handles reversed/overlapping lines and arcs, and reports checked/removed/modified counts. Fixed preselected JOIN across gaps, bulge EXTEND intersections, locked-layer replacement handles, TRIM/EXTEND option parsing and ellipse MIRROR/MINSERT explode regressions. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Camera and Viewport:** Pan/zoom/orbit reject non-finite camera updates and Zoom Extents skips NaN bounds. Zoom Extents/All/Object retain the intended pixel margin; orbit pivots on the surface beneath the pointer even for wire/fill geometry. A copied viewport gets its own clip boundary. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*

**Dimension Editing and Annotation:** Editing existing dimension text now updates the active override and drops the stale picture block; fixed extension lines stop at the measured object. Rotated/mirrored dimensions relayout readable text, single-scale annotative dimensions use their picture, and per-scale DIMTOFL/DIMSOXD/DIMTIX/DIMTMOVE fit overrides are honored without changing stored dimensions. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**Dimension Rendering:** Fixed annotative text being scaled twice, annotative MLeaders incorrectly multiplying overall scale, angular measurements displayed from their radians value, dimension text width factors, DIMJUST placement, engineering inch trailing zeros, architectural tick width, origin arrowheads, `_None` user arrow blocks and radius/diameter picks inside blocks/viewports. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**MLeader Compatibility:** Corrected text attachment values 5–8 and right-side attachment, landing underline origin/height/line, text and block-content mirroring, background-color masks, copied style remapping and style purge dependencies. *(Contributed by [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26), [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MTEXT and Text Styles:** Corrected bare `\p` drawing-unit indents and tab-stop origins, SHX line spacing, bottom/middle ink attachment, editor preview orientation/contrast and `%%c`/`%%d`/`%%p` entry. Selecting a stroke font now clears the prior system-font override; TrueType bold/italic faces resolve from their family. *(Contributed by [@vandang890615](https://github.com/vandang890615), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**DGN Import:** Corrected V7/V8 curve, cell, unit and text placement; V7 level names, code page, clockwise arcs, UOR fractions and sub-units; V8 mesh face loops; DGN dimension type/point counts, dimension styles, text fonts, arc points and annotation placement. Imported DGN dimensions no longer gain a centre mark. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF Import:** Corrected text runs across graphics/gaps, optional-content layer order, fill/stroke operator handling, line/fill paths, zero-area loops, curved boundaries, clipping and font-derived text heights. Password prompts keep their focus and apply only where import requires a permission password; ordinary PDF attachments remain available. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**STEP/IGES/WMF/3DS Import:** Fixed STEP mapped-item units/operator scaling and representation lookup; IGES cone direction, surface closure, whole torus/sphere and offset surfaces; WMF arc precision, endpoint/ascent and text alignment; 3DS material records, legacy object transforms, malformed chunks and cancel feedback. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Proxy, Mesh and Solid Rendering:** Decoded proxy text/unicode labels, layer/linetype traits, transforms, circles/arcs, fills, shells with holes and bulged polylines. Mesh edges keep object/material colors; layer-0 block members follow their reference; isolines follow the drawing setting; tapered block polylines and short dashed runs render correctly. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26))*

**PDF and Print Output:** Fixed plot transparency to use PDF alpha, respected automation transparency/lineweight/merge/stamp flags over saved page setups, restored cap/join state, and corrected paper-space projection of model fills. Fixed model-space color 7/ByBlock hatches and preserved yellow/cyan; added solid/surface/region edges and `.pc5` PDF plotter compatibility. *(Contributed by [@megabrain-agent](https://github.com/megabrain-agent) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Lineweights and Plot Styles:** `LWDISPLAY` alone now controls screen lineweight display; visible plot styles recolor each repeated block copy. Corrected plot fill background handling and PDF searchable-text graphics state/scale. *(Contributed by [@cmlad26](https://github.com/cmlad26) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Palettes and Properties:** Block gallery/palette caches no longer collide, build only needed previews and keep Recent/Favorites fallback previews. Floating palettes move and resize consistently while the viewport overlays keep pace; clipped property names show a tooltip. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Command Input and Selection:** Command option buttons wrap instead of squeezing; selection cycling lists each object once and Escape closes the list; spreadsheet-pasted rows become separate points and tabs delimit X/Y. The crosshair remains visible for XLINE/RAY and hides when the pointer leaves the viewport. *(Contributed by [@Jesus](https://github.com/Jeshuuu), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Layers, Properties and Links:** `LAYUNISO` restores only layers changed by `LAYISO`; hidden/xref-dependent symbols are retained; color dropdowns remain visible within scrollable palettes; transparency inputs keep focus and offer presets. Block-definition hyperlinks no longer expose unsupported view/relative-path controls or lose `#location` data. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps) and [@GWydouw](https://github.com/GWydouw))*

**Automation and Script Dispatch:** Headless open uses the recovery reader when strict read fails; header system variables are adopted on open; scripted command dispatch preserves one-command behavior and handles tab closure safely. Python-driven commands now create distinct undo steps, and the fillet wrapper accepts picks through completion. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**GPU and Platform Startup:** GPU probing rejects unsupported F16-in-F32 shader adapters, retries a previously blamed backend before final fallback and distinguishes crash-skipped backends from unsupported hardware. Wayland snaps bundle Xcursor themes; Mac trackpad wheel/two-finger behavior is corrected; Linux and Windows DWG/DXF file icons render at full resolution. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Plugin Grip Reliability:** First-write boundary broadcasts no longer deadlock through manager re-entry; one late grip delivery records a strike and cancels the drag while keeping the plugin connected, with repeated timeouts triggering teardown/re-arm. Stale notifications and incompatible plugin versions are reported or ignored safely. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Web and Other Stability:** Web drawing open evaluates fields as desktop does; web touch gestures use the platform clock. New drawings no longer lose entities to indistinguishable draw-depth labels; drawing reads can recover through the headless path; and DXF shape rotation is not applied twice. *(Contributed by [@megabrain-agent](https://github.com/megabrain-agent), [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@Jeshuuu](https://github.com/Jeshuuu))*

**Performance:** Avoided full-document scans and rebuilds in INSERT block lookup, TRIM/EXTEND picks, HATCH startup/moves, snap candidates, constraint graph refresh, visual-style changes, repeated viewport solid meshes, palette previews and localization lookup. Reused nested xref documents and STEP assembly indexes; reduced automation JSON reply latency. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), [@Lukreynol01](https://github.com/Lukreynol01), [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller) and [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Geometry Commands:** Improved `STRETCH` previews for arcs and splines, preserved arc height, sped up large `TRIM`/`EXTEND` picks, honored preselected extend boundaries, and joined filleted lines/arcs and separate chains correctly. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Extrusion History:** Preserved fallback profile data in group 295 and applied taper only when requested. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Grip & Hatch Interaction:** Kept model grips on the drawing plane and improved hatch pick performance in large drawings, including off-layer boundaries. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Layouts & Plot Units:** Preserved layout sheet state before first open, fit the first viewport to the sheet without dropping saved viewports, reopened layouts in their saved viewport, and kept paper units independent of model `INSUNITS`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**Zoom Extents:** Correctly framed drawings located at survey coordinates in Zoom Extents and Zoom All. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dimension Styles & Annotation:** Kept radius text aligned with its grip, based new dimension styles on the selected style, preserved model-height defaults for TEXT/MTEXT, and corrected annotative scale behavior. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Dialogs & Command Line:** Staged plot-style and point-style edits until acceptance, blocked edits to xref-dependent dimension styles, preserved typed command argument casing, and improved command-line focus. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Start & System Integration:** Restored the Start screen New action, opened the template picker at the default template folder, added a Windows Settings fallback for default-app configuration, and restored the macOS DMG Applications shortcut. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@KevinGriffin-new](https://github.com/KevinGriffin-new))*

**DWG Audit & Compliance:** Used codec audit and repair for corrupted drawings and corrected OCS-saved files for strict-reader compatibility. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**DGN, STEP, IGES & WMF Readers:** Bounded DGN element reads, hardened STEP/IGES/WMF parsing against crafted files, and corrected nested DGN elements, cells, text, and 3D line strings. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF Import & SHX Recognition:** Improved imported geometry precision, SHX font resolution, text grouping and glyph coverage, drawing order, and file/page feedback; corrected fractional SHX arc decoding. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**PDF & Plot Output:** Preserved wide-polyline end caps and joins, drawing layers, requested plot-style precedence, and accurate sheet placement for window plots. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Plot Lineweights & Patterns:** Preserved thin lineweight widths and correctly emitted PDF dash patterns with sub-point lengths. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Underlay & XREF Integrity:** Preserved host layer 0 and Defpoints flags in XREFs, corrected DWF origin handling, and kept layout viewport rendering caches available. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Raster Handling:** Enforced image decode memory limits, handled oversized GIF/TIFF inputs, and kept adjusted images linked to their source files. *(Contributed by [@afonsop](https://github.com/afonsop) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Transparency & Draw Order:** Fixed transparent hatch layering and transformed wipeout/hatch masks in block inserts. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**3D Redraw & Underlays:** Redrew moved meshes at their new positions and preserved underlay snap behavior and origin data. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12) and [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Save Reliability:** Retried atomic file replacement when files are briefly locked and avoided waiting indefinitely for thumbnail or screenshot rendering during save. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Automation Requests:** Hardened request ID reuse, atomic system-variable/layer changes, task completion, verified-save tracking, spline validation, and cancellation of requests that never settle. *(Contributed by [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Plugin Editing:** Refreshed selected grip markers after plugin-driven entity edits and joined plugin-opened XRecord writes to undo scopes. *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller))*

**Localization:** Improved Hungarian, French, and Spanish translations and cataloged newly added interface strings. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@NJdevPro](https://github.com/NJdevPro), and [@JuCeIbMo](https://github.com/JuCeIbMo))*

changes: **Sheet Set Manager (`SHEETSET`):** Introduced a complete Sheet Set Manager palette, `.dst` project creation wizard, cross-drawing sheet fields, drawing lock-file coordination, and background sheet opening. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Automated Entity Counting (`COUNT`):** Added the `COUNT` feature and palette, providing visual block counting across model space or designated polygon boundaries, collision/overlap diagnostics, and live evaluated count table insertion. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Associative Swept Surfaces & 3D Modeling:** Added network-tracked associative swept surfaces (`SWEEP`) with path-relative base points, miter corner history, B-rep `MASSPROP`, and curved offset/fillets in the geometry kernel. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**Advanced Typography & Table Overrides:** Fully compliant right-to-left (RTL) text rendering in `MTEXT`, exact evaluation bounding boxes for shaped/rotated text fields, and in-place cell style overrides with automated formula recomputation. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Dimension Style Independent Arrowheads (`DIMBLK1`/`DIMBLK2`):** Supported independent arrowhead styles for start and end leaders with real-time preview rendering and style synchronization. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**GPU Platform Routing & Hardware Info:** Added hardware-aware GPU backend routing (Metal on macOS, automated OpenGL fallback for legacy hardware), hardware information in About dialog, and dedicated Graphics options tab. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Sheet Set Manager Palette & Wizard:** Added Sheet Set Manager palette, `.dst` file reload, import sheet statuses, view categories, and Place-on-Sheet actions. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Count Palette & Table Generator:** Added interactive block counting, invalid area inspection dialog, and live count table generation with field references. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Quick Searchable Layer Palette:** Added fast search and filter command for drawing layers. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Associative Sweep:** Supported surface sweep associativity within the drawing dependency network, honoring custom path alignment and miter corners. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**B-rep Mass Properties & Kernel Operations:** Added `MASSPROP` mass evaluation from solid B-rep, curved `OFFSET`/`FILLET`, and sphere-cylinder boolean operations. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**UCS Face Alignment:** Aligned UCS Face origin and axes to the nearest vertex and edge with solid face raycasting. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**RTL Text Layout:** Added right-to-left word layout, leading space preservation, and mixed-font character advances. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Table Cell Overrides & Formulas:** Supported per-cell style overrides from either layout and automatic formula recomputation after editing. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Rotated & Shaped Text Field Boxes:** Accurate evaluation boxes, per-field shading backgrounds, and `UPDATEFIELD` traversal reaching nested blocks. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**GPU Platform Backends & Hardware Info:** Refined GPU platform selection (Metal on macOS, OpenGL fallback for legacy hardware), hardware info in About dialog, and dedicated Graphics options tab. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**ViewCube UCS Cache:** Cached UCS picker names behind an epoch to accelerate ViewCube orientation refreshes. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Global Interface Scaling:** Added window-wide interface scale setting in Options. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Pickbox-Only Cursor:** Cursor displays pickbox alone when drafting commands prompt for object selection. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Commandline History Retention:** Set `fade time = 0` to keep command-line history permanently visible without fading. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Touchpad Pan:** Optional touchpad panning for wheel-scrolling touchpads. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Expanded Ribbon Layer Display:** Ribbon layer dropdown displays full-length layer names. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**MCP Unchanged Diff Capture Payloads:** Omitted image base64 payloads on visual diff captures when the canvas has no dirty visual changes. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Spatial Index & Navigation Benchmarks:** Added formal QuadTree spatial index construction and viewport navigation benchmarks. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Selection State Refactor:** Decomposed monolithic 31-field `SelectionState` into five modular sub-structs. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**MCP Window & Crossing Selection:** Added window and crossing box selection tools in MCP server. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Lao Localization:** Added full Lao (`lo-LA`) language translation and web font rendering. *(Contributed by [@bounkirdni-2025](https://github.com/bounkirdni-2025))*

**Dimension Style Per-End Arrowheads:** Stopped `dimblk1` pick from clobbering `dimblk2` and ensured preview dialog respects independent per-end arrowheads (`50e20a91`, `29392de2`). *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**DimStyle Text Style Sync:** Propagated text style renames automatically into DimStyle `DIMTXSTY`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**MLeader Attachment:** Fixed text left of multileader landing to correctly attach via its right edge. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Layer Message & State Integrity:** Keyed layer messages, renames, and picker states by immutable layer names instead of row indices. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Layer Transparency Undo:** Added missing undo steps for layer transparency changes. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Shared Linetypes Memory Optimization:** Shared linetype table rows via `Arc` instead of per-row cloning. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Table and Multiline Buffer Reload:** Reloaded Table and MLine rendering buffers upon structural changes and validated cell text styles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Ribbon TableStyle Pick:** Ensured picking table styles in the ribbon writes headers so subsequent inserts inherit the style. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**XREF Row Identity & Empty State:** Carried stable row identity in XREF messages, themed empty states, and clarified silent annotative scale toggles. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Hidden Layer Interaction:** Prevented accidental cursor selection and interaction on hidden layers. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**Behind-Eye Axis Guard:** Protected `draw_axes` against divide-by-zero behind-the-eye camera projection crashes. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Spatial Index Normalization:** Normalized inverted axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABB) in the QuadTree spatial index. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Idle Redraw Suppression:** Eliminated unnecessary redraw loops when drawing documents lack underlay geometry. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Viewport Statusbar Synchronization:** Synchronized scale pill number, label, and badge strictly to the active viewport. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Properties Palette Asymmetric Scale:** Scoped asymmetric scale opt-outs per document tab. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Circle & Arc Patterned Linetypes:** Correctly preserved patterned linetypes on circles and arc segments. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**CTB Layout Block Colors:** Preserved CTB block ACI colors and layout plot settings during plotting. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**Command Previews Over Wipeouts:** Ensured active command previews draw above background wipeout masks. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**Perpendicular Tracking Distance:** Preserved perpendicular polar tracking after entering typed direct distance values. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*
**Paste into Block Editor:** Fixed pasted entities to land directly inside the active Block Editor context. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Feet-Inch Dynamic Input & Stretch:** Fixed feet/inch notation parsing in dynamic input and preserved preselected entities in `STRETCH`. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Script Blank Line Repeat:** Blank lines in script files now repeat the last command when outside an active command prompt. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**`ZOOMFACTOR` Maximum:** Allowed `SETVAR ZOOMFACTOR` to accept values up to 500. *(Contributed by [@F4brizi](https://github.com/F4brizi))*
**Purge Hang on Unnamed Styles:** Fixed `PURGE ALL` hanging on unnamed shape styles. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Cross-Platform CI:** Added multi-platform testing on Linux, Windows, and macOS with non-blocking lint checks. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**`FIELD` Evaluation System & Dialog:** Introduced the full `FIELD` command and UI dialog, supporting real-time text/MText field evaluation, table formula integration, block placeholders, attribute fields on insert, and automatic plot-time updates. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Attribute Definition (`ATTDEF`) Parity:** Added the complete `ATTDEF` and `-ATTDEF` dialogs, tag visibility management, entity property grid synchronization, and ribbon block definition integration. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Blocks Palette Overhaul:** Redesigned the Blocks palette with categorized tabs (Current Drawing, Recent, Favorites), insertion scale/rotation options, drag-and-drop canvas insertion, and `-INSERT` CLI parity. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**MCP Multiscale Pyramidal Tiling Protocol (DeepZoom):** Implemented multiscale pyramidal tiling protocol for MCP vision tools (`src/app/control/vision.rs`, `src/mcp.rs`), exposing DeepZoom manifests (`cad://session/{session_id}/pyramid/manifest.json`), on-demand cached multi-resolution PNG/JSON tiles (`tile/{level}/{x}/{y}`), and `tile`/`pyramid_manifest` parameters in `ocs_capture` to allow vision agents to navigate dense drawings without exceeding token limits. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Set-of-Marks (SoM) Visual Grounding & Vision ID Stamp:** Added high-contrast numbered visual ID badge stamping (`draw_som_badge`) on entity centroids in viewport captures, bidirectional entity grounding manifests mapping stamps to handles, layers, types, and world coordinates, regional camera framing, and 2-point raster calibration. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Visual Differential Streaming & Standardized Spatial Metadata:** Added pixel-level visual diff engine (`compute_visual_diff`) with dirty region cropping (`diff_mode: crop`), WCS CRS alignment (`_spatial`), and forward/inverse affine coordinate matrices to dramatically reduce vision token consumption. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Drawing Load Sentinel Recovery:** Materialized missing `BLOCK` and `ENDBLK` sentinel entities on damaged drawings during document load, preventing crashes and corrupt database states. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Underlays & Raster Improvements:** Native support for attaching DWF and DGN underlays (`UNDERLAY`), point cloud attachments (`POINTCLOUD`), image transparency controls, and image frame toggling (`IMAGEFRAME`). *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**PDF TrueType Font Embedding:** Enhanced PDF export to embed subset TrueType fonts directly into PDF output, ensuring crisp vector text rendering without font substitution artifacts. *(Contributed by [@Chrisyeh1983](https://github.com/Chrisyeh1983))*

**MCP Server Lifecycle Hardening:** Enforced accurate time-to-live policies (60 seconds for GUI resources, 1 hour for tools), request cancellation (`tasks/cancel`), and explicit request/document tracking on GUI capture requests. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Signed Offset & Live Drag Preview:** `OFFSET` opens with live interactive geometry preview on preselected objects and supports signed typed distance entries. *(Contributed by [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin))*
**Ribbon Active Command Indicator:** Active drafting commands highlight their corresponding buttons on the ribbon interface. *(Contributed by [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin))*
**Dynamic Input System Variable (`DYNMODE`):** Added the `DYNMODE` system variable and command for granular toggling of dynamic input modes. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Script File Engine (`.scr`):** Supported standard `.scr` CAD scripts across single-line, multi-line, and prefixed command syntax. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Fluid Tangent Snapping:** Supported continuous tangent snaps across circular arcs and ellipses. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Polyline Self-Intersection Trimming:** Added self-intersection snapping and trimming for complex polyline loops. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Exponential Zoom & Tool Cursors:** Added smooth exponential mouse-wheel zoom, contextual navigation cursors, and proper canvas framing in `ZOOM EXTENTS`. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*
**Zoom Factor Range Extension:** Expanded the `ZOOMFACTOR` upper range limit to 500. *(Contributed by [@F4brizi](https://github.com/F4brizi) and [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*

**Multiscale Pyramidal Tiling (DeepZoom):** Implemented multiscale pyramidal tiling protocol (`src/app/control/vision.rs`, `src/mcp.rs`), exposing DeepZoom manifests (`cad://session/{session_id}/pyramid/manifest.json`), on-demand cached multi-resolution PNG/JSON tiles (`tile/{level}/{x}/{y}`), and `tile`/`pyramid_manifest` parameters in `ocs_capture`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Set-of-Marks (SoM) Grounding & Vision ID Stamps:** Stamped high-contrast numbered visual ID badges (`draw_som_badge`) on entity centroids in viewport captures, paired with bidirectional grounding manifests (`annotations` / `visible_entities`) mapping tags to handles, layers, types, and world coordinates. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Visual Differential Streaming & Spatial Metadata:** Standardized WCS spatial metadata under `_spatial` with affine projection matrices and visual differential engine (`compute_visual_diff`) supporting dirty region cropping (`diff_mode: crop`). *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**2-Point Image Calibration & Regional Framing:** Supported regional camera framing (`bounds`) and 2-point raster image calibration in `embed_image` to calculate scale, origin, and world dimensions from pixel-to-world point pairs. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**4-Pillar Auto-Sync & Declarative Op Table:** Implemented 4-pillar auto-sync, dynamic introspection, and declarative MCP request dispatching. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Text Audit, Spell-Check & Replacement:** Added `text_audit` spell-checking with native OS spellcheckers and dry-run replacement simulation, alongside multiline `text_search` and `text_replace`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Lifecycle & Cancellation Management:** Supported `tasks/cancel` cancellation handling, public error codes, and schema-sync opt-out. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Inspector Conformance Probing:** Added Inspector CLI conformance tests and descriptor lifetime tracking for newly created GUI elements. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Desktop Crash Diagnostics:** Added automated desktop crash logging to capture and persist diagnostic trace logs upon unhandled exceptions. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*
**Italian Translation Updates:** Standardized CAD terminology throughout the Italian localization (Join, Plot, Layer, Hatch). *(Contributed by [@abccorsicad](https://github.com/abccorsicad))*

**Hotfix Release Workflow:** Added automated CI support for deploying patch releases (`v<year>.<week>.<patch>`) on top of weekly releases. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**3D Cylinder & Primitive Creation:** Respected typed height inputs during cylinder and basic 3D primitive creation. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Point Snap Node Constraint:** Constrained `POINT` entities to snap exclusively as `Node` object snaps. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Hatch Association on Trim:** Preserved hatch boundary associations when `TRIM` splits a boundary curve into multiple segments. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Polyline Joint Mitering:** Mitered joints accurately on wide polyline band corners. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**3D Solid History Graph:** Removed unnecessary history generation on edge fillets/chamfers of plain solids and corrected undo evaluation graphs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**ACIS Transform Normalization:** Eliminated duplicate transforms on center-framed 3D boxes and wedges following ACIS geometry lifts. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Novel Layer GUI Refresh:** Refreshed ribbon layers and the Layer panel immediately when newly created entities register new layers. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Erased Raster Image Placeholders:** Cleared placeholder bounding text cleanly when a broken raster image reference is deleted. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*
**R14 Layer Plot Flags:** Corrected layer plot flag parsing on legacy R14 drawings. *(Contributed by [@YsDirector](https://github.com/YsDirector))*
**Chinese Font Hinting (KaiU):** Fixed glyph rendering and hinting distortions for KaiU fonts. *(Contributed by [@Chrisyeh1983](https://github.com/Chrisyeh1983))*
**XREF Dimension Anonymous Blocks:** Imported missing anonymous blocks referenced by dimension entities across XREF boundaries. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*

**PDF Export Window Clipping:** Correctly clipped and excluded entities falling outside the designated export window during PDF plot. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Web Build Compilation:** Gated native-only desktop code out of the wasm32 build target. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Save Verification:** Verified baked-view consistency in `save_verified` automation checks. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

changes: **Python Host Model & Plugin Architecture:** Introduced the foundational Python plugin execution model, embedding an isolated Python runtime host with CAD entity data structures, automation APIs, and lifecycle bindings. *(Contributed by [@felixriestra](https://github.com/felixriestra))*

**Block Creation & WBLOCK Dialogs:** Implemented interactive Block Definition dialogs (`BLOCK`/`BMAKE`) with on-screen entity sequencing, base point pickers, unit settings, and the standalone `WBLOCK` dialog for writing blocks to external files. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Command-Line Autocomplete & Architecture Modularization:** Pressing Enter now immediately executes the highlighted autocomplete pre-selection. Completely refactored the 11,500-line monolithic command driver into clean, decoupled domain modules. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Parametric Constraints Parity:** Delivered complete geometric and dimensional constraint toolsets including Linear, Aligned, Angular, Radial, and Diameter constraints, constraint conversion (`DELCONSTRAINT`), and dynamic constraint bar display. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Individual Block Attribute Grips & Tracking:** Added individual grip markers on each block attribute definition and dual-vector intersection locks during object tracking (`OTRACK`). *(Contributed by Claude)*

**Tessellation & Pipeline Performance:** Optimized polyline arc tessellation sampling, bypassed wide fills on thin polylines, memoized constraint glyphs behind epochs, capped selection grips at 4096, and eliminated redundant wire distance calculations. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Boundary Clipping (`XCLIP`):** Implemented the `XCLIP` command, allowing users to define polygonal and rectangular clipping boundaries for external references and block inserts. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Trackpad Navigation Gestures:** Added native trackpad gesture recognition supporting smooth two-finger panning and pinch-to-zoom. *(Contributed by [@swit33](https://github.com/swit33))*

**PDF & XREF Attachment Parity:** Redesigned the PDF and XREF attachment dialogs with live scale/rotation previews, layer visibility overrides, and context ribbon tabs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Block Definition Dialog (`BLOCK`/`BMAKE`):** Added the standard Block Definition dialog with on-screen sequencing, base point coordinate pickers, retain/convert/delete actions, and unit settings. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Write Block Dialog (`WBLOCK`):** Added the `WBLOCK` dialog allowing users to export objects, entire drawings, or existing blocks to separate files. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Individual Block Attribute Grips:** Each visible block attribute now displays its own grip marker for independent position and orientation adjustments. *(Contributed by Claude)*

**Shared Dialog Button & Form Radio Builders:** Migrated dialogs across the application to consistent shared UI builders with theme-aware styling. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Block Window Localization:** Added multi-language localized strings for block creation dialogs and measurement units. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Autocomplete Execution on Enter:** Pressing Enter with an active autocomplete pre-selection now executes the highlighted command instantly. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Dual-Vector OTRACK Intersection Locks:** Visual object tracking draws both projection vectors simultaneously at ray intersections. *(Contributed by Claude)*

**XLINE and RAY Direction Grip Stretch:** Moving the directional pass-through grip on infinite lines and rays now applies stretch semantics rather than displacing the base origin. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Metric Drawing Defaults:** Initialized new drawings using standardized ISO metric template defaults (meters/millimeters) and proper dimension styles. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Page Setup Import (`PSETUPIN`):** Supported importing named page setups across drawings via JSON and drawing database exchanges. *(Contributed by [@lalomalvi](https://github.com/lalomalvi))*
**Raster Image Pixel Dimensions:** Displayed exact pixel width and height metadata for attached raster image references. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Interactive Plugin Previews:** Plugins can now emit transient graphic preview entities during active user interaction steps. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Command Execution from Plugins:** Added `run_command` capability enabling plugins to invoke built-in CAD commands programmatically. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Plugin Layer Property Access:** Exposed granular layer table read and write APIs to plugin scripts. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Repeatable Plugin Commands:** Enabled repeating the last-executed plugin command upon pressing Enter or Space. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*

**Polyline Arc Tessellation Performance:** Optimized polyline arc sampling and eliminated expensive wide fill mesh generation for zero-width/thin polylines. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Analytical Instancing & Wire Partitioning:** Streamlined render environment resolution, skipped wire distance calculations for solid lines, and optimized handle parsing. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Selection Grip Cap & Epoch Memoization:** Capped total displayed selection grips at 4096 and memoized constraint-glyph layout positions behind `constraints_epoch`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Statusbar Epoch Caching:** Cached layout and scale derived properties behind change epochs for smooth frame pacing. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Driver & Kernel Modularization:** Decomposed monolithic 11,500-line command driver into domain modules, extracted reusable clipboard and matchprop kernels, and unified table/block merge copies. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Plan-View Trim Segment Skipping:** Skipped zero plan-view polyline segments in `TRIM` to prevent clipping failures. *(Contributed by Claude)*
**Attribute Filter Refactoring:** Streamlined attribute filter logic in insert entity handlers. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*

allChanges: **Python Host Model & Plugin Architecture:** Introduced the foundational Python plugin execution model, embedding an isolated Python runtime host with CAD entity data structures, automation APIs, and lifecycle bindings. *(Contributed by [@felixriestra](https://github.com/felixriestra))*

**Block Creation & WBLOCK Dialogs:** Implemented interactive Block Definition dialogs (`BLOCK`/`BMAKE`) with on-screen entity sequencing, base point pickers, unit settings, and the standalone `WBLOCK` dialog for writing blocks to external files. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

Completely refactored the 11,500-line monolithic command driver into clean, decoupled domain modules. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Parametric Constraints Parity:** Delivered complete geometric and dimensional constraint toolsets including Linear, Aligned, Angular, Radial, and Diameter constraints, constraint conversion (`DELCONSTRAINT`), and dynamic constraint bar display. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Individual Block Attribute Grips & Tracking:** Added individual grip markers on each block attribute definition and dual-vector intersection locks during object tracking (`OTRACK`). *(Contributed by Claude)*

**Tessellation & Pipeline Performance:** Optimized polyline arc tessellation sampling, bypassed wide fills on thin polylines, memoized constraint glyphs behind epochs, capped selection grips at 4096, and eliminated redundant wire distance calculations. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Boundary Clipping (`XCLIP`):** Implemented the `XCLIP` command, allowing users to define polygonal and rectangular clipping boundaries for external references and block inserts. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Trackpad Navigation Gestures:** Added native trackpad gesture recognition supporting smooth two-finger panning and pinch-to-zoom. *(Contributed by [@swit33](https://github.com/swit33))*

**PDF & XREF Attachment Parity:** Redesigned the PDF and XREF attachment dialogs with live scale/rotation previews, layer visibility overrides, and context ribbon tabs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Block Definition Dialog (`BLOCK`/`BMAKE`):** Added the standard Block Definition dialog with on-screen sequencing, base point coordinate pickers, retain/convert/delete actions, and unit settings. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Write Block Dialog (`WBLOCK`):** Added the `WBLOCK` dialog allowing users to export objects, entire drawings, or existing blocks to separate files. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Individual Block Attribute Grips:** Each visible block attribute now displays its own grip marker for independent position and orientation adjustments. *(Contributed by Claude)*

**Shared Dialog Button & Form Radio Builders:** Migrated dialogs across the application to consistent shared UI builders with theme-aware styling. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Block Window Localization:** Added multi-language localized strings for block creation dialogs and measurement units. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Autocomplete Execution on Enter:** Pressing Enter with an active autocomplete pre-selection now executes the highlighted command instantly. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Dual-Vector OTRACK Intersection Locks:** Visual object tracking draws both projection vectors simultaneously at ray intersections. *(Contributed by Claude)*

**XLINE and RAY Direction Grip Stretch:** Moving the directional pass-through grip on infinite lines and rays now applies stretch semantics rather than displacing the base origin. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Metric Drawing Defaults:** Initialized new drawings using standardized ISO metric template defaults (meters/millimeters) and proper dimension styles. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Page Setup Import (`PSETUPIN`):** Supported importing named page setups across drawings via JSON and drawing database exchanges. *(Contributed by [@lalomalvi](https://github.com/lalomalvi))*
**Raster Image Pixel Dimensions:** Displayed exact pixel width and height metadata for attached raster image references. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Interactive Plugin Previews:** Plugins can now emit transient graphic preview entities during active user interaction steps. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Command Execution from Plugins:** Added `run_command` capability enabling plugins to invoke built-in CAD commands programmatically. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Plugin Layer Property Access:** Exposed granular layer table read and write APIs to plugin scripts. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
**Repeatable Plugin Commands:** Enabled repeating the last-executed plugin command upon pressing Enter or Space. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*

changes: **Geometric Parametric Constraints Engine:** Introduced the 2D geometric constraint engine with full support for Horizontal, Vertical, Perpendicular, Parallel, Tangent, Concentric, Smooth, Symmetric, Equal, and Fixed constraints, accompanied by `AUTOCONSTRAIN` and the interactive `CONSTRAINTBAR`. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**External References (XREF) Manager Overhaul:** Introduced a completely redesigned docked External References palette featuring lexical path handling, stale and orphaned status detection, detach, unload, reload, bind, and path operations, tree and table views, resizable columns, and unified split-button toolbar. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Independent 3D Object Snap System & Performance:** Introduced an independent 3D OSNAP engine supporting 6 distinct modes, coupled with a 22.7x broadphase and tangent gating speedup in cursor snap tracking. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Drafting Settings (`DSETTINGS`) & `ALIASEDIT` Modernization:** Redesigned the `DSETTINGS` dialog with a modern tabbed layout, editable grid/snap spacing, and major grid line intervals, alongside full shortcut-editor parity in `ALIASEDIT`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Polyline Arc & Offset Grip Editing:** Added interactive radius grip editing for LWPOLYLINE arcs and parallel segment offset grips while preserving connected tangent geometry. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Fusion Themes & UCS Face/Object Alignment:** Added high-contrast Fusion Black and Fusion White visual themes, interactive sketch mode, and UCS alignment to solid faces (`UCS FACE`) and planar entities (`UCS OBJECT`). *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*

**Associative Viewport Dimensions:** Enabled associative dimensioning in paper space layout viewports linked dynamically to 3D model space geometry across view rotations and scale adjustments. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin), and [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*

**3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Support:** Added native 6-DOF 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse controller navigation support on Windows for smooth 3D orbiting, panning, and zooming. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Context Menus & Interaction:** Added right-click context menus across entity selections, command states, and paper space layouts. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*

**Geometric Constraints (`GEOMCONSTRAINT`):** Added complete solver integration for Concentric, Smooth, Symmetric, Fixed, and Equal constraints. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Constraint Bar & Value Display:** Interactive on-screen constraint indicator bars with hover markers and visibility controls. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Auto-Constraint Inference:** Implemented `AUTOCONSTRAIN` to automatically infer geometric relationships across drafted geometry. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Docked External References Palette (`XREF`):** Docked panel with tree and list views, resizable columns, live preview on selection, and status detection for loaded, unloaded, stale, and orphaned references. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**XREF Operations & Path Management:** Full lifecycle support for Attach, Detach, Unload, Reload, Bind, and Overlay operations with relative/absolute/no-path actions. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Reference Manager Help Window:** Added integrated Reference Manager documentation and assistance dialog. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Independent 3D OSNAP System:** Added dedicated 3D object-snap engine supporting six modes (Endpoint, Midpoint, Nearest, Intersection, Perpendicular, Center). *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Polyline Arc Radius Grips:** Added interactive mid-arc radius grip editing on 2D lightweight polylines. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*
**Parallel Segment Offset Grips:** Added parallel offset grips to polyline segments while keeping adjacent arc connections intact. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Drafting Settings Dialog (`DSETTINGS`):** Modernized tabbed dialog layout with single tab strip, editable grid X/Y spacing, and major grid line frequency. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Command Alias Editor (`ALIASEDIT`):** Modern shortcut and alias editor with real-time command alias remapping. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Themed Ribbon Color Dropdown:** Implemented themed 5-section ribbon object color dropdown. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Axis-Aligned Snapping:** Added perpendicular axis alignment snapping and reprompting during precision coordinate inputs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Context Menus:** Contextual right-click menus tailored to active selection filters and commands. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*
**Hyperlink Control:** Added clickable hyperlink properties on drawing entities with sanitized external URL routing. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Options Dialog Actions:** Standardized OK, Apply, and Cancel button behaviors in the application Options dialog. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Fusion Themes:** Added Fusion Black and Fusion White visual themes with balanced canvas contrast. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**UCS Face & UCS Object:** Added direct UCS alignment to solid 3D planar faces and 2D entity planes. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**Interactive Sketch Mode:** Added dedicated sketch mode state on active planes. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**Canvas Background Colour Wheel:** Added interactive colour wheel picker for viewport canvas backgrounds. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**OLE2FRAME Image Embed:** Added support for embedded OLE images and picture frames. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
