allChanges: **Geometric Parametric Constraints Engine:** Introduced the 2D geometric constraint engine with full support for Horizontal, Vertical, Perpendicular, Parallel, Tangent, Concentric, Smooth, Symmetric, Equal, and Fixed constraints, accompanied by `AUTOCONSTRAIN` and the interactive `CONSTRAINTBAR`. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**External References (XREF) Manager Overhaul:** Introduced a completely redesigned docked External References palette featuring lexical path handling, stale and orphaned status detection, detach, unload, reload, bind, and path operations, tree and table views, resizable columns, and unified split-button toolbar. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Independent 3D Object Snap System & Performance:** Introduced an independent 3D OSNAP engine supporting 6 distinct modes, coupled with a 22.7x broadphase and tangent gating speedup in cursor snap tracking. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Drafting Settings (`DSETTINGS`) & `ALIASEDIT` Modernization:** Redesigned the `DSETTINGS` dialog with a modern tabbed layout, editable grid/snap spacing, and major grid line intervals, alongside full shortcut-editor parity in `ALIASEDIT`. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Polyline Arc & Offset Grip Editing:** Added interactive radius grip editing for LWPOLYLINE arcs and parallel segment offset grips while preserving connected tangent geometry. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Fusion Themes & UCS Face/Object Alignment:** Added high-contrast Fusion Black and Fusion White visual themes, interactive sketch mode, and UCS alignment to solid faces (`UCS FACE`) and planar entities (`UCS OBJECT`). *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*

**Associative Viewport Dimensions:** Enabled associative dimensioning in paper space layout viewports linked dynamically to 3D model space geometry across view rotations and scale adjustments. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12), [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin), and [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*

**3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Support:** Added native 6-DOF 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse controller navigation support on Windows for smooth 3D orbiting, panning, and zooming. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Context Menus & Interaction:** Added right-click context menus across entity selections, command states, and paper space layouts. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*

**Geometric Constraints (`GEOMCONSTRAINT`):** Added complete solver integration for Concentric, Smooth, Symmetric, Fixed, and Equal constraints. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Constraint Bar & Value Display:** Interactive on-screen constraint indicator bars with hover markers and visibility controls. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Auto-Constraint Inference:** Implemented `AUTOCONSTRAIN` to automatically infer geometric relationships across drafted geometry. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*

**Docked External References Palette (`XREF`):** Docked panel with tree and list views, resizable columns, live preview on selection, and status detection for loaded, unloaded, stale, and orphaned references. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**XREF Operations & Path Management:** Full lifecycle support for Attach, Detach, Unload, Reload, Bind, and Overlay operations with relative/absolute/no-path actions. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Reference Manager Help Window:** Added integrated Reference Manager documentation and assistance dialog. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

**Independent 3D OSNAP System:** Added dedicated 3D object-snap engine supporting six modes (Endpoint, Midpoint, Nearest, Intersection, Perpendicular, Center). *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Polyline Arc Radius Grips:** Added interactive mid-arc radius grip editing on 2D lightweight polylines. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*
**Parallel Segment Offset Grips:** Added parallel offset grips to polyline segments while keeping adjacent arc connections intact. *(Contributed by [@MarcelP102](https://github.com/MarcelP102))*

**Drafting Settings Dialog (`DSETTINGS`):** Modernized tabbed dialog layout with single tab strip, editable grid X/Y spacing, and major grid line frequency. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Command Alias Editor (`ALIASEDIT`):** Modern shortcut and alias editor with real-time command alias remapping. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Themed Ribbon Color Dropdown:** Implemented themed 5-section ribbon object color dropdown. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Axis-Aligned Snapping:** Added perpendicular axis alignment snapping and reprompting during precision coordinate inputs. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Context Menus:** Contextual right-click menus tailored to active selection filters and commands. *(Contributed by [@mechpanos](https://github.com/mechpanos))*
**Hyperlink Control:** Added clickable hyperlink properties on drawing entities with sanitized external URL routing. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81))*
**Options Dialog Actions:** Standardized OK, Apply, and Cancel button behaviors in the application Options dialog. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Fusion Themes:** Added Fusion Black and Fusion White visual themes with balanced canvas contrast. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**UCS Face & UCS Object:** Added direct UCS alignment to solid 3D planar faces and 2D entity planes. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**Interactive Sketch Mode:** Added dedicated sketch mode state on active planes. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**Canvas Background Colour Wheel:** Added interactive colour wheel picker for viewport canvas backgrounds. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**OLE2FRAME Image Embed:** Added support for embedded OLE images and picture frames. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**22.7x Snap Tracking Speedup:** Optimized OSNAP cursor tracking broadphase and tangent gating for dramatic real-time performance. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**GPU Backend Probe & Fallback:** Added hardware capability probing with automated fallback to OpenGL for older graphics hardware. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Spatial Interaction Indexing:** Chunked batch accumulation for spatial `InteractionIndex` build. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Direct Quad-Strip Triangulation:** Fast quad-strip triangulation for wide arc tessellation. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**MRU Inline Icon Cache:** Added MRU cache to `themed_handle` for instantaneous icon resolution. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Layer-Usage Table Rebuild Speedup:** Extracted and optimized layer-usage table regeneration. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Extrude Height Commit on Enter:** Committed typed dynamic input height accurately on Enter during `EXTRUDE`. *(Contributed by [@steveking-gh](https://github.com/steveking-gh))*
**Diameter Dimension Alignment:** Fixed diameter dimension grip placement and text alignment. *(Contributed by [@codallos](https://github.com/codallos))*
**Layer Invalidation on Model Space Import:** Properly triggered layer invalidation when importing model space content. *(Contributed by [@guywydouw](https://github.com/guywydouw))*
**Grid Units & Limits Display:** Honored `GRIDUNIT` X/Y spacing and `LIMITS` display toggle during viewport grid rendering. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Isometric Drafting Isolation:** Kept isometric drafting mode scoped strictly to active sessions. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**ViewCube Oblique Horizon:** Enforced deterministic horizon calculation for oblique viewpoints and generic opposite view transitions. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Block Palette Theme Contrast:** Enforced contrast coverage and theme-aware label colors in the Block Palette. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Command Line Markers & Formatting:** Standardized history markers and bold error highlighting in the command-line console. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*
**Polyline Intersection Snapping:** Resolved snap failure on intersecting polyline arc-line segments. *(Contributed by [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*

**STEP Export with Large Coordinates:** Fixed coordinate precision overflow when exporting geometry positioned far from the world origin to STEP format. *(Contributed by [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*
**OBJ Import Missing Normals:** Correctly computed and synthesized smooth vertex normals when importing OBJ files lacking normal data. *(Contributed by [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*
**Zero-Radius Curves:** Preserved valid zero-radius curve segments without collapsing geometry during entity transformations. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Perspective Clipping:** Fixed depth draw-order clipping artifacts in perspective camera projections. *(Contributed by [@HakanSeven12](https://github.com/HakanSeven12))*
**Hatch Boundary Precision:** Resolved boundary edge gaps in complex associative hatch loops. *(Contributed by [@gianlucafiore](https://github.com/gianlucafiore))*

**Off-World Z Transformations:** Corrected rotate and mirror transformations for linear and aligned dimensions whose plane does not align with the world Z axis. *(Contributed by [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*
**CTB Lineweight Precision:** Fixed lineweight mapping rounding errors when reading CTB plot style tables. *(Contributed by [@kevin9327](https://github.com/kevin9327))*
**Dimension Preview Styling:** Aligned interactive dimension placement previews with the active dimension style parameters. *(Contributed by [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin))*
**Block Text Wipeout Depth:** Prevented block-nested wipeouts from occluding dimension and annotation text. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**Cloud & Shrinking File Resilience:** Prevented crashes when reading locked, shrinking, or cloud-placeholder drawing files. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**Plotstyle Wire-Fill Depth:** Composed PLOTSTYLE wire-fill depth consistently with the wire rendering pipeline. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**Editor Crash Hardening:** Fixed edge-case crashes during editor state transitions and selection clearing. *(Contributed by [@CiberNin](https://github.com/CiberNin))*
**WASM Build Fixes:** Fixed wasm32 compilation errors in web packaging workflows. *(Contributed by [@helenkwok](https://github.com/helenkwok))*
**Nix Flake Support:** Added reproducible Nix flake dev shell and package build definitions. *(Contributed by [@dasmatus](https://github.com/dasmatus))*
**CI Signing Waterfall:** Added robust multi-stage signing waterfall with fallback for forks without secrets. *(Contributed by [@huaninstratech](https://github.com/huaninstratech))*
**Shell Icon Action Removal:** Removed legacy `RefreshShellIcons` `ie4uinit` custom action from Windows WiX installer. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi))*

releases.name: v0.9.8
changes: Expanded dimensioning with complete linear, aligned, angular, radius, diameter, ordinate, geometric tolerance, arc-length, and jogged-radius workflows, including associative updates, grips, properties, layout, rendering, and explode behavior.

Completed editing workflows for single-line text, multiline text, and tables; improved multileader persistence, grips, styles, and annotative scaling, with richer MText columns, masks, and editor controls.

Broadened drawing and modeling workflows for hatches, associative center marks and centerlines, 2D solids, multilines, arcs, circles, points, rectangles, donuts, boundaries, revision clouds, gradients, wipeouts, and freehand sketches.
Introduced new OpenCADStudio branding and a responsive, search-friendly web landing page.
Added kernel-backed exact solid operations and corrected saved solid booleans, selection flows, circle geometry, tangent construction, planar snapping, offset, and break behavior.
Added complete table creation and editing, inherited-property editing, XDATA visibility, wide dropdown controls, and corrected dimension-property routing.
Improved ALIGN and OFFSET interaction and previews, extension/object tracking, wide-polyline fill boundaries, hatch draw order, and grouped draw-order operations.
Improved block insertion, preset attributes, inserted-block zoom extents, paper-space viewport handling, and dimension definition-marker visibility.
Fixed dashed and complex linetype rendering for splines and polylines, aligned model/paper-space scale behavior, and prevented missing-pattern viewport plotting failures.
Added non-printing layer support and layer usage reporting for indexed plot styles; corrected named/indexed plot-style behavior across preview, PDF export, and printing.
Improved hatch stroke weights, wipeout order, text placement, MText masking, multileader persistence, rotated views, sheet viewport detection, and grid/selection rendering performance.
Improved save and recovery behavior, preserved current-layer data, 3D views and thumbnails, and corrected drawing-file persistence across the new annotation entities.
Added the new application logo, updated documentation imagery, Bulgarian documentation, and German localization corrections.
Added a responsive web landing page with improved image sizing and search metadata.
Added `SelectionChangedV4` delivery for V4 plugins, host dependency pinning and compatibility gating, plugin architecture documentation, and the MCP Bridge registry entry.
Fixed plugin runner polling transport desynchronization and shutdown behavior.
Updated codec and geometry-kernel revisions used by the new entity and modeling workflows.
Improved recovery portability on web targets and reduced repeated grid and plugin-selection work.

releases.name: v0.9.7
changes: Complete the freehand SKETCH workflow with line, polyline and spline output, persistent drawing settings, Record/Erase/Connect controls and kernel-backed spline fitting (#837, @ramox81).
Complete wipeout creation and editing, including clipping, grips, frames, draw order and display/plot visibility across reference entities (#838, @ramox81).
Add complete revision-cloud creation and editing, align gradient properties with rendering, and trace exact kernel-backed boundaries (#835, #836, #833, @ramox81).
Expand spline and ellipse editing with corrected Fit/CV semantics, periodic behavior, localized grip menus and complete arc/end-point grips (#824, #815, #813, @ramox81).
Preserve the selected SKETCH object type, increment and tolerance in DWG/DXF data; keep recorded movement endpoints and allow Connect to resume from the last committed stroke (#837, @ramox81).
Keep FLATTEN projections in the geometry kernel, including OCS polylines, planar entities, solids and 3D faces (#777, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Preserve retained geometry through TRIM, give SUBTRACT deterministic operands and use kernel solutions for enclosing tangent-tangent-radius circles (#823, #822, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Preserve unitless block insertion scale and honor polyline OCS across measurement and editing commands (#776, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Measure bulged polyline length and area exactly, correct XLine properties and hide unsafe MLine geometry fields (#808, #806, #807, @ramox81).
Remember polygon side count, keep definition points out of DDPTYPE changes and carry rounded lengths and angles into the next unit (#831, @ramox81; #826, #827, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Keep annotative MTEXT aligned, preserve literal property text and prevent editor arrow keys from walking command history (#778, @gianlucafiore; #825, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Tile oversized raster images without downsampling while preserving correct brightness for images, PDF underlays and OLE content.
Render 3D faces contained in blocks and repair solid Boolean operations in transformed and nested geometry.
Restore viewport grid visibility and retain continuous geometry through rendering and editing updates.
Open properties for the selected printer and verify platform-specific print command construction (#781, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Reduce ribbon layout work by avoiding construction of hidden panel variants.
Add independent display and plot frame controls for images, underlays, wipeouts and clipped references while retaining selectable frame geometry.
Default ZOOM to window mode and clear pending marquee/lasso gestures when another command starts (#780, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Add the Bulgarian interface translation and complete its command/property coverage (#793, @nickypn).
Keep browser recovery timestamps portable and force the compatible WebGL2 renderer where required (#834, @mvanhorn).
Add MTEXT and its nested enums to the V4 plugin type registry, skip incompatible notification targets and bound shared-memory mappings (#819, #803, #795, @schoeller).
Add Snap Store packaging from the shared Linux payload (#586, @Nozzit).
Verify saves through edit leases so the application does not block its own drawing reads on Windows (#794, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Scope the increased Windows stack to debug builds and keep release builds on their normal stack settings (#787, @schoeller).
Align the codec and geometry-kernel revisions for persistent SKETCH settings and kernel-backed freehand curves.

releases.name: v0.9.6
changes: Add persistent, kernel-backed history and grips for parametric 3D primitives, including live height previews and editable creation parameters.
Add multi-region associative hatches with kernel-based clipping, retained boundary links and stable pattern origins.
Introduce a persistent edge-stack dock system with stacked panels, drag-to-reorder previews and responsive rail state.
Land the V4 plugin API and host integration, with compatible messaging fixes, parallel release downloads and cleaner plugin shutdown.
Preserve solid creation history through edits, synchronize render interaction and correct primitive creation, placement and grip behavior.
Allow STRETCH to use multiple selection windows and move coincident grips together (#771, #772, @gianlucafiore).
Protect locked-layer entities during edits and keep layer rename references, caches and current-layer state synchronized (#770, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Respect drawing units in annotation and viewport scales, annotative text and related dimension workflows (#745, #768, @gianlucafiore).

Restore editable dimension styles and properties, stable dimension-text grips, classic leader linkage, Object Scale access and double-click text editing (#740, #741, #752, #755, #756, #759, @gianlucafiore).
Preserve the current layer for hatches and loaded drawings, including mixed-case and renamed layer references (#746, @gianlucafiore).
Reject unsupported native export extensions before writing, preventing mislabeled output files (#711, @DJ8520).
Share viewport render caches, keep solid meshes resident and instance repeated block geometry to reduce rebuild and draw overhead.
Improve solid tessellation, restore surface rendering, correct 3D mesh interaction and retain viewport settings across scene updates.
Improve plot-style editing and Print All actions while making read-only plot and style values selectable (#744, @gianlucafiore).
Preserve web drawing render state and use browser-safe render timing.
Add stacked dock rendering, persistent layout, active and dragging tab states, full-height previews and safer behavior in minimized windows.
Make property and style read-only fields selectable, select editable property values on click and keep the Block Palette state current.
Add seven UI locales and reorganize the translated README guides under the documentation directory.
Add a dedicated Reddit community action to the Start page; native builds link to OCS Web while web builds link to the latest desktop release.
Publish the web build from the custom-domain root and update the native web link to `www.opencadstudio.com`.
Add the V4 plugin API and host integration, preserve V2/V3 messaging compatibility and improve plugin installation and shutdown behavior (#751, @schoeller).
Remove the obsolete `acadifc` dependency and align the codec and geometry-kernel revisions across the workspace.
Repair stale integration tests and clear native, release and web build warnings.

releases.name: v0.9.5
changes: Move curve evaluation, snapping, editing and measurement onto the shared geometry kernel for consistent results across drawing tools.
Build and read 3D solids as kernel-backed analytic bodies, preserving exact geometry through primitives, booleans, transforms, slicing, sections, extrusion and revolution.
Bring solid modeling, solid rendering and exact solid file round-tripping to the web build.
Add complete ZOOM workflows and persistent crosshair, pointer, aperture, snap-angle and isometric drafting controls.
Add internal-point hatch boundary detection for separate and intersecting entities, with more accurate clipping around overlaps, corners and holes (#703, @gianlucafiore).
Keep rational and fit-point splines editable; reversing, trimming and splitting no longer reshape or discard the retained curve.
Improve TRIM and EXTEND for ellipses, splines, rays and infinite lines, and make AREA, DIVIDE, MEASURE, LENGTHEN and path arrays follow true curve geometry.
Add Dynamic Input, typed distance and angle, precision snapping and tracking to 2D grip editing (#729, @gianlucafiore).
Fix active-intersection, perpendicular, extension and object-tracking interactions, and show the active tracking reference in a contextual hint (#712, #714, #717, @gianlucafiore).
Add REDRAW, REDRAWALL, REGEN and REGENALL with R, RA, RE and REA aliases migrated into existing profiles (#734, @KarimJerbi).
Add indexed and true-color picker pages with recent colors while preserving indexed color values (#718, @gianlucafiore).
Improve the plot-style editor with color swatches, readable lineweights, screening controls, immediate updates and direct PLOT access (#733, @gianlucafiore).
Preserve inherited block colors during plotting so the correct plot style is selected (#735, @gianlucafiore).
Restore linetype scaling for lines, arcs and ellipses (#730, @gianlucafiore).
Fix transformed solid placement, missing faces, planar holes, coarse curved surfaces, spatial curves, entity widths and camera instability at large coordinates.
Complete the locale catalogs, including selectable Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Arabic and Japanese translations.
Add Previous, Object, Dynamic, All, Extents All and Scale options to ZOOM, plus persistent wheel controls (#412).
Add crosshair size, pick-box, aperture, color, pointer mode, snap-angle and isometric drafting options (#413).
Keep status-bar menus open while entering them and retain the pointer over disabled rows.
Restore Donate, Send Feedback and OCS Web actions on the Start page (#707).
Make Copy Info use the browser clipboard in the web About dialog (#738).

changes: Function keys no longer cancel the running command — F8 mid-LINE constrains the rest of the line instead of abandoning it (F7, F9, F10 too)

LAYTRANS translates layers onto a set taken from another drawing
Selection modes at "Select objects" — Window, Crossing, Fence, WPolygon, CPolygon, All, Add, Remove — shared with TRIM and EXTEND
One list of visual styles behind every way of choosing one
Docked block palette
Perpendicular object snap tracking (#696, @gianlucafiore)
TCOUNT numbers text instead of prefixing it, with start, increment and Overwrite / Prefix / Suffix (#698, @gianlucafiore)

allChanges: Expanded dimensioning with complete linear, aligned, angular, radius, diameter, ordinate, geometric tolerance, arc-length, and jogged-radius workflows, including associative updates, grips, properties, layout, rendering, and explode behavior.

Improved block insertion, preset attributes, inserted-block zoom extents, paper-space viewport handling, and dimension definition-marker visibility.

Improved hatch stroke weights, wipeout order, text placement, MText masking, multileader persistence, rotated views, sheet viewport detection, and grid/selection rendering performance.
Improved save and recovery behavior, preserved current-layer data, 3D views and thumbnails, and corrected drawing-file persistence across the new annotation entities.
Added the new application logo, updated documentation imagery, Bulgarian documentation, and German localization corrections.
Added a responsive web landing page with improved image sizing and search metadata.
Added `SelectionChangedV4` delivery for V4 plugins, host dependency pinning and compatibility gating, plugin architecture documentation, and the MCP Bridge registry entry.
Fixed plugin runner polling transport desynchronization and shutdown behavior.
Updated codec and geometry-kernel revisions used by the new entity and modeling workflows.
Improved recovery portability on web targets and reduced repeated grid and plugin-selection work.
Complete the freehand SKETCH workflow with line, polyline and spline output, persistent drawing settings, Record/Erase/Connect controls and kernel-backed spline fitting (#837, @ramox81).
Complete wipeout creation and editing, including clipping, grips, frames, draw order and display/plot visibility across reference entities (#838, @ramox81).
Add complete revision-cloud creation and editing, align gradient properties with rendering, and trace exact kernel-backed boundaries (#835, #836, #833, @ramox81).

Keep FLATTEN projections in the geometry kernel, including OCS polylines, planar entities, solids and 3D faces (#777, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Preserve retained geometry through TRIM, give SUBTRACT deterministic operands and use kernel solutions for enclosing tangent-tangent-radius circles (#823, #822, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Preserve unitless block insertion scale and honor polyline OCS across measurement and editing commands (#776, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Measure bulged polyline length and area exactly, correct XLine properties and hide unsafe MLine geometry fields (#808, #806, #807, @ramox81).
Remember polygon side count, keep definition points out of DDPTYPE changes and carry rounded lengths and angles into the next unit (#831, @ramox81; #826, #827, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Keep annotative MTEXT aligned, preserve literal property text and prevent editor arrow keys from walking command history (#778, @gianlucafiore; #825, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Tile oversized raster images without downsampling while preserving correct brightness for images, PDF underlays and OLE content.
Render 3D faces contained in blocks and repair solid Boolean operations in transformed and nested geometry.
Restore viewport grid visibility and retain continuous geometry through rendering and editing updates.
Open properties for the selected printer and verify platform-specific print command construction (#781, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Reduce ribbon layout work by avoiding construction of hidden panel variants.
Add independent display and plot frame controls for images, underlays, wipeouts and clipped references while retaining selectable frame geometry.
Default ZOOM to window mode and clear pending marquee/lasso gestures when another command starts (#780, @NgoQuocViet2001).
Add the Bulgarian interface translation and complete its command/property coverage (#793, @nickypn).
Keep browser recovery timestamps portable and force the compatible WebGL2 renderer where required (#834, @mvanhorn).

Land the V4 plugin API and host integration, with compatible messaging fixes, parallel release downloads and cleaner plugin shutdown.

releases.name: v0.8.9
changes: Add configurable Iced themes with Oxocarbon as the default, semantic interface colours, themed icons, and theme controls in Options.
Add pinned-first GitHub Discussions to the Start page and improve its responsive panel layout.
Add rectangular, polygonal, and object-based MVIEW creation with viewport clipping support.
Add polygonal WIPEOUT creation modes.
Add drag-and-drop document-tab reordering and native context menus.
Add default save-version selection, OFFSET multiple mode, and LIMITS support.
Keep object isolation transient and independent from dynamic-block visibility across entity types.
Guard concurrent drawing saves and preserve existing DXF layout rotation and save formats.
Fix nested block text picking, normal text highlighting, hatch property refresh, and empty-drawing properties.
Keep status-bar pills right-aligned and improve layer, viewport, multileader, and tab behaviour.
Apply active theme text colours throughout dropdowns, managers, Start controls, and ViewCube labels.
Move status-bar popups, context menus, and anchored overlays onto Iced and iced_aw widgets.
Update the AcadIfc revision used by the DWG pipeline.
Simplify root documentation and Start-page presentation.

releases.name: v0.8.8
changes: Standard DWG coverage now reaches the scene end-to-end: extended entities, object data, tables, view symbols, lights, materials, visual styles, dimensions, and viewport data are decoded into editable OpenCADStudio models.
3D solids and meshes gain complete ACIS placement, block-transform, material, colour-fallback, tessellation, and rendering integration.
Start-page workflows, document-cache REPL access, responsive file-opening progress, and the in-app performance console are expanded.
Save As preserves unsupported and newly decoded CAD data instead of producing lossy or recover-only round trips; DBCOLOR and additional legacy DWG/DXF records survive save and reopen.
Web loading uses a dedicated parser worker and paper-space rendering no longer produces stale, enlarged, or misplaced overlays.

Large-coordinate leaders and complex linetypes retain precision; annotative scales, model-space linetype scaling, inserted wipeouts, XREF layer-zero colours, viewport stretching, and SHX plotting render correctly.
Camera near/far planes update during orbit, renderer capability selection falls back automatically, and oversized 3D edge buffers split safely.
Entity edits, history, undo, redo, resident geometry, and interaction indexes update incrementally, removing large-drawing stalls during add, delete, modify, and grip operations.
File opening and expensive scene work move off the UI thread; initial hover and paper/model navigation stay responsive.
Repeated block meshes share GPU geometry, changed mesh chunks patch in place, and large mesh batches use chunk culling plus indirect draws.
Pin the current acadrust DWG pipeline and round-trip fixes.
Remove the temporary vendored web renderer.
Add document-cache REPL handling from @schoeller in #472.

releases.name: v0.8.7
changes: SHX fonts render for real: text styles and complex linetypes now draw their actual compiled SHX glyphs and shapes, and standalone SHAPE entities render from their shape file.
PDF underlays render end-to-end — attach a PDF and trace over it.
Text gets true top-to-bottom column layout with shared, flow-aware width grips.
TRIM / EXTEND gain full options: edges, fence, crossing, edge mode, and erase (#336).
PEDIT: convert-to-polyline prompt, join, and fit / spline / decurve, plus join fixes (#263).
MATCHPROP now copies every style-affecting property (#281).
Drag & drop drawing files straight onto the window to open them (#344).
Selection: PICKADD / PICKDRAG command-line toggles (#226).
XCLIP boundary frame draws when XCLIPFRAME is on.
PLINE: an Undo option removes the last segment mid-command (#352).
Properties: editable block Name row and collapsible XYZ groups.
File thumbnails are framed on-screen and stored as compact PNG / RLE8 previews, shrinking file size.
Web: copy / paste inside text fields via the browser clipboard (#346).
Copying a group keeps the copy grouped — through the COPY command, ARRAY, and clipboard paste, across drawings too (#440); hovering an arc now preselects its polyline (#444).
DXF load: grid and building axis lines no longer vanish from a misread "layer off" flag (#314), multileaders are no longer invisible, and R2018 MTEXT sits in the right place (#345).
MLEADER honours its baked context — anchors, rotation, dogleg, and frames.
Dimensions: baked *D fills render inside block dimensions.
Leaders: DWG leaders derive their hookline, sized from the dimension style.
Hatch: radial gradient stops run outside-in; a finite GPU sentinel stops boundary bleed on some drivers (#386, #416).
MLINE geometry is driven from the stored vertex parameters; SPLINE honours end tangents on two-fit-point splines (#332 undo, grip-drag history).
Solids: SAB Position tokens place the body correctly; display-cache wires are skipped when ACIS parses.
CIRCLE TTT works with concentric circles (#318); Convert-to-Arc follows the cursor and seats on click (#339); EXTRIM handles polyline cutting boundaries and targets (#340).
Rasters are no longer darkened; the X marker is reserved for broken references. Wipeout frames draw above the mask.
PURGE drops orphaned and anonymous blocks and stale draw-order records; Save-As defaults to the drawing's own format version.
Broader format support via acadrust: R14 solids and xclip, R14 gradient recovery, R13/R14 dimstyles, down-saved gradient hatches, and a SAT edge-parameter fix.
Large files are lighter: mesh-import wire sets cut ~35% (#358), the memoized wire set is shared by Arc instead of deep-copied, and per-vertex snap tables are skipped above 50k vertices.

releases.name: v0.8.6
changes: Dynamic input finally locks: type an angle and TAB — the rubber-band pins to that direction while you pick the length (and vice versa); the locked value constrains the preview, the click and the Enter commit identically (#356).

STRETCH in one round: with nothing pre-selected, the crossing window itself selects the objects — window, base, destination, done (#338). Dimensions stretch too: definition points inside the window move and the measurement updates (#372).

PURGE removes nested leftovers in one run (a purged block's now-unused sub-blocks, layers, linetypes and styles go with it), prompts with category options, and a single UNDO restores everything (#375).
MATCHPROP keeps painting: apply the source properties to target after target until Enter/Escape (#362).
Layer search: live filter boxes in both the ribbon layer dropdown and the Layer Manager (#343); the Layer Manager's Name column is drag-resizable for long layer names (#359).
Bare ZOOM prompts with Window / Extents / All / In / Out / Scale as clickable options.
Command line: a `>` toggle button makes literal-space mode persistent — Space stays in the line until you switch it off; the state survives restarts.
Every modal dialog now shows its name, centred in the title bar.
EXTEND lengthens arcs along their circle to the nearest boundary.
OFFSET works distance-first with a repeat loop and starts from pre-selected objects.
Gradient hatches: selectable gradient types with working creation; pattern-scale edits apply and background fill toggles (hatch editor).
Web: renderer errors surface in a copyable on-page banner (#414).
Web on Windows Chrome/Edge rendered nothing: the hatch and wipeout shaders called dpdx outside uniform control flow, which Tint rejects — both now compute derivatives up front (#414).
All text vanished inside paper-space viewports: the SDF glyph cache handed one wire source's text to another; reuse is now keyed per source (#403).
A reopened file's dimensions ignored grip drags: edits now drop the stale baked *D block so the live geometry renders and the next save re-bakes (#398).
TRIM/EXTEND missed arc-arc intersections — they were tested against the wrong circle's span (#370).

ZOOM Extents fits the whole window at the real viewport aspect instead of a small centre patch (#364); window-corner picks (ZOOM WINDOW, PLOTWINDOW, rectangular WIPEOUT) are exempt from Ortho/Polar so the rectangle can't collapse to a line (#363).

Ribbon buttons no longer stay blue after use: one-shots clear immediately, dialog openers clear when their dialog closes, state toggles light from state alone — and on the Start tab, unusable tools render dimmed (#355).
Files saved without the built-in Standard styles re-seed them on open, so style dropdowns can't come up broken (#366).
The running object-snap set persists in the app config — modern DWG has no file slot for it, and opening a file no longer wipes your snaps.
Mirrored (OCS) entities: LINE/POINT endpoints and the remaining per-entity gaps handle extrusion normals correctly.
Saving a freshly created empty drawing produced a DWG other applications refused: dangling owned handles are no longer written (#410).
Xrefs: merged xref layers appear in the Layer Manager at attach time (#407), and blocks respect their internal draw order.
Spline-fit 2D polylines draw the fitted curve instead of the control frame.
Ribbon tooltips show again; web builds pack wire attributes under the 16-attribute cap.
Dynamic input: an explicit minus keeps its sign in the angle field.
REFEDIT: objects created during the session join the block; BEDIT restores the view on exit; the layout context menu opens at the clicked tab.
acadrust bumped: the DXF writer emits $OSMODE and $LWDISPLAY, six boolean header variables on group code 290 parse correctly, and a poisoned model/paper-space handle gets a fresh one on read.

releases.name: v0.8.5
changes: OLE objects finally show their content: the embedded compound file is parsed properly and EMF/WMF presentation pictures (Excel/Word previews, scanned metafile pages) are rasterized — text drawn through the system-font pipeline — where previously only the rare bitmap-carrying OLE rendered and the rest were empty frames.

Click anywhere inside to select: images, OLE frames, wipeouts, underlays, paper-space viewports and drawing-view borders now select from their interior, not just their outline. Content drawn inside a viewport still wins the click, and the layout's invisible sheet viewport never swallows it.
File dialogs reopen in the last-used directory, persisted across sessions.

Wide polylines (LWPOLYLINE and 2D POLYLINE) render as true width bands through the wire shader — zoom-accurate, linetype-dashed, with smooth per-segment taper for varying widths — inside block instances too; PDF export strokes the band at its world width, and a wide polyline with thickness extrudes as a solid tube.
Section marks on model-documentation layouts render from their decoded style and view graph.
Dynamic text fields evaluate at render time; nonprint light / camera / geo-location glyphs are drawn.
MTEXT editing moved into the shared modal with resizable dialogs.

Start page: the two baked-in intro cards are replaced by a Tutorials rail listing the official YouTube playlist — fetched at boot, thumbnails cached under the config directory, nothing bundled in the binary.

Hatches whose boundary edges arrive reversed or out of order (common in associative hatches) are reassembled tip-to-tail, ending the self-crossing "bowtie" fills that painted the wrong region — including pattern hatches inside blocks.
Lineweight and width bands get round joints and end caps, closing the wedge gaps that opened at corners and along arcs.
Esc fully cancels a box selection: the marquee no longer springs back after a middle-button pan.
The Start page opens immediately — recent-file DWG thumbnails decode on a background thread instead of holding up the first frame.

Paper space: inch-unit sheets are sized in their own units, and the unit is derived from the plot scale instead of a limits heuristic; non-rectangular viewports clip to their true boundary shape; per-viewport layer freeze hides fills, images and meshes too; model-documentation drawing views are framed correctly.
A blank INSERT attribute renders nothing instead of a "[]" placeholder.
MTEXT: italic font flag and non-breaking spaces render; imported text shows at its correct size in the editor (#394); the empty-line caret slot is sized to the text.
Cone silhouettes use the base radius; wireframe mode hides subdivision-mesh face fills; thickness edits persist.

acadrust bumped: OLE presentation extraction (compound file, WMFC→EMF reassembly) moved into the library; large OLE blobs are no longer truncated at 10 MB; SectionSymbol and ViewBorder are first-class entities; out-of-range ACI values are rejected.

releases.name: v0.8.4
changes: Multi-column MTEXT lays out into its columns (`\N` breaks), and stacked fractions (`\S`) render as numerator over denominator.
MTEXT paragraph alignment: justified and distributed paragraphs fill the line width — justify spreads the word gaps and leaves the last line ragged; distribute spreads every glyph gap on every line.
MTEXT tab stops: center, right and decimal (dot-aligned) tab stops now align the field that follows a tab, so a column of numbers lines up on the decimal point.
MTEXT paragraph spacing: space-before / space-after between paragraphs and per-paragraph line spacing are honoured.
3D (ACIS) solids show far more of their surface: ISOLINES and view-dependent silhouettes (DISPSILH) on curved faces, spline (intcurve) edges, and the ring outlines of torus faces.
Custom (proxy) entities draw their saved graphics — lines, arcs, polygons, meshes and a text preview — with their colours and line weights.
Raster images: a remote (http/https) image reference is fetched and shown, and clipped to its boundary.
OLE objects render their embedded presentation bitmap.

MTEXT parser conformance (via acadrust): a raw line feed is a hard paragraph break, other control characters render as a space, the inline `\c` true-colour value is no longer red/blue swapped, an out-of-range `\C` colour is ignored, and the `\pqd` (distribute) and `\pq*` (justify) paragraph-alignment codes are parsed.

MTEXT vertical layout: a blank line takes the height of the text around it instead of the full entity height, so a small-text column no longer stretches down the page; heading placement and paragraph spacing corrected.
MTEXT tab stops are measured relative to their own column, so a second column's tabs no longer shoot off the page; the field after an aligning tab isn't wrapped by its full width.
MTEXT editor keeps UTM-scale text sharp and preserves columns through an edit; the `0x02` background-fill flag is treated as a mask.
Point entities: PDMODE marker glyphs.
Block attributes: constant attributes render, and multiline and invisible attributes are decoded.
2D SOLIDs are filled (block-nested ones are no longer hollow) and 2D overlay fills show in every view mode.
Dimensions no longer draw their Defpoints markers.
Tables: a baked table block sits at the table's insertion point.
Splines: fit-point splines interpolate with end tangents, and grips fall back to the fit points.
Curved 3D solids: torus faces are trimmed to their revolution arc, and shaded ACIS faces stay precise at UTM-scale coordinates.
Picking catches a wide polyline anywhere on its band, not just on its centreline.
acadrust bumped repeatedly for the MTEXT parser and entity-decoder fixes above.

releases.name: v0.8.3
changes: Open a drawing in the already-running editor: double-clicking a file, or opening one from the OS, now switches to it if it is already open and otherwise loads it into the running instance as a new tab, instead of launching a second copy of the application.
`EXPORTPDF <path>` (and `EXPORT <path>`) export straight to a file with no save dialog — both a scriptable entry point and the workaround for systems where the native save dialog cannot open (#369).

Text and dimensions appear in PDF and print export again: text became SDF-only and the CPU exporter dropped every glyph, so dimension text and standalone TEXT/MTEXT were missing from exported PDFs; the exporter now reconstructs the glyphs as vector strokes and fills (#385).

PDF and print export no longer distort drawings at UTM-scale coordinates — geometry, hatch fills and text are kept at full precision until the page offset cancels them, instead of being snapped to a coarse grid; text in a paper-space viewport is projected onto the sheet at its correct position.
PDF export never fails silently: when the save dialog cannot open (for example a missing or broken desktop portal on Linux) the command now reports it and points at `EXPORTPDF <path>` (#369).
MATCHPROP now copies the text style and height between TEXT and MTEXT objects, so matching one text object to another actually changes it (#361).
Updating a plugin from the Plugin Manager works even when the current version is loaded: the resident library is moved aside rather than failing to overwrite a locked binary (#391).
The welcome page's own buttons (About, Donate, Send Feedback, …) work again (#388, #389).
MTEXT: a top-aligned line is anchored by the ink it actually draws.
SOLID fills stay in place on UTM-scale drawings.
Tolerance: the feature control frame is drawn correctly.
Geometry far off the drawing plane is shown instead of being clipped away.

Editing touches only the entities that changed: a delta journal, an incremental spatial index and a per-edit splice of the resident wire set replace the whole-document rebuild, and move / edit patches the GPU wire buffer in place — large drawings stay responsive during edits and undo.
Undo records per-entity deltas instead of cloning the entire document.
acadrust now builds from the OpenAEC-Foundation/acadifc fork.

releases.name: v0.8.2
changes: Block editor: selecting a block and running BEDIT — by command, ribbon button, or double-clicking the block — opens a block-editor space tab named after the block, alongside Model and the layouts. It draws only that block's own entities in block-local coordinates; edits are live on the definition, so every INSERT updates. Save Block / Discard finish the session, and renaming the tab renames the block (#261).
Hatches now render on the web (WebGL2) build through a texture-backed per-hatch renderer, so web hatch fills draw instead of the command appearing to cancel (#204).

Annotative objects now carry real per-scale representations — a synthesized extension-dictionary chain that interoperates with other CAD apps — rather than just a native flag; the editable Annotative toggle covers Text and block references as well as MText and MLeader, and a new OBJECTSCALE dialog adds and removes an object's annotation scales.
The dimension-line colour is editable for Leaders and Dimensions, stored as a standard per-object dimension-style override so it round-trips through both DWG and DXF.
Dimensions: architectural and fractional units carry a rounded fraction up into inches and feet, so an exact three-foot object reads 3'-0" instead of 2'-11 1" (#380).
Hatch: picking selects the innermost boundary and detects nested holes; only direct children become holes, and only the outer ring is flagged external on save (#374).
Linetype: A-type dashed lines align their endpoints so a dash lands exactly at each end.
Paper space: a reused viewport GPU slot resets so the surviving viewport keeps its content.
Foreign DWGs: the root named-objects dictionary is resolved robustly when its header pointer is unreliable.
Save As: the version-picker dialog button is now labeled "Save as...".

Model, paper and block-editor spaces now share one resident wire path with no per-viewport cull or LOD: paper pan and zoom do no re-tessellation and reuse the idle single-blit cache, matching Model-space smoothness.
The resident wire GPU buffer is shared across viewport slots and panes by content id, so several viewports — or Model tiles — of the same drawing upload its geometry only once.

Bumped acadrust: read the DXF dimension block name (group code 2) so DXF dimension text matches DWG, and default the MTEXT and MULTILEADER annotative flags to false so DXF-imported text and leaders are no longer over-scaled.

releases.name: v0.8.1
changes: Annotative scaling: annotative objects (text, dimensions, tables, blocks) scale to the drawing's current annotation scale, and the Properties panel shows the Annotative state and the applied scale.

Annotation scales are editable: add and remove a drawing's scales, set the current one, and manage the whole list in a dedicated scale-manager window; MText and MLeader gain an editable Annotative toggle.

Properties panels for Text / MText / MLeader / Leader reworked to a consistent layout, with many previously read-only fields now editable: Hyperlink, MText columns, per-object leader dimension overrides, and style / material / plot-style / arrowhead / linetype pickers.
MText: structured editor with text selection, copy and visible bold; preview glyphs render and Enter inserts a line break.
A drawing reopens in the space (Model or the exact paper tab) it was saved in.
Save As uses the native OS file dialog, keeping the in-app format/version picker.
ATTMAN and BATTMAN open the attribute editor; HELP opens GitHub Discussions.

Scale manager: rename and paper:drawing edits now persist, including on drawings saved by other programs (the scale list is located robustly and scales are matched by name rather than an internal dictionary key); rename a scale inline by double-clicking it.
MLeader: straight leaders with a real landing and connection-anchored text (#347).
Text: the SDF glyph atlas grows instead of dropping glyphs when it fills (#347).
Precision: typed coordinates, hatch boundaries, block base points and TEXT/MTEXT insertion points are kept exact in f64 (#311).
Ribbon: toggle buttons highlight by their actual state, and command icons are inert on the Start page.
The View Cube clears when toggled off; BATTMAN works instead of erroring (#295).
Bumped acadrust: write entity XDATA to DXF, read model-space CANNOSCALE from DWG, and fix MLeader/WIPEOUT preview parsing (#347).
Removed orphaned dead code.

releases.name: v0.8.0
changes: DWG file thumbnails on Linux, Windows and macOS: a raster preview is embedded in the DWG's preview slot on save, so drawings show their contents in the file manager (Nautilus / Explorer / Finder) and on the Start page recent list. Ships a lean `dwg-thumbnailer` extractor, a Windows `IThumbnailProvider` COM handler and a macOS QuickLook extension, self-installed on startup, plus themed DWG/DXF file icons for previewless files.
Command aliases are centralized in a user-editable `ocad.pgp` file (#286/#288).
Adaptive ribbon: tabs fit and panels collapse to dropdowns as the window narrows.
Status bar honors `$COORDS` in the coordinate readout (click to cycle) and hides niche pills by default (opt-in).
Ortho, running OSNAP and Isolate persist per-drawing.
The ViewCube, then the render bar, hide as the viewport narrows.
Hatch: anchor the prebaked pattern origin near the geometry so fills no longer distort at large (UTM) coordinates.
OFFSET works on XLINE, Ellipse and Spline objects (#296).
STRETCH: crossing-window corners are freed from Ortho, with a filled marquee (#291).
Intersection snap requires a real 3D meeting rather than a plan-view crossing (#335); arcs no longer emit a spurious extension guide at line intersections.
Clipboard paste anchors at the bounding-box lower-left instead of the center (#285).
Text shows in command previews (move / copy / …) and no longer vanishes during a grip-drag (#316).
Web: keep the wasm `target_features` section so `wasm-opt` accepts bulk-memory.
Settings consolidated into one grouped `settings.json`; Ortho/OSNAP dropped from `settings.txt` (now per-drawing).
Bumped acadrust for the `*Model_Space` block-record fix.

allChanges: Add configurable Iced themes with Oxocarbon as the default, semantic interface colours, themed icons, and theme controls in Options.
Add pinned-first GitHub Discussions to the Start page and improve its responsive panel layout.
Add rectangular, polygonal, and object-based MVIEW creation with viewport clipping support.
Add polygonal WIPEOUT creation modes.
Add drag-and-drop document-tab reordering and native context menus.
Add default save-version selection, OFFSET multiple mode, and LIMITS support.
Keep object isolation transient and independent from dynamic-block visibility across entity types.
Guard concurrent drawing saves and preserve existing DXF layout rotation and save formats.
Fix nested block text picking, normal text highlighting, hatch property refresh, and empty-drawing properties.
Keep status-bar pills right-aligned and improve layer, viewport, multileader, and tab behaviour.
Apply active theme text colours throughout dropdowns, managers, Start controls, and ViewCube labels.
Move status-bar popups, context menus, and anchored overlays onto Iced and iced_aw widgets.
Update the AcadIfc revision used by the DWG pipeline.
Simplify root documentation and Start-page presentation.

Standard DWG coverage now reaches the scene end-to-end: extended entities, object data, tables, view symbols, lights, materials, visual styles, dimensions, and viewport data are decoded into editable OpenCADStudio models.
3D solids and meshes gain complete ACIS placement, block-transform, material, colour-fallback, tessellation, and rendering integration.
Start-page workflows, document-cache REPL access, responsive file-opening progress, and the in-app performance console are expanded.
Save As preserves unsupported and newly decoded CAD data instead of producing lossy or recover-only round trips; DBCOLOR and additional legacy DWG/DXF records survive save and reopen.
Web loading uses a dedicated parser worker and paper-space rendering no longer produces stale, enlarged, or misplaced overlays.

Large-coordinate leaders and complex linetypes retain precision; annotative scales, model-space linetype scaling, inserted wipeouts, XREF layer-zero colours, viewport stretching, and SHX plotting render correctly.
Camera near/far planes update during orbit, renderer capability selection falls back automatically, and oversized 3D edge buffers split safely.
Entity edits, history, undo, redo, resident geometry, and interaction indexes update incrementally, removing large-drawing stalls during add, delete, modify, and grip operations.
File opening and expensive scene work move off the UI thread; initial hover and paper/model navigation stay responsive.
Repeated block meshes share GPU geometry, changed mesh chunks patch in place, and large mesh batches use chunk culling plus indirect draws.
Pin the current acadrust DWG pipeline and round-trip fixes.
Remove the temporary vendored web renderer.
Add document-cache REPL handling from @schoeller in #472.
SHX fonts render for real: text styles and complex linetypes now draw their actual compiled SHX glyphs and shapes, and standalone SHAPE entities render from their shape file.
PDF underlays render end-to-end — attach a PDF and trace over it.
Text gets true top-to-bottom column layout with shared, flow-aware width grips.
TRIM / EXTEND gain full options: edges, fence, crossing, edge mode, and erase (#336).
PEDIT: convert-to-polyline prompt, join, and fit / spline / decurve, plus join fixes (#263).
MATCHPROP now copies every style-affecting property (#281).
Drag & drop drawing files straight onto the window to open them (#344).
Selection: PICKADD / PICKDRAG command-line toggles (#226).
XCLIP boundary frame draws when XCLIPFRAME is on.
PLINE: an Undo option removes the last segment mid-command (#352).
Properties: editable block Name row and collapsible XYZ groups.
File thumbnails are framed on-screen and stored as compact PNG / RLE8 previews, shrinking file size.
Web: copy / paste inside text fields via the browser clipboard (#346).
Copying a group keeps the copy grouped — through the COPY command, ARRAY, and clipboard paste, across drawings too (#440); hovering an arc now preselects its polyline (#444).
DXF load: grid and building axis lines no longer vanish from a misread "layer off" flag (#314), multileaders are no longer invisible, and R2018 MTEXT sits in the right place (#345).
MLEADER honours its baked context — anchors, rotation, dogleg, and frames.
Dimensions: baked *D fills render inside block dimensions.
Leaders: DWG leaders derive their hookline, sized from the dimension style.
Hatch: radial gradient stops run outside-in; a finite GPU sentinel stops boundary bleed on some drivers (#386, #416).
MLINE geometry is driven from the stored vertex parameters; SPLINE honours end tangents on two-fit-point splines (#332 undo, grip-drag history).
Solids: SAB Position tokens place the body correctly; display-cache wires are skipped when ACIS parses.
CIRCLE TTT works with concentric circles (#318); Convert-to-Arc follows the cursor and seats on click (#339); EXTRIM handles polyline cutting boundaries and targets (#340).
Rasters are no longer darkened; the X marker is reserved for broken references. Wipeout frames draw above the mask.
PURGE drops orphaned and anonymous blocks and stale draw-order records; Save-As defaults to the drawing's own format version.
Broader format support via acadrust: R14 solids and xclip, R14 gradient recovery, R13/R14 dimstyles, down-saved gradient hatches, and a SAT edge-parameter fix.
Large files are lighter: mesh-import wire sets cut ~35% (#358), the memoized wire set is shared by Arc instead of deep-copied, and per-vertex snap tables are skipped above 50k vertices.

Dynamic input finally locks: type an angle and TAB — the rubber-band pins to that direction while you pick the length (and vice versa); the locked value constrains the preview, the click and the Enter commit identically (#356).

STRETCH in one round: with nothing pre-selected, the crossing window itself selects the objects — window, base, destination, done (#338). Dimensions stretch too: definition points inside the window move and the measurement updates (#372).

PURGE removes nested leftovers in one run (a purged block's now-unused sub-blocks, layers, linetypes and styles go with it), prompts with category options, and a single UNDO restores everything (#375).
MATCHPROP keeps painting: apply the source properties to target after target until Enter/Escape (#362).
Layer search: live filter boxes in both the ribbon layer dropdown and the Layer Manager (#343); the Layer Manager's Name column is drag-resizable for long layer names (#359).
Bare ZOOM prompts with Window / Extents / All / In / Out / Scale as clickable options.
Command line: a `>` toggle button makes literal-space mode persistent — Space stays in the line until you switch it off; the state survives restarts.
Every modal dialog now shows its name, centred in the title bar.
EXTEND lengthens arcs along their circle to the nearest boundary.
OFFSET works distance-first with a repeat loop and starts from pre-selected objects.
Gradient hatches: selectable gradient types with working creation; pattern-scale edits apply and background fill toggles (hatch editor).
Web: renderer errors surface in a copyable on-page banner (#414).
Web on Windows Chrome/Edge rendered nothing: the hatch and wipeout shaders called dpdx outside uniform control flow, which Tint rejects — both now compute derivatives up front (#414).
All text vanished inside paper-space viewports: the SDF glyph cache handed one wire source's text to another; reuse is now keyed per source (#403).
A reopened file's dimensions ignored grip drags: edits now drop the stale baked *D block so the live geometry renders and the next save re-bakes (#398).
TRIM/EXTEND missed arc-arc intersections — they were tested against the wrong circle's span (#370).

ZOOM Extents fits the whole window at the real viewport aspect instead of a small centre patch (#364); window-corner picks (ZOOM WINDOW, PLOTWINDOW, rectangular WIPEOUT) are exempt from Ortho/Polar so the rectangle can't collapse to a line (#363).

Ribbon buttons no longer stay blue after use: one-shots clear immediately, dialog openers clear when their dialog closes, state toggles light from state alone — and on the Start tab, unusable tools render dimmed (#355).
Files saved without the built-in Standard styles re-seed them on open, so style dropdowns can't come up broken (#366).
The running object-snap set persists in the app config — modern DWG has no file slot for it, and opening a file no longer wipes your snaps.
Mirrored (OCS) entities: LINE/POINT endpoints and the remaining per-entity gaps handle extrusion normals correctly.
Saving a freshly created empty drawing produced a DWG other applications refused: dangling owned handles are no longer written (#410).
Xrefs: merged xref layers appear in the Layer Manager at attach time (#407), and blocks respect their internal draw order.
Spline-fit 2D polylines draw the fitted curve instead of the control frame.
Ribbon tooltips show again; web builds pack wire attributes under the 16-attribute cap.
Dynamic input: an explicit minus keeps its sign in the angle field.
REFEDIT: objects created during the session join the block; BEDIT restores the view on exit; the layout context menu opens at the clicked tab.
acadrust bumped: the DXF writer emits $OSMODE and $LWDISPLAY, six boolean header variables on group code 290 parse correctly, and a poisoned model/paper-space handle gets a fresh one on read.

OLE objects finally show their content: the embedded compound file is parsed properly and EMF/WMF presentation pictures (Excel/Word previews, scanned metafile pages) are rasterized — text drawn through the system-font pipeline — where previously only the rare bitmap-carrying OLE rendered and the rest were empty frames.

Click anywhere inside to select: images, OLE frames, wipeouts, underlays, paper-space viewports and drawing-view borders now select from their interior, not just their outline. Content drawn inside a viewport still wins the click, and the layout's invisible sheet viewport never swallows it.
File dialogs reopen in the last-used directory, persisted across sessions.

Wide polylines (LWPOLYLINE and 2D POLYLINE) render as true width bands through the wire shader — zoom-accurate, linetype-dashed, with smooth per-segment taper for varying widths — inside block instances too; PDF export strokes the band at its world width, and a wide polyline with thickness extrudes as a solid tube.
Section marks on model-documentation layouts render from their decoded style and view graph.
Dynamic text fields evaluate at render time; nonprint light / camera / geo-location glyphs are drawn.
