Save As uses the native OS file dialog, keeping the in-app format/version picker.
ATTMAN and BATTMAN open the attribute editor; HELP opens GitHub Discussions.

Scale manager: rename and paper:drawing edits now persist, including on drawings saved by other programs (the scale list is located robustly and scales are matched by name rather than an internal dictionary key); rename a scale inline by double-clicking it.
MLeader: straight leaders with a real landing and connection-anchored text (#347).
Text: the SDF glyph atlas grows instead of dropping glyphs when it fills (#347).
Precision: typed coordinates, hatch boundaries, block base points and TEXT/MTEXT insertion points are kept exact in f64 (#311).
Ribbon: toggle buttons highlight by their actual state, and command icons are inert on the Start page.
The View Cube clears when toggled off; BATTMAN works instead of erroring (#295).
Bumped acadrust: write entity XDATA to DXF, read model-space CANNOSCALE from DWG, and fix MLeader/WIPEOUT preview parsing (#347).
Removed orphaned dead code.

DWG file thumbnails on Linux, Windows and macOS: a raster preview is embedded in the DWG's preview slot on save, so drawings show their contents in the file manager (Nautilus / Explorer / Finder) and on the Start page recent list. Ships a lean `dwg-thumbnailer` extractor, a Windows `IThumbnailProvider` COM handler and a macOS QuickLook extension, self-installed on startup, plus themed DWG/DXF file icons for previewless files.
Command aliases are centralized in a user-editable `ocad.pgp` file (#286/#288).
Adaptive ribbon: tabs fit and panels collapse to dropdowns as the window narrows.
Status bar honors `$COORDS` in the coordinate readout (click to cycle) and hides niche pills by default (opt-in).
Ortho, running OSNAP and Isolate persist per-drawing.
The ViewCube, then the render bar, hide as the viewport narrows.
Hatch: anchor the prebaked pattern origin near the geometry so fills no longer distort at large (UTM) coordinates.
OFFSET works on XLINE, Ellipse and Spline objects (#296).
STRETCH: crossing-window corners are freed from Ortho, with a filled marquee (#291).
Intersection snap requires a real 3D meeting rather than a plan-view crossing (#335); arcs no longer emit a spurious extension guide at line intersections.
Clipboard paste anchors at the bounding-box lower-left instead of the center (#285).
Text shows in command previews (move / copy / …) and no longer vanishes during a grip-drag (#316).
Web: keep the wasm `target_features` section so `wasm-opt` accepts bulk-memory.
Settings consolidated into one grouped `settings.json`; Ortho/OSNAP dropped from `settings.txt` (now per-drawing).
Bumped acadrust for the `*Model_Space` block-record fix.

releases.name: v0.7.9
changes: **Unified Plot / Print** — plotting and printing merged into one dialog, backed by a page-setup manager (named setups, per-layout defaults, `<none>` / `<previous>`) that replaces the old Page Setup. **QUICKPRINT (QP)** plots a selection's bounding box straight to PDF (#325).
**EXTRIM** — cookie-cutter trim: pick a cutting boundary and a side, and everything crossing it on that side is trimmed in one pass (#253).
**TEXTFILL** — fill or hollow TrueType text glyphs (#260).
**Arc Continue** — the Arc tool keeps drawing arcs, each tangent to the last, until you end the command (#327).
**Polar angle picker** — a dropdown on the POLAR status-bar pill for choosing the tracking angle (#264).
**Faster command entry** — Space submits the command, typed input is uppercased, and a leading `>` escapes literal spaces.

**Curved walls render correctly** — ACIS cone-surface faces no longer balloon into a full cylinder of the surface radius, and short arc faces no longer leave see-through gaps; each face honours its true angular extent.

**SPLINE ends cleanly** — Enter / Esc finishes the spline and returns to the selection state instead of trapping the cursor, and the in-progress preview now traces the real curve rather than the straight control polygon (#282).
**DXF export** — no longer writes a duplicate `*Active` viewport (#319), and DXF hatch pattern definitions parse correctly (#330).
**Responsive snapping on block-heavy drawings** — snap and hover stay fast on drawings with millions of block-exploded segments, narrowing the intersection search to the cursor neighbourhood.
**Smaller downloads** — release binaries are stripped, cutting the download size (#324).

releases.name: v0.7.8
changes: **Arc Continue + 3-Point default** — the Arc tool now defaults to 3-Point, and a new **Continue** method starts an arc tangent to the last line or arc, picking only the end point.

**Editable geometry in the Properties panel** — Circle exposes editable Diameter / Circumference / Area (each drives the radius); the Ellipse panel is reworked (Start / Center / End, Major & Minor radius, ratio, angles); Arc rows are reordered Start → Center → End with read-only normals.

**Editable hatch pattern properties** — Type, Angle, Scale, Spacing and Origin are editable; Origin also has a draggable grip at the hatch centroid. Gradient hatches expose editable Type and Colors, and any hatch can carry an editable **background color**.
**Polyline vertex navigation** — step through a polyline's vertices directly from the Properties panel.
**Object-snap tracking direction** — OTRACK now tracks the direction from the base point to an acquired corner.
**Dimensions survive in-place edits** — a dimension re-bakes its display block after an edit, so moved/edited dimensions keep their geometry (#181).
**Polyline width inside blocks** — width bands render for polylines nested in blocks, and the full width is applied to each side of the centreline (#222).
**Ellipse grip** — dragging the minor-axis grip past the major no longer balloons both axes.
**Hatch fills** — solid/pattern fills render through the per-fragment in_polygon test again.
**Web divider-drag freeze** — grow-only viewport textures stop a Windows/Firefox freeze when dragging the pane divider (#191).

**Responsive large copy / paste and point picking** — snap gates its O(k²) intersection passes, the paste anchor and ghost come from bounding boxes, huge selections get a count-only Properties panel, and paste rebuilds meshes incrementally, so editing very large drawings no longer stalls (#322).
**Incremental wire tessellation** — the resident model wire set re-tessellates only the edited entity instead of the whole drawing.

releases.name: v0.7.7
changes: **Crisp text at every zoom** — all text (single-line TEXT, MTEXT, dimensions, table cells, block text, tolerances, complex-linetype labels and attributes) is now drawn with a signed-distance-field shader, staying sharp at any zoom level and replacing the old stroke renderer.
**MTEXT background fill, mask and frame** — MTEXT can carry an opaque or masked background and a border frame, all editable from the Properties panel.
**Text decorations** — underline, overline and strike-through now render on text.

**Clickable command options** — command-line options appear as buttons next to the prompt, so they need not be typed. Construction commands are now central: `CIRCLE` offers 3P / 2P / Ttr / Ttt / Diameter, `ELLIPSE` offers Arc / Axis, `ARC`, `RECTANGLE` and `POLYGON` likewise, instead of each method being a separate isolated command.
**Plot a model-space window to PDF** — pick a rectangular window in model space and export it straight to PDF.
**About in the Manage ribbon** — the version / About window now has a discoverable button on the Manage tab.
**Ribbon collapse-mode selector and Start-page recent controls** — choose how the ribbon collapses when space runs short, and manage recent files from the Start page.
**Paste keeps dimensions** — pasted dimensions copy correctly instead of losing their geometry.
**Text colour through blocks** — inline `\C` colour codes survive block colour inheritance.
**Text clipped to xclip** — text is clipped to a block's xclip boundary, and a debug-assert crash on block fills is fixed.
**Hatch in PDF / plot output** — hatches render correctly in PDF and plot export.
**ZOOM Extents ignores construction lines** — XLine and Ray display segments no longer blow up ZOOM Extents.
**Flicker-free hatches** — hatch fills are tessellated once, so panning and orbiting no longer flicker.
**Cached text** — text vertices are cached across frames instead of being rebuilt every frame.

releases.name: v0.7.6
changes: **The ribbon, tabs and status bar adapt to narrow windows** — the ribbon top bar, document tabs and status bar now flex-wrap onto extra rows instead of clipping, and the ribbon's tool panels degrade from the right as space runs out: large buttons shrink to compact icon columns, then a panel collapses to a title button that opens the full panel as a flyout.
**Dropdowns and popups open where you expect** — every ribbon dropdown and status-bar popup now opens directly at its button and flips to the other side when it would run off the window edge.
**Redesigned Start page** — Recent Files, Welcome and Supporters sit side by side while they fit, and fall back to a tab bar (Welcome open by default) when the window is too narrow.
**Collapsible properties panel** — on a narrow window the properties panel collapses to a slim vertical bar, freeing width for the drawing; click the bar to expand it.
**Parallel object snap** — snap the next point along a direction parallel to an existing line, with the reference line highlighted.
**Tangent line to two circles** — the LINE tool can draw a line tangent to two circles.
**Select meshes by their faces** — click a mesh's shaded face to pick it, not just its edges.
**Plugin commands in autocomplete** — commands from loaded plugins now show up in command-line autocomplete.
**Tidier layer list** — layers are listed alphabetically and the list scrolls to a newly created layer.

**Object snap tangents and guides** — tangent snaps land on the true tangent point, endpoint snaps no longer fire on closed curves, extension guides no longer stream from circles, and extension tracking points stay put while in use.
**User-defined hatches render** — hatches defined by an angle and spacing now draw instead of coming up empty.
**Concave mesh faces** — non-convex mesh faces are triangulated correctly (ear clipping) instead of spilling stray triangles.
**Picking in tilted 3-D views** — partly off-screen entities stay selectable when the view is tilted.
**Steadier orbit** — orbiting a large drawing no longer jitters at extreme extents.
**Dynamic input second point** — a comma-separated second value is read as a coordinate rather than width/height.
**OSNAP settings popup** — opens anchored to its status-bar button instead of the window corner.
**Faster idle and navigation** — the rendered scene is cached and skipped on unchanged frames, and the hatch pass is skipped while panning/orbiting.
**Faster picking and snapping** — model-space pick/snap reuses the static wire set instead of re-tessellating each gesture.
**Faster xref-heavy files** — referenced drawings parse in parallel, an O(n²) data-store parse is fixed, and ACIS record lookup is O(1).

releases.name: v0.7.5
changes: **Real edges on solids and meshes** — 3-D solids now draw their surface (B-rep face-boundary) edges instead of the full triangulation mesh, so curved solids read as clean outlines; mesh objects keep their triangulation edges. Edges take the object's colour in wireframe and hidden-line views and render black over shaded fills.

**BIM 3-D solids in the right position** — more BIM-authored DWGs place their 3D solids correctly, closing the remaining ACIS geometry-pairing cases (record-table data offsets and pre-table blob pools) so a solid no longer picks up the wrong shape.

**Object transparency reads correctly** — per-object transparency saved in DWG now decodes at its true value instead of being dropped or inverted, so semi-transparent objects (e.g. 85%-transparent area highlights) display as intended.
**Transparent solids no longer hide geometry behind them** — a see-through solid blends over what is behind it instead of erasing it.

**Curved solid edges no longer balloon** — cone and cylinder faces on curved solids (such as arched window mullions) sweep only their actual arc instead of drawing a full circle of the surface radius.
**Fit-point splines draw** — splines defined by fit points (as saved by R2013+ DWGs) now render instead of being invisible.
**Rational NURBS solids render undeformed** — 3-D solids bounded by weighted (rational) NURBS surfaces no longer appear distorted.

releases.name: v0.7.4
changes: **Object snap tracking (OTRACK)** — acquire a point, then track along ortho-locked directions and edge extensions to line new geometry up with existing geometry. (#218, #219)

**BIM 3-D solids in the right place** — 3D solids from BIM-authored DWGs (walls, floors, doors, furnishings) render at their true positions again, instead of piling near the origin or scattering outside the drawing. This corrects a regression introduced in v0.7.3 where a solid could pick up another solid's geometry.
**3-D solids off the paper sheet** — model-space 3D solids no longer stack at the origin on paper-space layouts; they now show inside the layout viewports where they belong.
**DWG solids open in strict readers** — DWG files saved from OpenCADStudio that contain 3D solids now load in strict, conformant CAD readers. (#225)

releases.name: v0.7.3
changes: **Properties panel** — a comprehensive rebuild: every entity now shows its full property groups (geometry, 3D visualization, dimension-style, plot style, hyperlink, material, solid history, and more), matching the reference layout. Read-only values are now selectable text you can copy.
**Quick-access toolbar** — New / Open / Save / Save As / Print buttons replace the logo menu at the top-left, alongside Undo / Redo.
**Layer Manager in bulk** — turn layers on/off, lock, freeze and set transparency across every selected layer at once, and Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all layers. (#236)
**Add Selected** — recreates the picked object's type and properties without changing the current layer, and now supports dimensions, adopting the template's dimension style. (#239)
**System variables** — typing a bare variable name (MIRRTEXT, FILLMODE, LTSCALE, …) prompts for the new value on the next line; Enter keeps the current one.
**Exact 3-D on save** — extrude / boolean / loft solids are written with exact NURBS ACIS geometry, so they open as real solids in other CAD applications.
**Plugins** — plugins can persist XDATA to DWG and modify or delete entities; layers they introduce are auto-registered so the added geometry survives a DWG save. (#249, #250, #252)

**Mirror text** — MIRROR now produces a true mirror image under MIRRTEXT, and keeps text right-reading at the mirror-symmetric position when MIRRTEXT is off; the live preview matches the committed result.
**Block attributes** — inserted block attributes land at their proper position and alignment instead of stacking at the origin, and follow the block when it is moved. (#255)
**Xref 3-D solids** — solids brought in through an xref now tessellate and render. (#203)
**Ellipse grip** — dragging the minor-axis grip past the major length swaps the axes instead of clamping it short. (#242)
**Text justify** — JUSTIFYTEXT sets the vertical alignment for single-line text.
**Numpad decimal** — the numpad decimal key always types a decimal point, regardless of keyboard layout. (#201)
**3-D rendering depth** — surface fills draw at their real depth and orthographic depth precision stays constant across zoom, fixing z-fighting and flicker.

releases.name: v0.7.2
changes: **3D view navigation** — orbit is now a lock-horizon turntable, so the view no longer banks and tips over as you rotate. It revolves around the centre of the current selection (or the point under the cursor when nothing is selected) instead of the file centre, and the mouse scheme is Zoom = wheel, Pan = middle button, Rotate = Shift + middle button. (#229)
**Extension object snap** — a dashed guide line now traces the extension path from the endpoint, so the snap is easy to see and follow instead of hunting for an invisible line. (#238)
**Start page** — lists your paying Patreon supporters, and shows a second intro video next to the first.
**Window / crossing selection while zooming** — the selection box now stays pinned to the drawing when you zoom or pan mid-drag, so it selects the area you intended. (#234)
**Properties panel dropdowns** — opening the Layer dropdown while the colour picker is open no longer leaves the two overlapping; opening one closes the other. (#235)
**DWG save** — R2013 save conformance and a fix for missing solid hatches, via an acadrust update. (#182, #225, #46)

releases.name: v0.7.1
changes: **Add Selected** — new `ADDSELECTED` command starts the draw command for the selected object's type, with the new object inheriting its layer, colour, linetype, lineweight and linetype scale. (#239)
**Copyable command line** — the command-history dropdown now has Copy and Clear buttons, and the log is drag-selectable so output can be copied as plain text for debugging. (#232)
**Multi-select layers** — select several layers in the Layer Manager to change their properties or delete them together. (#236)
**Layer lock enforcement** — objects on a locked layer stay visible and snappable but can't be selected or modified; they fade out and the cursor shows a lock badge.
**Block attribute editing** — view and edit block attributes in the Properties panel, or through a dedicated attribute-editor dialog (with prompts) opened via `ATTEDIT` / double-click.
**Status bar refresh** — icon toggles, a taller bar with centred pills, and Select All / Clear All in the filter popup. (#216)

**Property edits repaint immediately** — changing colour, linetype, lineweight or layer on a selection (ribbon dropdowns, `CHPROP`, `LAYMATCH`, `LAYER COLOR`) now updates the drawing at once instead of holding the old look until the next action. (#231)
**Deleting a non-empty layer** — warns and removes the layer's objects instead of failing silently. (#237)
**Purge** — deletes unused blocks, refreshes the UI, and reports per-type counts. (#228)
**Layer dropdown** — scrollable, and no longer leaks mouse events to the viewport behind it. (#227)
**Selection set** — accumulates as you pick and applies on Enter / right-click. (#220)
**Block layer-0 children** — inherit the block instance's layer. (#221)
**MOVE** — no longer leaves attributes / MultiLeaders behind. (#224)
**Heavy 3D models** — batched solid meshes remove per-pick freezes.
**Text style manager** — preview updates live. (#102)
**Web build** — restored after the SECTION / file-association changes broke it.

releases.name: v0.7.0

Saved drawings autosave next to the file; never-saved drawings autosave to the system temp folder. The copies are removed on a clean save or exit, so a leftover `.sv$` flags an unclean shutdown with data to recover. (#205)
**`.bak` backups** — writes a `.bak` backup when overwriting on save (`ISAVEBAK` toggle), and treats `.bak` as a first-class openable file type. (#205)
**File-association control** — new `FILEASSOC` command turns `.dwg` / `.dxf` association on or off; association is now set up once via the first-launch prompt instead of on every launch. (#205)
**Save-As safeguards** — warns before dropping AEC/Civil objects the chosen version can't store, and confirms before overwriting an existing file.
**Right-click to run** — after typing a command, right-clicking in the viewport runs it (first press = Enter, second = context menu).
**New commands** — REGION, FLATSHOT, CONVTOSURFACE, ARCHIVE / ETRANSMIT, CLOSE, HIDE, VISUALSTYLES, QUICKCALC, HYPERLINK, XOPEN, plus broader standard CAD command coverage.
**DWG → DXF conversion** — clean up dangling handle references (via an acadrust bump) so converted drawings open without errors in other CAD software.

**Xref 3-D solids** — solids brought in through an xref now tessellate and render. (#203)
**Ellipse grip** — dragging the minor-axis grip past the major length swaps the axes instead of clamping it short. (#242)
**Text justify** — JUSTIFYTEXT sets the vertical alignment for single-line text.
**Numpad decimal** — the numpad decimal key always types a decimal point, regardless of keyboard layout. (#201)
**3-D rendering depth** — surface fills draw at their real depth and orthographic depth precision stays constant across zoom, fixing z-fighting and flicker.

**3D view navigation** — orbit is now a lock-horizon turntable, so the view no longer banks and tips over as you rotate. It revolves around the centre of the current selection (or the point under the cursor when nothing is selected) instead of the file centre, and the mouse scheme is Zoom = wheel, Pan = middle button, Rotate = Shift + middle button. (#229)
**Extension object snap** — a dashed guide line now traces the extension path from the endpoint, so the snap is easy to see and follow instead of hunting for an invisible line. (#238)
**Start page** — lists your paying Patreon supporters, and shows a second intro video next to the first.
**Window / crossing selection while zooming** — the selection box now stays pinned to the drawing when you zoom or pan mid-drag, so it selects the area you intended. (#234)
**Properties panel dropdowns** — opening the Layer dropdown while the colour picker is open no longer leaves the two overlapping; opening one closes the other. (#235)
**DWG save** — R2013 save conformance and a fix for missing solid hatches, via an acadrust update. (#182, #225, #46)
**Add Selected** — new `ADDSELECTED` command starts the draw command for the selected object's type, with the new object inheriting its layer, colour, linetype, lineweight and linetype scale. (#239)
**Copyable command line** — the command-history dropdown now has Copy and Clear buttons, and the log is drag-selectable so output can be copied as plain text for debugging. (#232)
**Multi-select layers** — select several layers in the Layer Manager to change their properties or delete them together. (#236)
**Layer lock enforcement** — objects on a locked layer stay visible and snappable but can't be selected or modified; they fade out and the cursor shows a lock badge.
**Block attribute editing** — view and edit block attributes in the Properties panel, or through a dedicated attribute-editor dialog (with prompts) opened via `ATTEDIT` / double-click.
**Status bar refresh** — icon toggles, a taller bar with centred pills, and Select All / Clear All in the filter popup. (#216)

**Property edits repaint immediately** — changing colour, linetype, lineweight or layer on a selection (ribbon dropdowns, `CHPROP`, `LAYMATCH`, `LAYER COLOR`) now updates the drawing at once instead of holding the old look until the next action. (#231)
**Deleting a non-empty layer** — warns and removes the layer's objects instead of failing silently. (#237)
**Purge** — deletes unused blocks, refreshes the UI, and reports per-type counts. (#228)
**Layer dropdown** — scrollable, and no longer leaks mouse events to the viewport behind it. (#227)
**Selection set** — accumulates as you pick and applies on Enter / right-click. (#220)
**Block layer-0 children** — inherit the block instance's layer. (#221)
**MOVE** — no longer leaves attributes / MultiLeaders behind. (#224)
**Heavy 3D models** — batched solid meshes remove per-pick freezes.
**Text style manager** — preview updates live. (#102)
**Web build** — restored after the SECTION / file-association changes broke it.

**Autosave & crash recovery** — a periodic autosave writes `.sv$` recovery copies (new `SAVETIME` command, in minutes; default 10). Saved drawings autosave next to the file; never-saved drawings autosave to the system temp folder. The copies are removed on a clean save or exit, so a leftover `.sv$` flags an unclean shutdown with data to recover. (#205)
**`.bak` backups** — writes a `.bak` backup when overwriting on save (`ISAVEBAK` toggle), and treats `.bak` as a first-class openable file type. (#205)
**File-association control** — new `FILEASSOC` command turns `.dwg` / `.dxf` association on or off; association is now set up once via the first-launch prompt instead of on every launch. (#205)
**Save-As safeguards** — warns before dropping AEC/Civil objects the chosen version can't store, and confirms before overwriting an existing file.
**Right-click to run** — after typing a command, right-clicking in the viewport runs it (first press = Enter, second = context menu).
**New commands** — REGION, FLATSHOT, CONVTOSURFACE, ARCHIVE / ETRANSMIT, CLOSE, HIDE, VISUALSTYLES, QUICKCALC, HYPERLINK, XOPEN, plus broader standard CAD command coverage.
**DWG → DXF conversion** — clean up dangling handle references (via an acadrust bump) so converted drawings open without errors in other CAD software.

releases.name: v0.6.7
changes: **Interactive PAN**: pan with a left-drag — no middle mouse button needed.

**Typed command lines & interactive UCS**: type whole command lines with spaces (unified with the headless path), run `UCS Z 90` typed anywhere, and answer interactive value prompts for `PDMODE` / `PDSIZE` / `LTSCALE` / `CELTSCALE` (#169).
**ViewCube**: a compass ring with cardinal directions and navigation controls, with the face names painted onto the cube itself.
**Lineweight legibility**: model-space lineweight display is boosted so thin lines read clearly on screen (#147).
**Save dialog**: navigate to other drives, including on macOS and Linux (#170).
**TRIM circles**: clicking a circle in TRIM now cuts it into an arc (it was silently ignored); the arc/circle trim preview is drawn in the correct plane (#184).
**Command preview always on top**: live command-preview wires are never hidden behind occluding geometry, for every command.

**Dimensions survive in other CAD**: an anonymous `*D` geometry block is baked for each dimension on save, so DWG TrueView, QCAD and BricsCAD open and place them correctly (#178, #181, #182); COPY now duplicates that baked block too (#161).
**Text**: TTF glyphs render as solid fills, with font fallback and corrected Z-order (#180).
**ViewCube**: face clicks always land upright, never upside-down.
**Dimensions**: diameter text renders and point markers are smaller (#139); DIMCONTINUE chains stay collinear with the base (#151); aligned/ordinate placement and preview plane corrected (#150).
**ROTATE**: a typed angle applies right after the centre is picked (#159).
**PDF export**: linetypes and true lineweights are exported (#155).
**Linetypes**: dotted and dash-dot patterns render (#149).
**OSNAP**: snaps to an arc/circle centre when hovering the curve (#152).
**Hatch**: all island loops are preserved in complex hatches (#148).
**OFFSET**: the offset side is chosen by containment for closed polylines.
**Layout / viewport**: the camera centres on the sheet when a layout first opens; a new paper-space viewport border shows without a zoom; paper viewports frame on a robust cluster centre.
**Scale list**: the default scale list is restored when a drawing has none (#154).
**Ribbon**: annotate style dropdowns float so they aren't clipped (#153).
**Web**: the wasm build is restored (native-only deps gated off wasm) and the OSNAP tooltip caret renders as SVG, not a tofu glyph (#138).
**XCLIP**: clipped hatch loops stay in `world_origin`-relative space.

Plugins: out-of-process host moved to double precision with shared-memory IPC, faster shutdown, backward-compatibility and a `plugin-template-v2`; plugin pick coordinates are f64 and the lifecycle is hardened.

releases.name: v0.6.6
changes: **Large-coordinate precision (UTM)**: the whole renderer is now relative-to-eye with double-single (high/low) vertex precision across every pipeline, backed by an absolute-f64 CPU path for pick / snap / overlay. Drawings far from the origin (e.g. UTM-georeferenced) no longer jitter on pan / zoom or snap baselines onto a coarse grid.

**In-viewport editing**: editing inside a floating viewport (MSPACE) runs on the model-space path through one shared camera adapter — live snap, grips, command preview and dynamic input all track pan / zoom inside the viewport.
**Per-viewport UCS**: each floating viewport adopts its own UCS; the grid, UCS icon, ortho/polar constraints and the ViewCube all follow it inside the viewport.

**Viewport (UTM)**: keep the MSPACE camera target in f64 so content no longer jitters inside paper viewports; clip pick / box / lasso selection and snap to the viewport rect so off-screen geometry isn't caught.

**Viewport activation**: clicking the empty area beside a viewport that runs off-screen no longer switches into it; the active-viewport outline hugs the real visible edge; overlapping viewports resolve to the topmost.

**ViewCube**: hover now highlights the face under the cursor (matching the click) under an active UCS and inside paper viewports; clicking a face snaps the view square to the UCS (direction + twist), and the top/bottom flip no longer inverts inside a viewport.
**Blocks**: restore per-definition precision after the world_offset removal (block lines and greeked text).
**Paste / pick / snap / XCLIP**: UTM-precise paste and block base, click / box / lasso selection, computed snaps, and clip-boundary carry across cross-drawing paste.
**Camera**: precise zoom-to-cursor pivot at large coordinates; centre the ortho depth range so deep zoom doesn't clip the drawing.
Drop the vestigial `_f64` suffixes and the dead `world_offset` / `view_proj` / `local_offset` plumbing now the relative-to-eye migration is complete.
Registry: add the Land Survey and HydroComplete plugins to the marketplace.

releases.name: v0.6.5
changes: **UCS workflow**: central WCS↔UCS converter that adopts the file UCS and drives the coordinate readout and UCS icon. The whole drawing experience now follows the active UCS:
Model grid, grid snap, and grid axis lines align to the UCS
Ortho/polar constraints work in the UCS plane
Object-snap tracking rays follow the UCS
Dynamic-input deltas/angles and typed coordinate values resolve in the UCS
New axis-aligned shapes are built in the active UCS
Text-bearing annotations orient to the UCS
ViewCube orients to the UCS and snaps face views square to it
**Views**: apply a saved view twist as camera roll on load; unify model VPORT / paper VIEWPORT view handling.

**Text**: keep text anchors in f64 so large-coordinate (UTM) drawings no longer snap baselines onto a coarse grid and overlap rows; honour leading/trailing space advance so space-aligned columns line up.
**Clipboard**: PASTEORIG and PASTEBLOCK now recreate referenced block definitions and tessellate pasted solids, so blocks no longer paste empty.
Silence native and wasm build warnings; update the lock so the wasm build compiles.

Show polyline length and area in the properties panel
Open CAD-saved layouts without crashing — viewport status flags now use the DWG spec bit layout

Keep a block's owned-entity list in sync on save so CAD no longer drops model-space geometry
Place the sheet viewport in the paper plane so the layout isn't shifted
Reflect page-setup paper changes on the sheet immediately
Keep each viewport's grid independent and clipped to its own rectangle
Fully remove a deleted layout's record and references so it can't reappear
Select, move and paste 3D ACIS solids in the right place and refresh them after a transform
Box/lasso-select blocks and 3D solids and click the front-most solid body
Carry block definitions, block-internal layers and pasted-solid tessellation across drawings on paste
Keep the paste preview on the cursor across drawings
Stitch touching segments into a polyline at any angle (JOIN)
Move the baked dimension block when a dimension is transformed
Refresh a DXF SOLID's fill after move/copy and recolour solid meshes on a colour/layer change
Resolve Leader annotations correctly in TEXTEDIT and don't advance the edit count on an empty commit
Sync COMMANDS.md with the implemented command set

Use Wz in the arbitrary-axis algorithm else branch

Honor layer off/freeze for block sub-entities
Explain pierced-face outer-loop selection in the 3D module

releases.name: v0.6.2
changes: Render block-definition solid meshes as instances per INSERT
Show the entity handle in the General properties section
Orange hover / blue selection highlight for all object types
Per-viewport grid/snap, adopted from the active viewport; persisted to the active VPort
Unified viewport control chip with per-tile grid rendering and item dividers
Create polylines as live entities so they snap while still being drawn
Render pierced solid faces together with their holes
Object snap now takes precedence over ortho/polar
Keep dimension line continuous when the text sits above/below it
Keep the angle input box clear of the snap point near 0°
Bump acadrust to drop the forced VPORT grid in saved DWG/DXF
Make grid visibility per-drawing rather than a global setting
Refresh layer toggle SVG icons
Drop brand names and orphaned PICK_HIGHLIGHT colours
Clear compiler warnings

releases.name: v0.6.1
changes: Copy/paste between drawings carries the entities' referenced records (layer, linetype, text/dim style): missing ones are recreated in the target drawing, an existing same-named record is kept.

Paste split into a menu: **Paste** (pick a point), **Paste to Original Coordinates** (no prompt), and **Paste as Block** (wraps the clipboard in a new block definition, then prompts for the insertion point with a live preview).
Object-snap selection is now priority-then-distance, so a continuous snap (Nearest, Perpendicular) no longer suppresses the discrete snaps (Endpoint, Midpoint, Center, …) you also have enabled.
Perpendicular snap drops its foot from the segment's drawing origin, so the new segment is genuinely perpendicular to the target instead of just nearest-on-line.
Web: UI chrome and ribbon tool icons render from bundled SVGs instead of font glyphs, which the web build couldn't display (showed empty boxes).
Web: dynamic-input value boxes were blank because canvas text used Basic shaping (unsupported on the web backend); they now force Advanced shaping, so coordinates display and accept input.
Web: saving an older DWG/DXF version now honours the selected format instead of always writing the newest (AC1032).
Modal dialogs capture the keyboard — typed keys no longer leak into the command line and fire as commands after the dialog closes.
Copying entities with inline sub-entities (INSERT attributes, 3D-polyline vertices) regenerates their handles, preventing duplicate handles that corrupted the saved DWG.
Paste base point is no longer NaN when the clipboard geometry contributes wire separators, which previously froze paste-as-block.

releases.name: v0.6.0
changes: **Plugin system.** Open CAD Studio now loads third-party add-ons as external dynamic libraries. Install and manage them from the Plugin Manager — from a curated registry or any GitHub repo'\''s releases — with upgrade, reinstall, uninstall and enable/disable. Plugins target the semver-stable `ocs_plugin_api` crate (ribbon tabs, commands, XDATA, per-tab state, native file dialogs, and click-to-place interactive commands with point and object picking).

**External automation API.** `OpenCADStudio --serve` drives the app headless over a line-based JSON protocol on stdin/stdout or a local TCP socket (`--port`): open / save documents, run commands (drawing, modify, selection), and query entities, layers and drawing variables. State persists, so a script or AI agent can act, observe and act again. Ships a thin `ocs.py` Python client — no binding to maintain.
**TORIENT** — rotate text to a view-aware orientation; fixes the dynamic-input angle commit.

Plugin API is **v2**: the interactive-command hook changed the contract, so plugins must be built against the current `ocs_plugin_api`. Reference: [opencad-example-plugin](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencad-example-plugin).
A `#[repr(C)]` ABI and signature verification are intentionally out of scope for now — plugin binaries must be built against the same toolchain as the host.

Lazy per-script font loading for international CAD text on the web build
Wrap external-plugin calls in a panic guard
Defer the rollover hit-test until the cursor stops, so it no longer freezes the crosshair on large drawings
Restore DIMTAD=Outside placement and route every DIMTAD value through the placement logic
Place DIMTAD "above" text by the text-up side rather than the object side
Close the boundary loop in the hatch fill shader
Paste clipboard text into the TEXT / MText editors
Render OSNAP menu symbols as SVG instead of font glyphs on the web build
Gate boot() to native so the wasm build compiles
Use Wz in the arbitrary-axis algorithm else branch
Anchor ribbon tooltips to the right of their button
Pick a pierced face's outer loop by area rather than list order
Honor layer freeze toggles in the ribbon dropdown and make the layer manager columns sortable
Honor layer off/freeze for block sub-entities
Explain pierced-face outer-loop selection in the 3D module
Render block-definition solid meshes as instances per INSERT
Show the entity handle in the General properties section
Orange hover / blue selection highlight for all object types
Per-viewport grid/snap, adopted from the active viewport; persisted to the active VPort
Unified viewport control chip with per-tile grid rendering and item dividers
Create polylines as live entities so they snap while still being drawn
Render pierced solid faces together with their holes
Object snap now takes precedence over ortho/polar
Keep dimension line continuous when the text sits above/below it
Keep the angle input box clear of the snap point near 0°

Drop brand names and orphaned PICK_HIGHLIGHT colours
Clear compiler warnings
Copy/paste between drawings carries the entities' referenced records (layer, linetype, text/dim style): missing ones are recreated in the target drawing, an existing same-named record is kept.

Paste split into a menu: **Paste** (pick a point), **Paste to Original Coordinates** (no prompt), and **Paste as Block** (wraps the clipboard in a new block definition, then prompts for the insertion point with a live preview).
Object-snap selection is now priority-then-distance, so a continuous snap (Nearest, Perpendicular) no longer suppresses the discrete snaps (Endpoint, Midpoint, Center, …) you also have enabled.
Perpendicular snap drops its foot from the segment's drawing origin, so the new segment is genuinely perpendicular to the target instead of just nearest-on-line.
Web: UI chrome and ribbon tool icons render from bundled SVGs instead of font glyphs, which the web build couldn't display (showed empty boxes).
Web: dynamic-input value boxes were blank because canvas text used Basic shaping (unsupported on the web backend); they now force Advanced shaping, so coordinates display and accept input.
Web: saving an older DWG/DXF version now honours the selected format instead of always writing the newest (AC1032).
Modal dialogs capture the keyboard — typed keys no longer leak into the command line and fire as commands after the dialog closes.
Copying entities with inline sub-entities (INSERT attributes, 3D-polyline vertices) regenerates their handles, preventing duplicate handles that corrupted the saved DWG.
Paste base point is no longer NaN when the clipboard geometry contributes wire separators, which previously froze paste-as-block.

**Plugin system.** Open CAD Studio now loads third-party add-ons as external dynamic libraries. Install and manage them from the Plugin Manager — from a curated registry or any GitHub repo'\''s releases — with upgrade, reinstall, uninstall and enable/disable. Plugins target the semver-stable `ocs_plugin_api` crate (ribbon tabs, commands, XDATA, per-tab state, native file dialogs, and click-to-place interactive commands with point and object picking).

**External automation API.** `OpenCADStudio --serve` drives the app headless over a line-based JSON protocol on stdin/stdout or a local TCP socket (`--port`): open / save documents, run commands (drawing, modify, selection), and query entities, layers and drawing variables. State persists, so a script or AI agent can act, observe and act again. Ships a thin `ocs.py` Python client — no binding to maintain.
**TORIENT** — rotate text to a view-aware orientation; fixes the dynamic-input angle commit.

Plugin API is **v2**: the interactive-command hook changed the contract, so plugins must be built against the current `ocs_plugin_api`. Reference: [opencad-example-plugin](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencad-example-plugin).
A `#[repr(C)]` ABI and signature verification are intentionally out of scope for now — plugin binaries must be built against the same toolchain as the host.

releases.name: v0.5.9
changes: Extensible plugin system: install third-party add-ons from the Plugin Manager (`PLUGINS`). Plugins are external dynamic libraries loaded from the plugins folder; install, upgrade, reinstall and uninstall them from a curated registry or any GitHub repo's releases, and enable/disable loaded plugins. A stable `ocs_plugin_api` contract crate and an example plugin repo document how to build one.
Point style: `PDMODE` / `PDSIZE` commands and a `DDPTYPE` dialog (glyph grid, size relative to screen or in absolute units). Relative point markers now keep a constant on-screen size across zoom.
Drag in-canvas dialogs by a title-bar grip, clamped to the window so they can't be pushed off-screen.
OTRACK: hover an acquired tracking point to remove it, and snap to the intersection when two tracking/polar vectors are active.
Web: page favicon and a loading splash while the WASM app initializes.
OSNAP pickup radius shrunk to a quarter of the crosshair arm, and the snap aperture unified so OTRACK catches where OSNAP does.
OTRACK waits a 250 ms dwell before acquiring a tracking point, so brushing past snap points no longer spawns stray points.
Dimensions: scale DIMGAP by DIMSCALE so text is placed correctly when DIMSCALE is not 1.
Rewrite the plugin architecture spec and template for the external-only model.

releases.name: v0.5.8
changes: System **TrueType** font support on the desktop, with shaping (ligatures, Arabic joining, kerning, bidi) and automatic font fallback.
Curated the bundled stroke-font set down to the standard equivalents.
**OCS Web** button on the Start page; **Send Feedback** now pre-fills the GitHub issue with the app version and platform.
Fixed the Donate button (Start-tab gate + web).
Internal: scene modules regrouped into role-based folders.

releases.name: v0.5.7
changes: Dynamic input: per-step `DynSpec` framework with coordinate/length/angle boxes and on-screen guides for LINE, RECTANGLE, POLYGON, ELLIPSE, ARC and CIRCLE, plus a shared angle reference with consistent sign handling.
MIRROR: erase-source prompt — keeps the mirrored copy and the original by default, or flips in place.
SCALE: live ghost preview from the base point.
STRETCH: live ghost preview while dragging the new point.
ARRAYPATH: items align to the path tangent and the array starts from the path end nearest the pick.
XCLIP: clip block references to their `SPATIAL_FILTER` boundary, including hatch fills and nested blocks.
Plugin Manager window listing installed add-ons.
Dynamic input: F12 toggles dynamic input again (removed iced's debug feature that hijacked F12 for the comet debugger).
Command-line coordinates are always absolute; the dynamic-input prompt sits evenly off the crosshair.
ARRAYPATH: arc and polyline-arc paths no longer come out mirrored (OCS-correct arc sampling + canonical bulge centre).
Properties: the color dropdown closes on selection change and on the first viewport click.
The main menu closes when opening a file from Recent documents.
Extract the \`ocs_plugin_api\` crate as the stable add-on contract.
Publish SHA256 checksums alongside the AppImage, portable .exe, MSI and .dmg.

releases.name: v0.5.6
changes: Loaded 3D solids and surfaces now tessellate and render: ACIS solids through the truck B-rep kernel, plus loft / sweep / extrude and other surface entities.
The shared colour selector (swatch + name dropdown) is now used in the properties panel, ribbon, and layers as well.
Unnamed palette colours show their RGB value instead of just "Index".
Cone and cylinder 3D solids tessellate correctly.
Raster images render at the correct position and size, and DWG-embedded image paths resolve so the images actually load (#98).
A typed command submits on Enter without first focusing the command input (#99).
The Start tab's Send Feedback and Release Notes buttons work instead of reporting "No drawing open".

releases.name: v0.5.5
changes: Dimension style editor: every enum setting (text placement, units, fit, zero-suppression, …) is now a named dropdown instead of a raw code box.
Colours in the dimension, multileader and table style editors are picked from a shared colour selector (swatch + name dropdown) with a "More…" button that opens a full ACI palette window.
Dimensions follow the style for text placement — DIMTAD (above / centred / below), DIMTVP, and DIMJUST (with text rotated along the extension line for the "over ext" options).
Dimension text and arrows move outside the extension lines when they don't fit (DIMTIX / DIMATFIT), and the dimension line is broken behind on-line text so a background fill (DIMTFILL) reads cleanly.
New text, mtext, dimension, multileader and table objects inherit the document's current style.
TRIM can trim the same (closed) polyline repeatedly within one command (#65).
FILLET fixes the wrap-around corner of a closed polyline (#91).

Modify commands started from the ribbon accept their option keywords (FILLET "R", CHAMFER "D") and the radius/distance value; typed coordinates (including @ and # prefixes) and Enter work with dynamic input both on and off (#90, #97).
Object-selection steps no longer show a coordinate input box and instead show a prompt-only hint at the cursor.
Making a layer current keeps the active-layer dropdown correct after pressing Esc (#93).
STRETCH updates the viewport as soon as the command finishes (#95).
The Start tab no longer runs drawing commands that have no drawing to act on (#96).
Dimension background fill (DIMTFILL drawing-background) and architectural feet/inch zero-suppression (DIMZIN) now render.
DXF/DWG preserve the dimension "text moved by user" flag so imported drawings keep their text placement.
The Windows installer shows the GPL-3 licence on its agreement page.

releases.name: v0.5.4
changes: Right-edge side toolbar replaces the paper-space ribbon tab.
Open CAD Studio registers as a .dwg / .dxf handler (installer and portable build) and prompts on first launch to become the default app, so it shows up in Windows "Open with".
The "Open with" / default-apps entry now shows the app icon on Windows and Linux instead of a blank generic document icon.
RENAME focuses the inline rename field so you can type immediately.
Object snap tracking resets its acquired points after each committed point.
Box / lasso selection keeps the active selection when the region is empty.

releases.name: v0.5.3
changes: 3D solids (3DSOLID / REGION / BODY) authored in CAD 2013+ now render: their ACIS/ASM geometry is loaded from the AcDs data store, tessellated to a mesh, and placed by the solid's body transform.
Dynamic blocks with a visibility parameter show a lookup grip; clicking it opens a dropdown of the block's states, and picking one switches the visible geometry.
Visibility-state dynamic blocks display the saved state instead of every variant stacked on top of each other.
3D solids are included in ZOOM EXTENTS / auto-fit, and no longer draw a stray placeholder line beside them.
TRIM / EXTEND can now cut against polyline boundaries (LwPolyline / Polyline / Polyline2D / Polyline3D), not just lines/arcs.
TRIM / EXTEND / FILLET picks and their hover previews land on the geometry on large-coordinate (UTM-scale) drawings instead of being offset.
Box and lasso selection add to the current selection; Shift+box/lasso removes the enclosed objects (#83).

The Annotate style dropdowns (text / dimension / multileader / table) and the layer dropdown load from the opened document and stay empty on the Start tab, instead of showing a hard-coded placeholder.
Wipeout masks created in the app no longer bleed past their boundary.
Files that previously loaded with zero entities (AC18 section-name decoding) or hung on load (near-collinear arcs) now open correctly.

releases.name: v0.5.2
changes: Plugin host architecture: load external add-ons through a shared plugin interface, with a demo plugin and integration tests (#80).
Storm Sewer add-on: interactive storm-drain network with snapping and tracked objects, plus Rational/Manning/HGL analysis of the drawing.
The five style managers (text, dimension, mline, table, multileader) share one transactional frame — changes persist only on Apply.
The current style is marked with a green ✓ in each manager, resolved from the DWG.
Current table/multileader style is read from, seeded by, and written back to the DWG; current text/dim/mline style changes persist too.
Ellipses render in their WCS plane; hatch MIRROR is delegated upstream.
MIRROR negates polyline bulges so mirrored arcs curve the right way.
Hatch: giant wrong-way boundary arcs in mirrored blocks now curve correctly.
Grip positions computed in f64 so they sit exactly on the wire.
Drop the geometry-only pick cache that served stale culled wires on hover.
Purge zero-length point-collapsed and degenerate arcs/splines that hung or OOM'd on load.
Cover the object-pick snap mode in the persisted-mode match.
Double-click inline style rename fires again.
Hover no longer rebuilds/re-uploads hatches on every rollover, nor scans every wire on large drawings.
Bump acadrust to current main (upstream sync).

releases.name: v0.5.1
changes: TRIM trims closed and open polylines: clicking a segment removes the span between the adjacent boundary crossings (#65).
OTRACK supports polar coordinates — type a distance to place a point along the tracking ray from the tracking point, locking to POLAR angles (#69).
User preferences (DYN, ORTHO, POLAR, GRID, OSNAP modes, OTRACK) persist across sessions (#68).
Dynamic-input boxes accept scalar values (distance/radius/count) directly.
Expression evaluation for numerical inputs and the command line (#66).
Overflowing text is elided with an ellipsis across panels; the layer manager shows the full name in a tooltip.
POLAR only snaps when the cursor is near a polar ray, leaving it free otherwise (#70).
OTRACK temporary tracking points/vectors clear when the command ends (#64).
Dot hatch patterns (zero-length dashes) now render, as a steady single pixel at any angle.
Hatch: stays selectable on its fill, boundary no longer offset at large coordinates, and deselect clears the highlight (#71).
New layers get real handles so they survive a DWG save (#67).
The active command step prompt stays pinned in the command line instead of fading.
The save dialog appends the selected format's extension to a bare filename (#60).
Properties edits refresh the scene immediately.
Incremental tessellation for MOVE / COPY / ERASE and a per-entity tessellation memo on the render path.
Drop the ACAD prefix from ISO asset names.

releases.name: v0.5.0
changes: Rollover highlight — the entity under the cursor is highlighted as the mouse moves over the drawing.
Esc cancels an in-progress grip drag, restoring the entity to where it started; a normal release commits.
`PERF` command toggles a frame-budget HUD showing the cost of the last wire re-tessellation.
Open completion logs a `parse / purge / caches / xref / total` breakdown to the command line.
Continuous interaction no longer re-tessellates the whole model: selecting, hovering, drawing-command previews and grip drags now refresh only what actually changed.
Block-heavy edits: line-commit and grip start/end drop from ~400 ms to the ~30 ms baseline — a non-block edit no longer rebuilds every block definition (separate `block_epoch`).
Panning reuses the cached tessellation and skips the wire-buffer GPU re-upload; only the camera matrix and scissors update.
The wire pass is batched into per-run draw calls — a 2D model renders in a single draw instead of one per entity.
Command-preview and grip-drag overlays draw from their own small GPU buffer, so the resident base wire buffer stays put during a drag.

Faster file open — redundant entity walk dropped, the world-offset scan fused into the cache pass, corrupt-entity scan and block-definition build parallelized, and FxHash for the hot block / hatch / wire-cache maps.

releases.name: v0.4.9
changes: Status-bar customization menu (`≡` handle): toggle which pills are shown; the choice persists across sessions.
New pills: Coordinates (live cursor X,Y,Z), Drawing Units (INSUNITS picker), Transparency display, Quick Properties (floating panel on selection), Clean Screen (hide ribbon + panels).
Isolate / Hide objects with an action menu on the pill and the right-click menu (`ISOLATEOBJECTS` / `HIDEOBJECTS` / `UNISOLATEOBJECTS`).
Selection Filtering: limit which object types can be picked.
Selection Cycling: a pick list for overlapping objects with hover highlight; the pick is added to the selection.

Annotation/viewport scales are driven by the drawing's own scale list (`ACAD_SCALELIST`); xref-derived scales are filtered out. Model-space scale round-trips through the standard `CANNOSCALE` / `CANNOSCALEVALUE` header variables instead of a user variable.
Cycling-list hover highlight now stays put when moving between rows and returning to the first row (enter/exit event reordering).

releases.name: v0.4.8
changes: Full style editors for **Text, Dimension, Multileader and Table** styles, covering every style field: a new Multileader Style manager window, dropdowns and arrowhead / ext-line linetype pickers in the Dimension editor, and per-cell editing (text, colours, borders, margins, flow) for tables.

**Annotative** support across Text / Dimension / Table / Multileader styles, persisted to both DXF and DWG using CAD's standard encoding (`AcadAnnotative` XDATA/EED, native MLEADERSTYLE flag) — verified byte-for-byte against a real CAD drawing, so the flag round-trips and stays readable by other CAD apps.
Tables created in-app now render cell background fills, text colours, styled borders, margins and flow direction from their table style.
Dynamic MLEADER text placement with grips and consistent arrow sizing.
Per-tile model render mode in viewports, persisted through VPORT entries.

Drawing and editing now use the correct world-XY drawing plane (#54): a revision cloud follows the path you draw instead of collapsing to two horizontal lines (same fix for donut, mline, wipeout, table, attribute and tolerance); ID / DIST / AREA report correct values; and fillet, chamfer, break, join, trim, lengthen, array and window-stretch pick the right geometry.
3D revolve axis and OBJ mesh import now use the Z-up world correctly.
FILLET / CHAMFER on polylines: the corner now previews as an arc instead of a straight line, hovering highlights the picked edge, and chamfering a polyline corner works.
The Text Style manager opens from the Annotate-tab "Manage…" button.
The in-place MText / Text editor stays on-screen at the window edges.
New style records are given unique handles instead of colliding.

releases.name: v0.4.7
changes: 3D solid modelling tab: box / wedge / cylinder / cone / sphere / torus primitives plus union / subtract / intersect boolean ops, backed by a per-session B-rep cache.

Native paper-space viewports: the sheet is rendered as a top-locked full-canvas GPU viewport through the shader, with floating content viewports overlaying it. Sheet and floating viewport cameras now round-trip through the viewport entities themselves on save/reopen (DXF and DWG).
Floating-viewport fills (hatches / wipeouts / images) no longer bleed past the viewport borders onto the sheet.
Lines now appear immediately while panning / zooming / orbiting inside a double-clicked floating viewport, instead of staying invisible until you exit the viewport.
Distinct cameras for duplicate tiled model-space viewports are preserved across DWG save and reopen.
Layout cameras are persisted before switching layouts, so they no longer revert when toggling between model and paper space.
3D solids can be selected by clicking their body, not only their edges.
Stuck style dropdown is dismissed on viewport click.

releases.name: v0.4.6
changes: In-place editors for every text-bearing entity: a plain text box for single-line text (Text, attributes, dimension override, tolerance) and the rich MText editor for MText / MultiLeader. DDEDIT and double-click route each entity to the matching editor.
TEXT now places a plain text box at the click point; double-click edits in place.
MLEADER places the leader, then opens the MText editor on its annotation content.
LEADER follows the classic flow — points, Enter, then a linked empty MText annotation opens in the editor; the leader's `annotation_handle` links the pair so they edit and erase as a unit.

releases.name: v0.4.5
changes: Custom hover menus for every remaining entity: Polyline / Polyline2D / Polyline3D, Spline, MLine, Hatch, Leader, MultiLeader, Text, MText. New `GripMenuAction` vocabulary covers Add / Remove Vertex, Refine Vertices, Tangent Direction, Origin Point / Hatch Angle / Hatch Scale, Move with Text, Stack / Unstack, Move with Leader / Move Independent.

Spline CV grips support Add / Remove Vertex (chord-midpoint insertion, weights kept in sync, knots cleared so to_truck rebuilds a uniform knot vector) plus Refine Vertices (inserts a CV between every adjacent pair).
Hatch centroid grips expose Origin Point / Hatch Angle / Hatch Scale; Angle (degrees → radians) and Scale (positive scalar) prompt for a value on the command line.

Leader path-vertex grips add / remove intermediate vertices; arrow head and centroid stay Stretch-only. MultiLeader text-location grips offer Move-with-Leader / Move-Independent (menu vocabulary live, structural multi-leader edits stubbed).
Text / MText insertion grips add Move with Text and Rotate (Rotate prompts for degrees and rewrites the entity rotation). MText width grip stays Stretch-only.
`Spline`, `Leader` and `MultiLeader` are converted from the `impl_entity_basics!` macro to manual trait impls so `grip_menu` can be overridden per entity.

New right-click context-menu entry **Select Similar** (or `SELECTSIMILAR` / `SELSIM`) walks the active layout and, for every (entity type, layer) pair already in the selection, adds every matching entity. The seed selection stays selected; matches already selected are not double-counted.

New right-click **Quick Select…** (or `QSELECT` / `QS`) opens a centred floating panel with the classic single-filter shape: Object type → Property → Operator → Value, plus an Append-to-current-selection checkbox.

The Property dropdown is type-aware: always lists the common four (Layer, Color, Linetype, Lineweight); selecting a specific Object type appends that type's `geometry_properties` rows (Start X, Length, Radius, Pattern Angle, …) sampled from the first entity of that type in the active layout. Changing the Object type drops the Property when the new type no longer offers it.

Operators: `= Equals`, `!= Not equal`, `> Greater than`, `< Less than`, `* Any value`. Eq / Neq are case-insensitive string compares; Gt / Lt parse both sides as f64 and reject anything non-numeric; Any skips the value test. The Value field is disabled while no Property is picked or the operator is Any.

Scope is the entire active layout, so a paper-layout filter never reaches into model-space entities (and vice versa). Common-property values are canonicalised (`ByLayer` / `ByBlock` / `<aci>` / `r,g,b` for colour; `0.30mm` for lineweight) so the typed value matches what the panel will show.

The context menu used to be anchored in window-relative coordinates while the cursor position it followed was canvas-relative — the menu drifted away from the cursor by the size of the surrounding ribbon and side panels. Moved inside `viewport_stack` so the anchor resolves in the same coordinate space the cursor was captured in.

New shared `position_canvas_overlay(anchor, panel)` helper wraps a panel in fixed-width spacers and `iced::widget::opaque(panel)` so events on the menu itself don't fall through to the viewport mouse area. The multi-functional grip popup is rewritten to use the same helper.

Outside-click dismiss mirrors the grip popup: `ViewportLeftPress` checks `selection.context_menu.take()` at the top and returns early when it was set, so a press that reaches the viewport mouse area (i.e. outside the opaque panel) closes the menu without running the rest of the left-click handler.
Right-drag threshold for orbit was 3 px squared — small enough that normal hand jitter promoted a click-and-release to an orbit drag and the menu never opened. Bumped to 8 px squared.

`Message::ViewportExit` no longer clears `context_menu`. With the menu now living above the viewport mouse area, the opaque panel capturing the cursor fired the underlying area's exit handler — which closed the menu the instant it opened.

Eight layer-state commands (`LAYOFF`, `LAYFRZ`, `LAYLCK`, `LAYULK`, `LAYON`, `LAYTHW`, `LAYISO`, `LAYUNISO`) mutated `document.layers` directly and called `refresh_layer_panel()` — but never bumped the scene's geometry epoch. The 3D viewport caches its uploaded geometry by that epoch, so visibility / freeze changes only took effect once something else triggered a re-render (pressing Esc was the workaround because the Esc handler calls `deselect_all()`, which bumps geometry).
Each command branch now calls `scene.bump_geometry()` after the layer mutation loop so the viewport repaints immediately.

The boot task now consumes `std::env::args_os().nth(1)` as a path and dispatches `Message::OpenRecent`, so a file passed on the command line opens after startup. Flag-style args are ignored, and a bogus path lands as a clean command-line error.

Both hatch fragment shaders ended `fs_main` with a bare `discard;` after the pattern-match for-loop fell through without matching. naga (the Linux/Vulkan path) accepts that; DX12's FXC compiler (default on Windows) rejects it with `X3507: 'fs_main': Not all control paths return a value` and took the entire pipeline create-down on every drawing open. Append an unreachable `return vec4<f32>(0.0);` after each terminal `discard;` so every control path syntactically ends in a return.

GitHub Actions takes ~15 min to build and attach the platform binaries after a tag is pushed, but the latest-release API returns the tag the moment it is published — users were getting a popup pointing at a release page whose asset list was still empty. The check now parses `published_at` and suppresses the notification while the release is younger than 30 minutes.

releases.name: v0.4.4
changes: New hover-popup vocabulary: after a 600 ms dwell on a grip, a single keyboard-navigable popup widget opens listing the operations the entity supports at that grip. Arrow keys move the highlight, Enter commits, Esc / click-outside / mouse-leave dismisses, and the popup width auto-sizes to the longest label with full-row highlighting.
Per-entity menu vocabulary replaces the generic "drag this point" model. Stretch is always present (and falls through to the regular drag); each entity adds its own operations.

**Line / Arc / Dimension** — Lengthen (line endpoints, arc endpoints) and Radius / Arc Length (arc midpoint) prompt for a typed distance on the command line and apply it along the line direction or around the arc. Dimension text grip exposes Reset Text, Move-with / Independent options; dim-line grip exposes Reverse Arrows.
**Polyline / Polyline2D / Polyline3D / MLine** — Add Vertex (chord midpoint, with bulge / elevation kept in sync where applicable) and Remove Vertex (blocked at the minimum two-vertex floor).

**Spline** — Add Vertex / Remove Vertex on control vertices, plus Refine Vertices which inserts a CV between every adjacent pair. Weights are kept in sync when present and the knot vector is cleared so the truck conversion rebuilds a uniform knot vector for the new CV count.
**Hatch** — Origin Point, Hatch Angle (prompts for degrees, writes `pattern_angle` in radians), Hatch Scale (prompts for a positive scalar).

**Leader / MultiLeader** — Add / Remove Vertex on intermediate path vertices; arrow head and centroid stay Stretch-only. MultiLeader MText location adds Move-with-Leader / Move-Independent (menu vocabulary live; structural multi-leader edits stubbed — Stretch falls through to the regular drag).
**Text / MText** — Move with Text and Rotate (Rotate prompts for degrees and sets the entity rotation). MText width grip stays Stretch-only.

Picking a menu action that needs a numeric input (Lengthen, Radius, Arc Length, Hatch Angle / Scale, Rotate) queues a `GripPendingValue` and pushes the action's label to the command line as a prompt. The next command-line submission is routed back through `apply_grip_menu_value`; Esc clears the pending value.
Window `frames()` subscription drives the dwell tick so the popup opens after the configured delay without requiring continuous mouse motion over the grip.
`Spline`, `Leader` and `MultiLeader` switched from the `impl_entity_basics!` macro to manual `Grippable` / `PropertyEditable` / `Transformable` impls so `grip_menu` can be overridden per entity.

Grip-shape vocabulary completed (`Square` / `Rectangle` / `Triangle` only); `Rectangle` is reserved for direction-aware mid-segment stretch handles, `Triangle` for directional indicators (dimension reverse-arrow flips, dynamic-block parameters).

releases.name: v0.4.3
changes: Model and paper layouts now share a single GPU shader widget: `Scene::active_viewports` yields a `Vec<ViewportInstance>` (one per tiled Model pane or floating paper viewport), and the `MultiPipeline` renders each into its own scissor pass.

Model space gains a tiled-pane layout: split the active tile via ▤/▥ buttons or `VPORTS 2H|2V|4|SINGLE`, drag the inner dividers to resize, and drag a divider past the ViewCube minimum to collapse the pane into its longest-contact neighbour. The tile layout (rect + per-pane camera) round-trips through the DXF/DWG `VPort` table via `*OCS_Tile_<i>` entries.

Paper layout drops the old `PaperViewportPane` + `PaperViewportPipeline` newtype. The `PaperCanvas` 2-D widget draws the sheet, paper-space entities and viewport borders; every content viewport (active and inactive) renders through the unified shader on top, with a transparent shader clear + alpha-blended blit so the paper sheet shows through outside drawn geometry.

Each content viewport now runs its own frustum + LOD cull (`view_aabb` + `wpp` derived from the viewport's stored camera + on-paper pixel height), so 100k-entity drawings no longer re-tessellate the whole model through every floating viewport every frame. Per-viewport hatch / wipeout / mesh upload follows the same pattern.

UTM-style drawings whose `view_target = (0, 0, 0)` no longer render blank — `camera_for_viewport` runs the same overlap-with-content-cluster test the CPU projection path already had and auto-fits when the saved view points at empty WCS.

Off-canvas viewports composite correctly: the per-viewport MSAA is sized to the on-canvas intersection and the camera projection is cropped via `crop_view_proj` to map only the visible sub-rect to NDC, so deep paper zoom no longer panics in `Device::create_texture` past the 8192-pixel limit and partially off-screen viewports no longer drift toward the canvas corner.

Inactive paper viewports were drifting against the CPU projection in `PaperCanvas` once the rect ran off-canvas; the CPU projection of model content is now removed (the unified GPU path is the single source of truth) and `paper_canvas_hatches` / `paper_canvas_wipeouts` filter to paper-layout-block entities only so model-block hatches don't get a second copy on the sheet.

`adapt_to_bg` now reaches every entity type: wires (already), hatches, ACIS meshes (Solid3D / Region / Body), 3DFACE filled triangles. New `Scene::recolor_meshes` rewrites cached mesh colours on `BACKGROUND` change + layout switch so ACIS solids track the live background without re-tessellating.

`BlockCache` stores raw sub-entity colours and applies `adapt_to_bg` at `Batches::finalize` time with the per-render `bg_color`. A single cached block defn now serves model and paper renders simultaneously with the right adaptation per render call — no rebuild needed on `BACKGROUND` or layout switch.
`model_wires_for_viewport` adapts model content shown in paper viewports to the paper background (what's actually visible behind the transparent shader), not the model bg.

ACIS solids were tessellated straight from the SAT data in WCS while every other path runs in `(WCS - world_offset)` — at UTM scale this floated meshes millions of units off camera. The new `offset_mesh_lod_set` shifts each `MeshLodSet`'s verts + `world_aabb` into the shared local f32 space at every tessellation call site.
Model-tile cameras + `view_target`s round-trip through the DXF/DWG `VPort` table with `world_offset` added back, so saved tiled layouts re-open at the right model coordinates.

Cursor hidden over the viewport (`Interaction::Hidden`) so the CAD crosshair is the only cursor; the OS resize arrow takes over on Model-tile dividers, and the CAD crosshair is suppressed there to avoid double cursors.
Divider hover hit-test + drag pipeline. Border between Model tiles drawn as a 2-px line.
Render-mode picker, ViewCube hit-area and the active-viewport border follow the active tile in tiled Model layouts and the active viewport in paper layouts.
Premultiplied-alpha blit fixes the double-darkening of anti-aliased line edges against the now-transparent shader background.

releases.name: v0.4.2
changes: Viewport render mode is now a 7-way dropdown (Wireframe 2D, Wireframe 3D, Hidden Line, Flat Shaded, Gouraud Shaded, Flat Shaded with Edges, Gouraud Shaded with Edges) instead of a binary wireframe/solid toggle.
**Wireframe 2D / 3D** draw 3D solids and meshes as their triangle edges only; PolyfaceMesh / PolygonMesh face fills are dropped while 2D fills (text-LOD greek, MultiLeader backgrounds) stay visible.
**Hidden Line** runs a depth-only prepass so edges occluded by closer geometry disappear; text greek and other 2D fills remain drawn.

**Flat vs Gouraud** shading: Flat uses a per-triangle face normal (derivative-based) for a faceted look; Gouraud keeps the smooth interpolated normal. Lighting widened to a higher-contrast range so the difference reads clearly on curved surfaces.
**\*WithEdges** variants overlay triangle edges on top of the shaded fill; the plain shaded modes hide 3DFACE / PolyfaceMesh outlines for a clean surface.
Each paper-space viewport now renders through its own `render_mode` (visual style) — the model-space dropdown only governs the Model layout.
Relative coordinate entry: `@x,y[,z]` is relative to the last point, `#x,y[,z]` forces absolute, and with DYN on bare coordinates default to relative (#26).

Dynamic input shows editable boxes near the cursor with the quantity the command is asking for (X/Y, polar distance + angle, a single radius, or an angle in degrees). TAB moves between boxes; typing locks a box to a fixed value while the rest track the cursor; Enter commits the resolved point. Numpad digits are captured too.
Dynamic input now reports the cursor's Y ordinate correctly in 3D views — it previously always showed 0 because it read the world Z component (#27).

ViewCube clicks snap to the picked face/edge/corner while preserving the user's up-sense: the nearest world axis to the current up is chosen and projected onto the new view plane, so neighbouring picks rotate the cube without rolling the screen.

Sub-pixel 3D entities (3DFACE, Solid3D, Mesh, PolyfaceMesh, PolygonMesh, Body, Region) keep their true 3D position and Z range when they shrink below the LOD threshold instead of collapsing to a flat z = 0 stub.

releases.name: v0.4.1
changes: Command line redesigned as a bottom-centre overlay that floats above the viewport — the input pill no longer takes a full-width row at the bottom of the window.
Autocomplete suggestions appear above the input as you type (substring match across every registered command); ↑ / ↓ navigates the list, Enter / click dispatches.
Command names come from `inventory::submit!` blocks placed next to each `CadCommand` impl, so the autocomplete corpus stays in sync without a hand-maintained central list.
History rows on the overlay fade off after 3 s; a ▸/▾ button next to the input opens a dropdown with the full backlog since startup.
Keyboard always reaches the command line — typed characters land in the buffer even when focus is parked on the viewport / a ribbon button / a tab.

`Space` submits the typed command the same way `Enter` does, except in free-form text prompts (TEXT / MTEXT / DDEDIT / attribute value) where it stays a literal character via a new `wants_text_with_spaces()` flag.
Empty `Enter` / `Space` now repeats the last dispatched command from anywhere.
`Esc` on a non-empty input clears the buffer first; a second press escalates to cancel-command / deselect.
Hatch wire outline no longer draws a ghost segment between disconnected boundary polylines — the missing NaN separator in the polyline arm is now emitted.
Paper-canvas no longer panics with `IncorrectActiveEdgeOrder` when a layout contains a multi-region hatch — the fill path now respects the NaN-NaN sub-path sentinels in `HatchModel.boundary`.
Dependencies bumped to latest stable releases (bytemuck 1.25, glam 0.33, rfd 0.17, ureq 3, windows-sys 0.61). `ureq 3` API migration handled inline.

Large internal refactor: per-entity tessellation moved out of `scene/tessellate.rs` into the entities' own files; bulge → arc geometry unified into a shared `BulgeArc`; `EntityTypeOps` dispatch macro-ized.
