The `PaperCanvas` 2-D widget draws the sheet, paper-space entities and viewport borders; every content viewport (active and inactive) renders through the unified shader on top, with a transparent shader clear + alpha-blended blit so the paper sheet shows through outside drawn geometry.

Each content viewport now runs its own frustum + LOD cull (`view_aabb` + `wpp` derived from the viewport's stored camera + on-paper pixel height), so 100k-entity drawings no longer re-tessellate the whole model through every floating viewport every frame. Per-viewport hatch / wipeout / mesh upload follows the same pattern.

UTM-style drawings whose `view_target = (0, 0, 0)` no longer render blank — `camera_for_viewport` runs the same overlap-with-content-cluster test the CPU projection path already had and auto-fits when the saved view points at empty WCS.

Off-canvas viewports composite correctly: the per-viewport MSAA is sized to the on-canvas intersection and the camera projection is cropped via `crop_view_proj` to map only the visible sub-rect to NDC, so deep paper zoom no longer panics in `Device::create_texture` past the 8192-pixel limit and partially off-screen viewports no longer drift toward the canvas corner.

Inactive paper viewports were drifting against the CPU projection in `PaperCanvas` once the rect ran off-canvas; the CPU projection of model content is now removed (the unified GPU path is the single source of truth) and `paper_canvas_hatches` / `paper_canvas_wipeouts` filter to paper-layout-block entities only so model-block hatches don't get a second copy on the sheet.

`adapt_to_bg` now reaches every entity type: wires (already), hatches, ACIS meshes (Solid3D / Region / Body), 3DFACE filled triangles. New `Scene::recolor_meshes` rewrites cached mesh colours on `BACKGROUND` change + layout switch so ACIS solids track the live background without re-tessellating.

`BlockCache` stores raw sub-entity colours and applies `adapt_to_bg` at `Batches::finalize` time with the per-render `bg_color`. A single cached block defn now serves model and paper renders simultaneously with the right adaptation per render call — no rebuild needed on `BACKGROUND` or layout switch.
`model_wires_for_viewport` adapts model content shown in paper viewports to the paper background (what's actually visible behind the transparent shader), not the model bg.

ACIS solids were tessellated straight from the SAT data in WCS while every other path runs in `(WCS - world_offset)` — at UTM scale this floated meshes millions of units off camera. The new `offset_mesh_lod_set` shifts each `MeshLodSet`'s verts + `world_aabb` into the shared local f32 space at every tessellation call site.
Model-tile cameras + `view_target`s round-trip through the DXF/DWG `VPort` table with `world_offset` added back, so saved tiled layouts re-open at the right model coordinates.

Cursor hidden over the viewport (`Interaction::Hidden`) so the CAD crosshair is the only cursor; the OS resize arrow takes over on Model-tile dividers, and the CAD crosshair is suppressed there to avoid double cursors.
Divider hover hit-test + drag pipeline. Border between Model tiles drawn as a 2-px line.
Render-mode picker, ViewCube hit-area and the active-viewport border follow the active tile in tiled Model layouts and the active viewport in paper layouts.
Premultiplied-alpha blit fixes the double-darkening of anti-aliased line edges against the now-transparent shader background.

Viewport render mode is now a 7-way dropdown (Wireframe 2D, Wireframe 3D, Hidden Line, Flat Shaded, Gouraud Shaded, Flat Shaded with Edges, Gouraud Shaded with Edges) instead of a binary wireframe/solid toggle.
**Wireframe 2D / 3D** draw 3D solids and meshes as their triangle edges only; PolyfaceMesh / PolygonMesh face fills are dropped while 2D fills (text-LOD greek, MultiLeader backgrounds) stay visible.
**Hidden Line** runs a depth-only prepass so edges occluded by closer geometry disappear; text greek and other 2D fills remain drawn.

**Flat vs Gouraud** shading: Flat uses a per-triangle face normal (derivative-based) for a faceted look; Gouraud keeps the smooth interpolated normal. Lighting widened to a higher-contrast range so the difference reads clearly on curved surfaces.
**\*WithEdges** variants overlay triangle edges on top of the shaded fill; the plain shaded modes hide 3DFACE / PolyfaceMesh outlines for a clean surface.
Each paper-space viewport now renders through its own `render_mode` (visual style) — the model-space dropdown only governs the Model layout.
Relative coordinate entry: `@x,y[,z]` is relative to the last point, `#x,y[,z]` forces absolute, and with DYN on bare coordinates default to relative (#26).

Dynamic input shows editable boxes near the cursor with the quantity the command is asking for (X/Y, polar distance + angle, a single radius, or an angle in degrees). TAB moves between boxes; typing locks a box to a fixed value while the rest track the cursor; Enter commits the resolved point. Numpad digits are captured too.
Dynamic input now reports the cursor's Y ordinate correctly in 3D views — it previously always showed 0 because it read the world Z component (#27).

ViewCube clicks snap to the picked face/edge/corner while preserving the user's up-sense: the nearest world axis to the current up is chosen and projected onto the new view plane, so neighbouring picks rotate the cube without rolling the screen.

Sub-pixel 3D entities (3DFACE, Solid3D, Mesh, PolyfaceMesh, PolygonMesh, Body, Region) keep their true 3D position and Z range when they shrink below the LOD threshold instead of collapsing to a flat z = 0 stub.
Command line redesigned as a bottom-centre overlay that floats above the viewport — the input pill no longer takes a full-width row at the bottom of the window.
Autocomplete suggestions appear above the input as you type (substring match across every registered command); ↑ / ↓ navigates the list, Enter / click dispatches.
Command names come from `inventory::submit!` blocks placed next to each `CadCommand` impl, so the autocomplete corpus stays in sync without a hand-maintained central list.
History rows on the overlay fade off after 3 s; a ▸/▾ button next to the input opens a dropdown with the full backlog since startup.
Keyboard always reaches the command line — typed characters land in the buffer even when focus is parked on the viewport / a ribbon button / a tab.

`Space` submits the typed command the same way `Enter` does, except in free-form text prompts (TEXT / MTEXT / DDEDIT / attribute value) where it stays a literal character via a new `wants_text_with_spaces()` flag.
Empty `Enter` / `Space` now repeats the last dispatched command from anywhere.
`Esc` on a non-empty input clears the buffer first; a second press escalates to cancel-command / deselect.
Hatch wire outline no longer draws a ghost segment between disconnected boundary polylines — the missing NaN separator in the polyline arm is now emitted.
Paper-canvas no longer panics with `IncorrectActiveEdgeOrder` when a layout contains a multi-region hatch — the fill path now respects the NaN-NaN sub-path sentinels in `HatchModel.boundary`.
Dependencies bumped to latest stable releases (bytemuck 1.25, glam 0.33, rfd 0.17, ureq 3, windows-sys 0.61). `ureq 3` API migration handled inline.

Large internal refactor: per-entity tessellation moved out of `scene/tessellate.rs` into the entities' own files; bulge → arc geometry unified into a shared `BulgeArc`; `EntityTypeOps` dispatch macro-ized.
Project renamed: H7CAD → Open CAD Studio
Binary name: `H7CAD` → `OpenCADStudio`
Logo redrawn with OCS initials
Repo moved to `HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio` (old URLs auto-redirect)

releases.name: v0.3.8
changes: Wire rendering migrated to instanced GPU pipeline — segment upload shrinks from 576 B to 76 B (~7.6× smaller), making cold-open of large drawings markedly faster.
Wire vertex emission now runs in parallel across CPU cores (rayon).
Wire upload writes straight into a `mapped_at_creation` GPU buffer, skipping one staging copy.
`LWDISPLAY` (Show Lineweight) toggle is now a shader uniform — flipping it no longer triggers a full retessellate.
Wide-polyline fill band arc center corrected, plus `LWDISPLAY` command added.
Wipeout uses real clip vertices and the correct image-pixel → WCS mapping.
Update notice now shows release notes inline with a version-card layout.
`acadrust` dependency now tracks its `main` branch for upstream fixes.

releases.name: v0.3.7
changes: **MText inline format codes everywhere.** A new run-aware MText pipeline (`text_support::layout_mtext`) replaces the legacy `strip_mtext_codes` path. Every text-bearing entity — MTEXT, TABLE cells, MLEADER MText content, ATTRIB / ATTDEF with `mtext_flag` set, and DIMENSION `text_override` — now honours `\f`, `\C`/`\c`, `\H`, `\W`, `\Q`, `\T`, `\A`, `\p…` (paragraph align + indents + tab stops), `\S` stacked fractions, `\L`/`\O`/`\K` decorations, brace-scoped state, and `\U+XXXX` unicode.

**Hatch + wipeout export to PDF.** The PDF / print pipeline previously dropped every solid fill — sheets came out with hollow polygons. `pdf_export::export_pdf` and `print_to_printer::print_wires` now consume the same hatch / wipeout list as the on-screen canvas and emit each as a filled polygon (EvenOdd winding so islands / holes work).

**PAT pattern rasteriser.** `HatchModel::pattern_segments()` clips each PAT line family against the boundary on the CPU so ANSI31, ANSI37 and friends render as actual ruled fill in both paper canvas and PDF — not just an outline. Dash phase is preserved across clipped spans to match the GPU shader.
mtext: `\pxqc;` / `\pxqr;` / `\pxql;` paragraph alignment was being lost when wrapped in a `{…}` font block; paragraph properties now persist across braces (only character state scopes).
mtext: trailing whitespace no longer skews centre / right alignment by half a space-width.
table: `\C7;Red`-style codes inside cell text used to render as literal backslash glyphs; cells now go through the MText pipeline.
multileader: silent loss of `\f`, `\C`, `\H`, `\p` inside the MText content is gone — both the snap / truck path and the LOD ladder route through `layout_mtext`.
dimension: `text_override` carrying MText escapes (font / colour / stacked tolerances) now builds a synthetic MText instead of a Text, so the codes reach the renderer.

releases.name: v0.3.6
changes: **Start tab.** A fixed Welcome tab opens on launch with quick access to New / Open / Donate, persistent Recent Documents, and a brand-tinted glow behind the action row. No more auto-spawned Drawing1.

**Text LOD everywhere.** The baseline / greek / full ladder previously used only by Text and MText now applies to AttributeDefinition, AttributeEntity, Tolerance, and the text inside Dimension and Table — including baked-block paths.
scene: render baked-block geometry for Dimension and Table (`*D###` / `*T###` / custom names) instead of synthesising from the style — fixes 60000-unit dim text in files with DIMSCALE 304.8.
text: width factor and oblique angle now use the entity-level value when present and only fall back to the text style — fixes mis-sized text in styles with non-default width or oblique.
text: MText honours `is_backward` and `is_upside_down` text-style flags.
text: MultiLeader no longer applies `scale_factor` on top of `ctx.text_height` (already baked).
text: Tolerance uses the entity's stored `dimension_gap` instead of a hard-coded heuristic.
text: Table cells resolve text height / font / alignment through CellContent → CellStyle → TableStyle.{title|header|data}_row_style.

io: opening a DWG with degenerate Arcs (radius ≈ 5e-14, zero sweep) or 100k-vertex LwPolylines at astronomic coordinates no longer crashes the wire pipeline with a 3 GB allocation. `is_entity_corrupt` now validates vertex coordinates, thickness, and degenerate-curve cases for Arc / Circle / Ellipse.

releases.name: v0.3.5
changes: **Per-tab Layer / Color / Linetype / Lineweight defaults (#21).** Opening a new tab, switching between tabs, or discarding an unsaved tab now re-seeds the Home-ribbon chips from the active doc's `CLAYER / CECOLOR / CELTYPE / CELWEIGHT` (and persists user picks into that tab's header on `Ribbon*Changed`).
Flatpak build dropped — the job, manifests, metainfo and `flatpak-builder` cache are gone. AppImage stays.
ui: ribbon chips track the active tab and write back to that tab's header (#21)
windows: hide the console window on release builds

releases.name: v0.3.4
changes: **Hatch-corrupted DWG parse hang fixed.** Files with misaligned hatch records that emitted near-INT_MAX `boundary_handle_count` values spun the parser for tens of seconds per record (>100 s on a 2.5 MB sample). The acadrust fork now caps the count via `safe_count`; the same file opens in well under a second. Tracking upstream PR: https://github.com/hakanaktt/acadrust/pull/27

**Sub-pixel objects stay visible + selectable.** Entities that projected to under ~5 px no longer drop to nothing — they emit a one-segment stub that preserves the `selected` highlight across zoom-induced LOD changes, and `box_hit` / `poly_hit` fall back to the wire AABB so fill-only greek text (and any future fill-only LOD wires) remain pickable. #19

**Round-trip DWG metadata browser.** `DWGPROPS` dumps create/update timestamps, fingerprint/version GUIDs, last_saved_by, code_page, menu_name, hyperlink_base, project_name, stylesheet, measurement, proxy_graphics, tree_depth, user-timer, and the five USERI / USERR slots; `USERI <1-5> <int>` and `USERR <1-5> <real>` edit those scalar slots and mark the tab dirty.

**Dimension / DimStyle** — full round-trip render: DIMBLK arrows, DIMLDRBLK leader heads, DIMLWD/DIMLWE per-wire weights, DIMTOL/DIMLIM tolerance text emitted at DIMTFAC × DIMTXT height with DIMTOLJ alignment, DIMALT*, DIMCEN center marks, DIMDLE, DIMJUST, DIMTVP, DIMFXL/DIMFXLON, DIMTFILL/DIMTFILLCLR background fill, DIMLTEX/1/2 linetypes, leader_length, ext_line_rotation, attachment_point, horizontal_direction, DIMTXSTY-by-handle.

**MultiLeader** — leader line_color / line_type_handle / line_weight / arrowhead_handle, extend_leader_to_text, text_angle_type / text_direction_negative / text_top/bottom_attachment / text_attachment_direction / text_alignment, block-content rendering via a synthesised Insert, every handle and override surfaced in properties.
**Table** — per-cell border `invisible` honoured (drop the always-grid pass), style / block / data_version / value_flags / override flags / break_options surfaced.

**AttributeDefinition / AttributeEntity** — text_generation_flags (mirror via width_factor / rotation), horizontal/vertical alignment mapped to Text struct, alignment_point + lock_position, attdef_handle on ATTRIBs, MText-flag / is_multiline / line_count surfaced.
**Shape** — shape_number / relative_x_scale / style_handle in properties.
**Insert** — per-INSERT `attributes` (ATTRIB entities) now render as part of the block. #20

New 3D **Mesh** SubD render path with face-fan fill, vertex grips, subdivision_level / blend_crease surfaced; Polyline3D / PolygonMesh / PolyfaceMesh / Solid3D / Region / Body / Polyline2D / Hatch / MLine / Viewport / Leader / Tolerance / RasterImage / Wipeout / Underlay / Ole2Frame metadata surfaced for round-trip.

Selecting an entity now mirrors its values into the Home-ribbon Layer / Color / Linetype / Lineweight dropdowns (#17), and changing those dropdowns with a selection edits the entities (rather than just creation defaults).
Idle CPU dropped from ~2-3 % to near zero — `window::frames()` only runs while something on screen is animating. (#18)
Per-frame redraw subscription gated on actual animations (#18)
Greek-LOD text fill carries the selection colour so highlight survives zoom past the LOD boundary (#19)
`lod_stub_wire` colour-bakes selection, INSERT attribute rendering for nested blocks (#20)
Dimension text format now reads DIMDEC / DIMZIN / DIMLFAC / DIMRND instead of `{:.4}`
Closed-filled triangle arrowheads + DIMTSZ oblique ticks replace the previous open-V two-line stroke

releases.name: v0.3.3
changes: **Full DimStyle integration** — dimensions in opened files now render with the arrow shapes, colours, line weights, text format, tolerances, alternate units, center marks and linetypes specified in their `DIMSTYLE` table instead of the previous hard-coded "open V + 4-decimal text" fallbacks. Inserts of CAD files made in CAD/BricsCAD round-trip visually for the entire DimStyle field set.

**Selection-aware Home ribbon (#17)** — selecting an entity updates the Layer / Color / Linetype / Lineweight dropdowns to match, so the dropdowns can be used to inspect (and change) the current object instead of only the creation defaults.

ui: Home-ribbon dropdowns mirror the entity selection (#17)
perf: drop idle `window::frames()` subscription (#18)

releases.name: v0.3.2
changes: **Batched hatch rendering (Phase 4-B).** Every hatch in the frame is uploaded into a shared set of GPU storage buffers and drawn in a single indexed `draw` call. The previous path issued one `set_bind_group` + one `set_vertex_buffer` + one draw call per hatch — on a 1000-hatch drawing that's ~1000 GPU command-buffer submissions replaced with 1, plus a per-instance visibility buffer that the vertex shader honours so off-screen / sub-pixel hatches still skip the fragment stage.

pipeline: batched-hatch WGSL shader (60c742e)
pipeline: wire batched-hatch pipeline + single draw call (3593e9d)
pipeline: per-instance visibility for batched hatches (398eee5)
pipeline: drop legacy per-hatch path after batched soak (798a391)
pipeline: batched-hatch pattern math (QCAD PAT local-frame convention) + invisible-instance clip position (cfe53bd)
rendering: mark Phase 4 done, drop deferred / non-goal phases (66fca6e)

releases.name: v0.3.1
changes: **Critical regression fix.** v0.3.0 shipped a quadtree with a broken `split()` that silently orphaned most of the index when straddler items piled up at an internal node. On non-UTM drawings the bulk of geometry vanished after pan/zoom — only ~5 % of indexed entities were reachable from the query. The split path now only fires on leaves, so the entire previous subtree is preserved.

**Degenerate-bbox entities now render.** v0.3.0's quadtree path also silently dropped any entity whose `bounding_box()` returned the degenerate default — points, broken polylines, etc. The fallback that the legacy `entity_aabb` provided (treat as `UNBOUNDED_AABB`, never cull) is now part of `Scene::entity_index`: such handles go into a parallel always-emit list that the wire path appends regardless of view.
quadtree: `split()` on an internal node was orphaning the entire subtree (416b0d4)
scene: emit entities with degenerate bbox from the quadtree path (b4745ef)
quadtree: silence dead-code warnings on planned API (0ec5601)

releases.name: v0.3.0
changes: **Spatial index for huge drawings.** A new quadtree drives per-frame visibility: wire tessellation, hatch fills, wipeouts and meshes all skip off-screen geometry instead of touching every entity each frame. Pan / zoom on 100 k-entity drawings now stays smooth where the previous version stalled.

**In-app update notice.** On startup the app checks the GitHub releases API; if a newer version is published it pops a small modal with a one-click link to the release page (instead of silently being out of date).

**Viewport auto-fit fallback.** Drawings where the saved viewport `view_target` is the sentinel `(0,0,0)` (common on legacy / converted files) now auto-fit to the model contents on first display instead of showing an empty viewport.
**f64-precision viewport projection.** UTM-scale drawings no longer show jitter through paper-space viewports; the projection inner loop runs in f64 throughout.

**Batched hatch rendering (Phase 4-B).** Every hatch in the frame is uploaded into a shared set of GPU storage buffers and drawn in a single indexed `draw` call. The previous path issued one `set_bind_group` + one `set_vertex_buffer` + one draw call per hatch — on a 1000-hatch drawing that's ~1000 GPU command-buffer submissions replaced with 1, plus a per-instance visibility buffer that the vertex shader honours so off-screen / sub-pixel hatches still skip the fragment stage.

**Critical regression fix.** v0.3.0 shipped a quadtree with a broken `split()` that silently orphaned most of the index when straddler items piled up at an internal node. On non-UTM drawings the bulk of geometry vanished after pan/zoom — only ~5 % of indexed entities were reachable from the query. The split path now only fires on leaves, so the entire previous subtree is preserved.

**Degenerate-bbox entities now render.** v0.3.0's quadtree path also silently dropped any entity whose `bounding_box()` returned the degenerate default — points, broken polylines, etc. The fallback that the legacy `entity_aabb` provided (treat as `UNBOUNDED_AABB`, never cull) is now part of `Scene::entity_index`: such handles go into a parallel always-emit list that the wire path appends regardless of view.

**Viewport auto-fit fallback.** Drawings where the saved viewport `view_target` is the sentinel `(0,0,0)` (common on legacy / converted files) now auto-fit to the model contents on first display instead of showing an empty viewport.

releases.name: v0.2.6
changes: **Loading overlay while opening CAD files.** Large DWG/DXF parses used to freeze the UI with no signal; the open flow now shows a modal with file name, size, phase (Reading → Parsing → Building caches → Finalizing), an animated progress bar, and a Cancel button. The cache-build phase is determinate (`done/total`); other phases use an indeterminate bouncing bar. Cancel hides the overlay and discards the result — the parser thread runs to completion since acadrust has no interrupt hook.

**Corrupt-entity guard at load time.** acadrust's DWG reader occasionally desynchronises on certain files and produces entities with garbage fields (non-unit normals in the 1e200+ range, vertex counts of 100k, infinite/NaN coordinates). Those entities are now scanned and dropped before tessellation, with a count surfaced in the command line: \`Warning: N corrupt entities dropped (parser junk — bad normals / counts)\`. Same files in DXF form continue to parse cleanly; this is strictly a DWG-path workaround until the upstream parser bug is fixed.
**Multileader text rendering** now strips MText control codes and honours the full layout (text + lines + arrows) instead of dropping fragments.
**f64 precision preserved until world_offset subtraction** in the render path, so drawings with very large coordinates (UTM, survey) no longer wobble or lose digits during pan/zoom.

**High-elevation geometry is visible in fit_all / ZOOM EXTENTS.** The outlier gate that filtered points beyond 10× the header extent half-size now only checks XY. Civil 3D files can legitimately carry profile geometry at huge Z (10^6+ units) inside an otherwise small XY footprint; Z-axis outliers are no longer a known garbage pattern and the gate no longer hides them.

**Wire segment caps (\`MAX_SEGS_PER_WIRE\` = 100k, \`MAX_TOTAL_SEGS\` = 3M).** These were stop-gap GPU-memory guards that mutated visible output — single complex entities were cut mid-geometry, and entire wires past the 3M total were dropped by arrival order with no spatial awareness. Truncated arcs and missing road segments look like bugs to the user, not "we ran out of GPU memory." Per-entity LOD and viewport culling remain the long-term answer.

releases.name: v0.2.5

The earlier `fix_mirrored_arc` workaround in H7CAD has been removed; the fix lives at the `acadrust` layer and handles non-Z normals and mirror+rotate+translate combinations.
Bumped `acadrust` pin to `622729f` (HakanSeven12/acadrust, also opened upstream as hakanaktt/acadrust#24).

releases.name: v0.2.1
changes: **Entities offset in existing drawings** — Interactively created entities (lines, arcs, etc.) are now saved with the correct world coordinates. Previously the `world_offset` subtracted during rendering was not re-added when writing to the DXF document, causing all new geometry to appear shifted by the drawing's UTM/large-coordinate offset.
**MODEL button in MSPACE** — Clicking the MODEL status-bar button while inside a viewport now correctly returns to paper space (`PSPACE`) instead of switching to the Model tab layout.
**LTSCALE applied to linetype rendering** — The global `LTSCALE` header variable is now multiplied with each entity's individual linetype scale, so dash/gap patterns render at the correct size.

**Crossing selection catches large entities** — Box selection dragged right-to-left (crossing mode) now correctly selects entities whose segments *cross* the selection box boundary, not just entities with vertices inside it. Viewport frames and other large objects are no longer missed.
**Sheet viewport border hidden** — The overall/sheet viewport (the paper boundary) no longer renders a visible border frame on top of the paper canvas.
**Paper-space grip positions** — Absolute grip moves on paper-space entities no longer apply the model-space `world_offset`, which was causing grips to jump by hundreds of kilometres when dragged.
**Viewport grip resize** — Dragging a corner grip to resize a viewport now keeps the drawing scale constant and reveals more (or less) of the model, instead of zooming the content.

**MSPACE viewport pan speed** — Panning inside an active viewport with the middle mouse button now moves the view at the correct 1:1 pixel ratio, matching the visible paper zoom level and viewport scale.

**Sheet viewport double-click (DWG files)** — The overall/sheet viewport is now correctly identified in DWG files where the viewport `id` field is not written. Previously the sheet viewport (which always has `center = (0, 0)` in DWG format) was mistaken for a content viewport, making it tessellated and enterable via double-click.
**OSNAP off by default** — Object snapping is now disabled on startup. Users can enable it via the OSNAP button in the status bar.

**MSPACE viewport pan speed** — Panning inside an active viewport with the middle mouse button now moves the view at the correct 1:1 pixel ratio, matching the visible paper zoom level and viewport scale.

**Sheet viewport double-click (DWG files)** — The overall/sheet viewport is now correctly identified in DWG files where the viewport `id` field is not written. Previously the sheet viewport (which always has `center = (0, 0)` in DWG format) was mistaken for a content viewport, making it tessellated and enterable via double-click.
**OSNAP off by default** — Object snapping is now disabled on startup. Users can enable it via the OSNAP button in the status bar.

**Native Save As file chooser** — replaced the system file dialog with a full in-app file browser: directory navigation, scrollable file list, filename input, and a format drop-down (DWG/DXF × R14/2000/2004/2007/2010/2013/2018). Fixes the long-standing issue where the selected format was ignored on Linux (#9).
**Unsaved changes dialog** — Save / Discard / Cancel prompt when closing a tab or quitting with unsaved work.
**Paper-space grip projection** — grip handles now appear at the correct screen position for paper-space entities.
**MTEXT attachment point** — text no longer renders offset from its declared attachment point (Top Left, Middle Center, etc.).
**MTEXT line spacing** — correct inter-line gap and preserved blank paragraph separators.
**MTEXT escape codes** — all `\P`, `\~`, `\U+XXXX`, font-change, and colour-change sequences decoded correctly.

releases.name: v0.1.9
changes: **Paper-space grip points**: Grip points on paper-space objects are now visible and interactive. Two root causes fixed: grip coordinates were incorrectly offset by the model-space world_offset, and the projection used the 3-D view matrix instead of the 2-D paper-space transform.

**MTEXT attachment point rendering**: Text with Top/Middle/Bottom attachment points now renders with the insertion point at the correct position. CXF glyphs extend upward from the baseline, so v_offset is now computed correctly for each attachment variant.
**MTEXT line spacing**: Line height now correctly applies the CAD 5/3 × text_height default baseline-to-baseline multiplier (DXF code 44 factor = 1.0 → single spacing ≈ 1.667 × height).
**MTEXT paragraph separators**: Blank lines produced by double `\P` are now preserved between paragraphs instead of being stripped.

**MTEXT special character codes**: All standard escape sequences are now decoded — `\U+XXXX` Unicode, `\S` stacked fractions, `\t` tab, `%%d`/`%%p`/`%%c` degree/plus-minus/diameter, and `%%nnn` decimal codes.

**Unsaved changes dialog**: Closing a dirty tab or quitting with unsaved files now shows a Save / Discard / Cancel dialog in a separate OS window. Multiple dirty tabs are confirmed one by one. Cancelling aborts the close.

releases.name: v0.1.8
changes: **Camera persistence**: Camera position, zoom, and orientation are now saved per layout (model space and each paper space tab) and restored on file open and tab switch. Stored in the View table so it survives DWG save/reload cycles.

**Correct paper size**: Paper dimensions are now read from the embedded PlotSettings (`paper_width`/`paper_height`/`plot_rotation`) rather than drawing limits, which could be wrong for files with mixed paper sizes.
**Viewport projection fix**: Model content now projects correctly into paper-space viewport rectangles — `view_target` is properly converted to wire-space before projection.

**Viewport visibility**: Viewports from externally-created DXF/DWG files are now visible and enterable; handles the case where viewport IDs are 0 or negative by falling back to geometry-based identification.
**Entity colors in viewports**: White/black entity colors adapt correctly to the viewport background luminance.
**Wide polylines**: LWPolyline and Polyline2D with non-zero width are now rendered as solid filled strokes.
**Face3D performance**: Dedicated Face3D shader reduces draw calls from N to 2.
**Selection visibility**: Selected wires are always drawn on top of occluding geometry via an X-ray ghost pass.
**Color adaptation**: White and black entities automatically invert against contrasting backgrounds.
**Complex linetypes**: Text elements in complex linetype definitions are now rendered.
**Dimension arrows**: Arrow size respects `DIMASZ × DIMSCALE` from the dimension style.
**Extension lines**: `DIMEXO` (offset from origin) and `DIMEXE` (extension overshoot) are now applied.
**MultiLeader**: Spline path type tessellated via Catmull-Rom.
**New snap points**: Ellipse arc endpoints, LWPolyline arc midpoints, ellipse quadrant points, INSERT insertion point, Hatch boundary points.
